articleTitle: Smart Wheelchair Controlled by Head Movements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces overview of smart wheelchairs controlled by head movements, an emerging technology aimed at improving mobility and independence for individuals with motor disabilities. Traditional wheelchair control interfaces often pose challenges for users with limited hand dexterity, necessitating innovative solutions to enhance accessibility and ease of navigation. The core of the system lies in the real-time processing of video input captured by a camera mounted on the wheelchair. By leveraging computer vision algorithms, such as open-cv python and motion tracking, the system identifies and tracks the user’s head movements with high accuracy and responsiveness. This information is then used to generate control commands (like Forward, Backward, Right, Left) for the wheelchair, allowing users to navigate smoothly and intuitively. In additionally, the smart wheelchair system offers various features to enhance user experience and safety. These include obstacle detection and healthcare parameters, as well as customizable control parameters to accommodate individual user preferences and mobility needs. By leveraging the power of computer vision, the system offers a more intuitive and accessible means of wheelchair navigation, empowering users to navigate their environments with greater freedom and independence.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Dimmable Circuits for Lighting Applications: Technologies, Design Considerations, and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The evolution of lighting technology has significantly advanced with the integration of Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs), offering superior energy efficiency, extended operational life, and minimal heat generation compared to traditional lighting sources. Dimming capability is a critical feature that enhances the versatility and functionality of LED lighting systems across various applications. This paper provides an in-depth review of dimmable circuits specifically designed for LED lighting, focusing on the latest technologies, key design considerations, and performance metrics.The review encompasses four primary dimming techniques: phase-cut dimming, pulse width modulation (PWM) dimming, analog dimming, and digital dimming. Each method is evaluated based on its operational principles, advantages, and limitations. By studying and understanding the literature’s available, this paper brings out in depth details of various dimming techniques and contributes to advancement in the field of LED lighting technology.

articleTitle: E-bike using wireless charging and split battery with renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The demand for renewable energy sources (RES) to generate pure, sustainable electricity is on increasing. Wind and solar energy were the most viable forms of clean energy due to their abundance and ease of access. Efficiency in both off-grid and grid-connected renewable energy systems has been greatly improved. Using RES to charge the batteries of EVs is one of their many uses. A new bidirectional dc-ac converter configuration was suggested for use in a developed photovoltaic grid supply to the single-phase grid with utility sent back to the extra power that has been generated by the photovoltaic array, while simultaneously charging the EV battery during maximum direct sunlight hours. In the suggested setup, the power grid would back up EV battery charging during low and non-sunny hours. Inherent self-grid synchronization capability of the innovative bidirectional dc-ac converter topology used in this suggested system decreases work in the proposed charging system.

articleTitle: IoT Assisted Smart Parking System for Vehicles using Logical Sensors and Remote Monitoring Facility
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Users have a hard time dealing with the issue of finding a parking spot, particularly in busy areas. The conventional method for locating a parking spot is scouting out areas with free pavement on one's own. It causes consumers to use more effort and time, which in turn causes traffic congestion. In response to these difficulties, a smart parking system has been designed to help drivers locate parking spots more quickly and easily. Congestion on the roads is becoming increasingly problematic in big cities due to the growing number of cars on the road. Our hope is that this report will help find a solution. Most of the time, the user will need to squander time and energy trying to find a parking spot in a certain lot or garage. A notice is delivered to the user with the parking details. As a result, the user spends less time in a holding pattern when looking for a parking spot. When customers use the mobile app to book a spot and pay for it using PayPal, the system is considered "smart."

articleTitle: Smart Mushroom Cultivation with Classification of Mushrooms and Disease Detection using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Mushrooms, cultivating may be a well-known choice among the agriculturists because it devours less space and less time for developing whereas offering a tall dietary esteem, but most agriculturists come up short to get the leading abdicate from their developments due to the abandons and wasteful aspects within the manual strategies that are being directly utilized. The engineering strategy for IoT and machine learning (ML)-based keen mushroom cultivation is reflected in this study. Classification of mushrooms and cultivation mechanisation are included in the suggested framework. Smart monitoring and cultivation mechanisation are made possible by the Internet of Things (IoT), the microcontroller ESP32, and a few agriculturally related sensors. Innovation in machine learning (ML) has been embraced to categorise different types of mushrooms to prevent mixing them together and to separate the disease-affected mushrooms.

articleTitle: IoT Air-Care
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Vulnerable populations such as juveniles, the geriatrics, gestating females and individuals managing antecedent health concerns like COVID19 are particularly susceptible to the harmful ramifications of air pollution. According to the World Health Organization, each year, 3.2 million people die prematurely from illnesses attributable to the household air pollution caused by the incomplete combustion of solid fuels and kerosene. The proposed system aims to analyze the quality of indoor air using Raspberry Pi Pico W interfaced with sensors and implements real-time monitoring through Internet of Things (IoT). It employs MQ-135 sensor and DHT11 sensor to observe the smoke levels, temperature and humidity in the atmosphere. The accrued quantifiers are utilized to analyze the Air Quality Index (AQI). If the cleanliness standard exceeds safe thresholds (above 400ppm), an alert will be activated, to signal that dangerous air quality levels are present nearby. The information thus collected is monitored continuously through ThingSpeak and MQTT server.

articleTitle: Reliable Network-on-Chip Design with Spare Node Analysis for Smart Fault Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Networks-on-Chip (NoCs) are crucial in VLSI development, enabling faster on-chip communication. However, as technology advances, power consumption by NoC links competes with that of routers and network interfaces. To address this, an encoding technique using XOR gates is proposed to reduce link power consumption. This innovative design introduces robust error detection mechanisms for dynamic Network-on-Chip (NoC) architectures, where faulty blocks' count and location fluctuate during operation. Real-time detection of data packet errors and adaptive routing algorithm anomalies enables precise identification of permanent and transient faults, pinpointing faulty blocks with high accuracy.Intelligent spare node selection in NoC routers leverages this information, maintaining optimal throughput, network load, and data packet latency. By minimizing redundant checks on inactive nodes, return path latency is significantly reduced. This approach optimizes NoC performance, rendering it a promising solution for dependable and efficient on-chip communication.

articleTitle: Cascaded Neural Network Controller Development for Electric Vehicle Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The possible way to decrease the dangerous air pollution that comes from vehicle exhaust by deciding to operate an EV. This research suggests developing a CNN controller for plug-in hybrid EV(PHEV) energy management system. PHEV Battery System is developed for an isolated high gain bidirectional isolated DC-DC converter. An example of a bridge rectifier, a type of fullwave rectifier that converts alternating current (AC) into direct current (DC). Here, the PHEV system uses independent DC-DC converters. Isolated DC-DC converters control variable low voltage to steady high output voltage. For closed loop functioning, the ANN controller is utilised. The PWM Generator assists the ANN controller in regulating the voltage, and the reference current that results is then compared to the real current. The suggested approach results in a high gain, diminished ripples, decreased switching losses, and improved energy management. In order to construct this project, MATLAB Simulation was used.

articleTitle: OCR based transliteration of Brahmi to Tamil using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project aims to develop an OCR (Optical Character Recognition) system that can translate Brahmi script into Tamil automatically. Data preparation, picture preprocessing, character mapping with JTessBoxEditor, producing training data, and building a trained model are some of the phases involved in the suggested system. After that, handwritten Brahmi images are used to test the system, and an intuitive web interface is created to make the transliteration process easier. In order to close the gap between ancient scripts and modern Tamil, this research makes use of contemporary OCR technology and image processing, which improves comprehension and interpretation of historical texts.

articleTitle: Wireless Servosystem For AC and Dc Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This manuscript presents the design and implementation of a wireless servosystem for AC and DC machines. The system aims to improve the efficiency and control of electrical machines through wireless communication and advanced control algorithms. The project focuses on the development of hardware and software essentials to achieve seamless integration and operation of the servosystem. The proposed solution addresses the limitations of traditional wired systems by providing a robust and scalable wireless alternative, enhancing flexibility and reducing complexity in installation and maintenance using Field-Programmable Gate Arrays.

articleTitle: Smart Water Quality Monitoring and Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent times, water pollution is one of the biggest challenge in the world. Drinking water is becoming spoiled and polluted. Additionally, storage of water is essential to water management because it guarantees a steady supply of water for a variety of purposes and acts as a backup during periods of scarcity. This paper discusses how to use water effectively that promotes sustainability, sufficiency, and efficiency by incorporating cutting-edge technologies including information systems, data collecting, sensors, smart water meters, and decision support systems. This solution is provided with the application of IoT technology. Smart water quality monitoring and management system uses smart water quality sensor technology to measure water parameters such as temperature, dissolved oxygen levels, presence of suspended solids, RFID reader, GSM module. A water level monitoring system may automatically determine the liquid level in tanks or storage containers of various sizes. This ensures that their water is nutrient-rich and safe for human consumption, even in remote areas. Furthermore, saves power by knowing how much water flow is needed for a specific distribution line.The proposed system offers several advantages, including real-time water monitoring, efficient water management, secure access control, automatic alerts for low water levels and water impurities, and location tracking for improved maintenance. The system utilizes various components such as an ultrasonic sensor, pH sensor, RFID reader, keypad, relay, solenoid valve, GSM module, GPS module, and LCD. The GSM module is used to send alert messages to the appropriate authorities or a designated corporation responsible for water supply. The GSM module also enables communication with the tank’s location information, obtained through a GPS module, facilitating efficient water management and maintenance. The existing system depends on manual water quality and level monitoring, which can be laborious and prone to human mistake. The integration of advanced technologies within this water management system is being undertaken to present a comprehensive solution aimed at optimizing water usage and enhancing efficiency. The prototype of this system is successfully implemented and tested.

articleTitle: FHarmony- An AI Based Personalised E-commerce Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Unofficially, Agriculture is now considered to be one of the least profitable jobs one could do. The main reason behind this is that the livelihood of farmers which is based on the only source of their income is being affected. Most of their income is decided by the Intermediates. The price of the cultivated crops is being decided by the third parties rather than being decided by Farmers itself. An application to overcome the existing intermediate system in the field of agriculture by connecting farmers with consumers directly through this app can provide a solution the above problem. Giving the control of fixing the price of harvested products by the farmers itself through this app can help solving the abovementioned problem. Our idea is to create an AI based Application that provides a direct link between the customers and the cultivators, which helps the farmers to decide their price for their products with a reasonable amount of profit. By this, customers can directly avail products from farmers for a reasonable price. Our target are the cities near cultivable lands, where we establish a hub for storing and delivering goods. Customers can either pick up their orders directly from these hubs or opt for door delivery. This App contains personalised User Interface (UI)for both Farmers and Consumers. That works on the principle inspired from REVERSE BIDDING. Also have included features such as Artificial Interface (AI) based recommendations of products, user friendly chatbots.

articleTitle: Sil Based Fault Detection in Distillation Column
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Distillation column failure identification and detection required improved efficiency, safety, and dependability of sophisticated process control techniques. Our main motive of this project is to maintain the liquid flow in the flash drum. And to maximize the products, minimize the losses and energy and capital cost. Ensure process works and achieves business objectives and to ensure process is safe. Chemicals like petrol, diesel, petrochemical feedstocks, lubricating oils are the products of crude oil order to obtain all these products from crude oil there is a long process which requires a continuous monitoring and we need to make sure if everything is going in the right way. So that we can use these methods that will be discussed in below slides monitoring these process requires a lot productivity efficiency and safety in process industries

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach to Attendance Monitoring: Combining Geo Location and Facial Verification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Attendance management is an important task for an educational institution to cater to faculty accountability and correct tracking of the same. Traditional technique is enhanced by introducing a novel system that uses three separate modules; namely face recognition, geofencing, and real-time notifications. The system can identify when faculty members enter the institution’s appointed area, and it embraces them with a request to complete the attendance process. The faculty members are encouraged to log onto to face detection software, where in they have a set time frame for them to log on and log their attendance using their individual identification number. The mobile application software has additional options - check-in and check-out options to precisely monitor the working hours accurately. It ensures the attendance is not falsified, and only registered within the designated area. The bank offers an elegant interface with sections of home, reports, user details, and announcement. The report sect provides a clear overview of the attendance records, and the user detail section provides comprehensive information about the faculty members, however the announcement section is relevant for the announcement section is the latest updates about the institution. Additionally, with the advanced security on this system, the data privacy and the data integrity is secure and trustworthy to use in this contemporary educational institution. It has not only increased the efficiency of workplace, but has also improved the traditional attendance logging system.

articleTitle: Smart Sensors for Real-Time Monitoring of Animal Health and Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The health issues in animals are increasing in our daily life. Nowadays animals have become increasingly significant in the lives of humans. When animals suffer from diseases and infections, keeping track of their well-being is crucial as it can impact our daily routines, highlighting the importance of monitoring their health. Clinical methods for keeping an eye on cattle health are inadequate because they yield inconsistent data and demand an excessive amount of effort and veterinary knowledge. The primary cause of death for the aforementioned animals is this issue. As a result, an IoT-based prototype of an animal health monitoring system is constructed, which measures the temperature, heart rate, and movement of sick animals in real time. By monitoring vital signs such as heartbeat rate, temperature, and motion, the app can alert veterinary staff about potential health problems in pets, allowing them to intervene early and provide appropriate treatment. This equipment can be affixed to the ill animal in order to monitor it by gathering and evaluating health data. Animals with aberrant vital signs can be treated sooner. Animals with abnormal vital signs can be relieved sooner.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fruits and Vegetables Storage Management System for Warehouse and Cold Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study investigates the creative use of artificial intelligence to combine object detection with conventional cooling systems. It maximizes the system's overall efficiency and temperature by the application of an AI algorithm. This study offers a clever, environmentally responsible method of cold storage that helps fruits and vegetables stay fresher for longer. Subsequent to the integration of Object Detection, this system will have intelligent temperature regulation, hence increasing its energy efficiency. Using computer vision, the project's Object Detection component identifies objects inside the cold storage and adjusts the temperature dynamically to ensure the best possible preservation depending on the type and quantity of contents. It will additionally offer details regarding the condition of the merchandise. We will have internet access to all of the data, allowing us to access the cold storage data from anywhere at any time. The LCD will also show the fruits' condition and temperature. This project's practical use will be in the transportation and agriculture sectors for the long-term, effective storage of various items in any compartment.

articleTitle: The Pivotal Role Of Digital Marketing In The Global Market: A Comprehensive Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Digital marketing's impact on the worldwide market is immense in today's linked world. Businesses now have more chances than ever before to connect with customers all over the globe because to the expansion of digital technology and the internet's broad use. This article delves into the relevance, essential components, and impact on company operations and strategies of digital marketing, offering a thorough review of its multidimensional position in the worldwide market. The article examines pertinent literature and case studies to shed light on how digital marketing enables several benefits, such as reaching a worldwide audience, making ads more targeted, being cost-effective, developing brands, making content more accessible, being available 24/7, being agile, and being flexible. Additionally, it delves into the possibilities and threats of digital marketing on a worldwide scale, shedding light on new developments and recommendations for making the most of digital platforms in today's cutthroat business climate.

articleTitle: Emotion Detection System for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder based on IoT and Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Today, parents of children are feeling difficult having problem of autism spectrum disorder since their child struggle to recognize and express their emotions, which makes them feel alone. The design and execution of an emotion detection system for kids with ASD are presented in this research. The system uses python libraries such as open cv and haar cascade method to detect and predict facial expressions in real time. Unlike most existing systems that focus on social media like Snapchat, this project is centered on real-time facial expression recognition (FER) aimed at improving the social interaction of those suffering from such disorders such as autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The child's face is captured by the system in real time so as to capture her emotional state from her facial gestures. It also responds to detected emotions like playing a song if it notices a happy face to improve the social behaviour of kids with ASD. For example, an engaging audio track may be played when it identifies a smiley face. This helps maintain calmness in children thus fostering interactive learning through an ATmega microcontroller coupled with DF mini-player. A stress sensor based on Galvanic Skin Response (GSR) has also been added for monitoring purposes of stress levels within this system. For continuous monitoring and management purpose stress data is transmitted through Node MCU (ESP8266-12E microcontroller) over Internet in real time.

articleTitle: Finwise–A Smart Investment Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper proposes an MLR-based framework of stock valuation and investment advisory system. The system requires the user to input his/her financial information and the current information about the stock in question. It then gives out very customized, individualized investment advice. Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Django, Python, Scikit-learn, yfinance. The algorithm analyzes equities based on financial metrics: market sentiments, earnings, pulling real-time data from Yahoo Finance. MLR will then alter the advice based on customers financial conditions, including targets for investments and salary. The user-friendly interface enables easy data entry, which also displays individualized stock picks. Django integrates well with scikit-learn modeling and provides secure management of users data. At the very heart of this ingenious approach is to enable customers to achieve their financial goals by outpacing inflation through better investing choices. High performance based on real-time data and innovative technology.

articleTitle: Immaculate Water Tank
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The water in overhead tanks heats up to a temperature of more than 40 degrees Celsius during the summer in Tamil Nadu, where temperatures range from 34 to 45 degrees Celsius. Direct usage of the water from the above tank may be extremely hot and occasionally intolerable for sensitive individuals. This situation applies to all housekeeping tasks. This issue appears in hospitals as well. The usage of such hot water may result in health problems like sunburns, rashes, and irritation. The use of hot water from the overhead tank could possibly inflict burns or boils on young children or elderly people with sensitive skin. Daily uses of tap water include bathing, washing dishes, and taking showers. It is uncomfortable to use tap water at this hot a temperature Thus, that project having a spotless water tank allows you to manage and modify the water's temperature from 40 degrees Celsius to 30 degrees Celsius Using the temperature sensor. Using Arduino, we set it to a regular temperature in order to measure the temperature. The heated water is cooled using a Peltier module to return it to normal temperature.

articleTitle: AI supermarket
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: AI supermarket introduces an innovative RFID-based smart shopping system designed for supermarkets. The system comprises two Arduino-based kits, the first managing secure entry through RFID card authentication and the second automating the shopping process within the store. The entry system utilizes an RFID reader and DVD loader for access control, while the shopping module, integrated into trolleys or baskets, incorporates RFID technology for product verification and GSM communication for seamless payments. The inclusion of NodeMCU ensures real-time updates of customer information to the supermarket's database. This project aims to revolutionize in-store shopping, making it more efficient, secure, and accessible to a diverse range of customers.

articleTitle: Human ECG Authentication with Computational Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Electrocardiograms are unique to each individual and vary depending on their physiological state. In this study, we harness ECG data to identify diseases and distinguish between different individuals. The process begins with the collection of ECG signals from various individuals under different conditions. Next, we preprocess the data using statistical methods to ensure its quality and consistency. Following this, we employ a Support Vector Machine to train on the preprocessed value, enabling us to classify each person’s ECG into distinct categories. Finally, when new ECG data is presented, the trained SVM can accurately identify and classify it, thanks to the robust statistical preprocessing. This approach not only enhances the classifier’s accuracy but also its resilience to variations in individual ECG signals.

articleTitle: Battery Management In Grid Into Vehicle Integration For Smart Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EV) are becoming more and more prevalent in the distribution systems, and this trend is expected to continue. Increased EV penetration causes problems with power quality in the distribution system. For system planning and design, distribution networks must take into account the power quality problems brought on by the widespread use of EVs. EV penetration in distribution networks is expected to cause power quality problems, such as imbalance in voltage, total harmonic distortion, failure of distribution transformer and associated problems. The impact of these power quality problems on distribution networks also appropriate mitigation strategies are discussed in this paper. G2V and V2G bidirectional power flow have been proposed as methods for mitigating the effects of poor power quality. Bidirectional power flow while EVs are being charged and discharged as well as power quality problems are addressed.

articleTitle: Gesture-Enhanced Communication Systems for the Deaf and Dumb: An In-Depth Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Sign language is a vast and complicated language with its own grammatical structures and content. It conveys message through hand forms, face emotions, and body movements. There are several sign languages around the world, each with unique characteristics. As a result, few individuals are able to understand sign language, it is impossible to communicate with the deaf-mute. The gap that exists between the deaf and normal people can be lessened with research in the field of sign language recognition (SLR). Unfortunately, with huge improvements in SLR, this type of recognition lags behind voice recognition by at least ten years. This research provides an overview of Sign Language, including movements and key approaches for identifying it.

articleTitle: Design and Comparison of Activation Functions for the Classification of Cotton Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Non-linear activation units seen in artificial and deep neural networks are the hyperbolic tangent, sigmoid functions, and ReLu (Rectified Linear Unit).This research compares the performance of these activation functions within a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework for detecting Cotton Leaf Diseases. The study evaluates performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix and support. The activation functions are trained on a dataset consisting of labeled images of healthy and diseased cotton leaves. The comparative analysis highlights the influence of the activation function on the model’s performance, with a specific focus on a model that combines ReLu and Tanh activation functions for image classification tasks related to Cotton Leaf Diseases detection. This research contributes to the advancement of deep learning techniques in agricultural disease detection and promotes sustainable farming practices.

articleTitle: PV based single input multi output converter for residential loads
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As the global demand for sustainable energy solutions rises, residential power distribution faces challenges of inefficiency and environmental impact. This project introduces a groundbreaking solution - a PV-based single input multi-output converter designed for residential loads. The technology integrates a two-stage converter, Power MOSFETs, and a PIC 16F877A microcontroller to maximize solar energy utilization, adapt to varying loads, and optimize energy distribution.The project's innovative features include a two-stage converter architecture, Power MOSFETs for efficient switching, and a smart energy management system executed by the PIC 16F877A microcontroller. Our solution addresses challenges in residential energy distribution, providing an intelligent, sustainable, and adaptive power system for homes.As we progress through TRLs, our commitment is to advance this technology towards commercial deployment, contributing to a more sustainable and efficient future for residential energy consumption.

articleTitle: Smart Goggles for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The goal of this project is to develop AI-powered smart glasses that will help people who are blind or visually impaired navigate and interact with their surroundings more successfully. The smart goggles combine cutting-edge natural language processing and computer vision technologies to offer text-to-speech conversion, face recognition, and real-time object detection. The glasses' built-in ultrasonic sensor determines how far away the subject must be from the object that will be the subject of the captured image in order to take a sharp picture. We have used Tinkercad, Proteus, and Python to simulate this.

articleTitle: Criminal Identification Based On Database Management Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The crime monitoring system is a unique and authentic project which functions with the concepts of block chain language. Blockchain technology has the potential to revolutionize the management of criminal records by providing a secure network where documents are readily accessible and immune to tampering. This innovation ensures the safety and integrity of sensitive information, offering a robust solution to the challenges posed by traditional recordkeeping system. The basic use of the crime identification system is to maintain and process the criminal records and data that are given by the user. This can be used in the security system during the arrival of dignitary people for the occasional events by recognizing the people based upon the criminal records. Thus, criminals are restricted from entering inside the event. This can also be embedded for the security cameras of the event and are constantly monitored.

articleTitle: IOT Based Forest Fire Detection and Extinguishing System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A forest fire detection system integrating deep learning and IoT for timely and accurate wildfire detection. Surveillance cameras in forests capture visual data, analyzed by deep learning algorithms to distinguish smoke or flames, ensuring low false alarm rates. The system uses an Arduino Uno with an IR sensor to detect wind direction, displaying updates on an LCD and transmitting data to a cloud server via an ESP8266 microcontroller for remote monitoring. Python-based image processing enhances fire detection. This comprehensive solution improves early fire detection and response, contributing to effective forest fire prevention and mitigation [1].

articleTitle: Farm Aid Metrix
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project presents the development of an agricultural coordinating platform with advanced sensors like NPK sensors, pH sensors, temperature sensors, GPS and Internet of Things technology to reduce fertilizer usage by correct assessment of the available nutrients in soil and accurate recommendation of the type of fertilizer used, cropping pattern and crop planning. By incorporating real-time data from an NPK sensor into the IoT, which can ease mixed cropping for farmers and discover fertilizers they require exactly. Mapping the ground using drone, satellite, and GPS technologies is another factor the platform uses in automating agriculture- related tasks. The drones are used in spraying fertilizers, and bots remove weeds to ensure that the exact pH and nutrition balance in the soil is maintained. An approach like this will give increased yields of crops, lead to fertile soils, and ensure sustainable agricultural practices. These results imply that a platform of this nature is likely to significantly bring down fertilizer wastage and increase productivity in agriculture.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mental Well-being through AI-Driven Virtual Environments: The Merrytopia Project
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces Merrytopia, an innovative well-being platform integrating AI, Unity, and journaling to address contemporary mental health challenges. The platform leverages AI methodologies such as Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning for sentiment analysis and personalized insights. Unity is employed to craft visually pleasing environments fostering mindfulness. The paper outlines the system architecture, AI techniques, and user experience, highlighting how Merrytopia contributes to accessible and personalized mental well-being solutions.

articleTitle: Under Water Safety System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The increasing frequency of human-shark and human-saltwater crocodile encounters near coastal areas has prompted the need for advanced surveillance techniques to enhance swimmer safety. Conventional thermal cameras are limited in their ability to detect cold-blooded marine species. This study proposes a novel approach to marine species identification utilizing high-resolution cameras and advanced pattern recognition techniques. By harnessing the power of machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision, we aim to develop a robust system capable of accurately identifying and tracking various marine species in real-time. This system has the potential to revolutionize coastal safety measures, providing early warnings and enabling rapid response to potential threats. The proposed methodology holds promise in significantly reducing the risks associated with marine species encounters, ensuring safer swimming experiences for coastal communities.

articleTitle: AgriBot : An Integrated Chatbot Platform for Precision Agriculture and Farmer Support using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In modern agriculture, efficient soil moisture management and timely disease prevention are critical for maximizing crop yields. This study proposes a novel approach integrating sensor-based soil moisture detection and AI-driven chatbot technology to address these challenges. The developed system enables users to inquire about soil moisture levels and receive responses indicating whether the moisture is optimal, high, or low. Moreover, utilizing AI chatbot capabilities, users can seek guidance on resolving soil moisture issues, with the chatbot providing tailored solutions based on the detected conditions. Furthermore, the system extends its functionality to disease detection in plant leaves by employing deep learning methodology using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithms. Users can upload images of diseased leaves, and the chatbot utilizes CNN to identify the type of disease present. Upon diagnosis, the chatbot offers preventative measures to mitigate the spread of the disease, thus aiding in preserving crop health and productivity. Additionally, the chatbot serves as a platform for agricultural inquiries, where users can seek information on various agriculture-related topics, receiving informative responses tailored to their queries. By integrating sensor technology, AI ChatBot capabilities, and CNN Algorithms for image recognition, this innovative solution empowers farmers with actionable insights for effective soil moisture management, disease prevention, and agricultural decision-making. This research not only demonstrates the potential of AI-driven systems in agriculture but also highlights their role in addressing key challenges faced by modern farming practices.

articleTitle: Scouring of Salt Chuck: Employing Deep Learning for Autonomous Plastic Extraction from Water Bodies' Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Ponds grapple with diverse challenges as plastic trash accumulation harms aquatic ecosystems and endangers a variety of species. The urgency to address these issues is underscored by the importance of ponds as vital habitats. Detrimental effects of trash on water quality, aquatic life, and biodiversity necessitate prompt removal. Utilizing advanced technologies such as Satellite signals, IoT sensors, and Al & ML with deep learning algorithms can expedite plastic trash detection and removal processes. Swift intervention is critical to restoring pond ecosystems, safeguarding biodiversity, and ensuring sustainable water resources.

articleTitle: Enhancing Blood Glucose Monitoring Through Integrated Defected Ground Structure and Radio Frequency Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The prevalence of diabetes globally has highlighted the need for continuous and non-invasive blood glucose monitoring methods. Traditional invasive techniques, such as finger pricking, are not only painful but also pose risks of infection and skin irritation. This paper presents the design and development of an intelligent non-invasive blood glucose monitoring system utilizing a Defected Ground Structure (DGS) with Radio Frequency (RF) waves. The proposed system aims to offer a low-cost, reliable, and user-friendly alternative for glucose monitoring, improving the quality of life for diabetic patients. The system's effectiveness has been demonstrated through simulations and prototype development, showing promising results for accurate glucose measurement without tissue damage.

articleTitle: Smart Mining: Integrating Internet Of Things (IoT) For Improved Coal Mine Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents a Coal Mine Safety System designed to monitor environmental conditions in underground mines using IoT technology. The system employs various sensors, including an MQ-2 gas sensor, a DHT11 temperature and II. METHODOLOGY humidity sensor, and a NodeMCU Wi-Fi module, to detect hazardous conditions such as gas leaks, temperature fluctuations, and humidity levels. The data is transmitted to a central server via the IoT platform ThinkSpeak, allowing for real-time monitoring and alerts. This system aims to enhance miner safety providing <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">•</sup> timely warnings and helping to prevent accidents in coal mines.

articleTitle: Optimizing Virtual Power Plant Allocation to Enhance Indian Distribution Grid Performance under Extreme Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Indian distribution grid faces substantial challenges due to diverse climate conditions and rising energy demands, exacerbated by frequent extreme weather events such as storms, heatwaves, and heavy rainfall. These events often lead to severe disruptions in power supply, highlighting the need for advanced solutions to enhance grid resilience and reliability. This study explores the optimization of virtual power plant (VPP) allocation to improve grid performance under such conditions, using the water cycle search optimization algorithm (WCOA). The research focuses on the Indian 28-bus radial distribution system (RDS) and aims to achieve two main objectives: (i) Minimizing energy not delivered and (ii) Maximizing the resilience index. The WCOA is employed to optimize VPP deployment, integrating various distributed energy resources (DERs) like solar and wind sources and storage systems (BESS). Results demonstrate that the WCOA effectively enhances grid resilience and reduces energy not delivered during extreme weather events. This study provides insights into optimizing VPP allocation, contributing to a more reliable and resilient Indian distribution grid.

articleTitle: Analyzing and predicting the performance of players using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The ensemble method employs a combination of logistic regression and random forest classification to analyze cricket player performance. Using datasets from the Indian Premier League (IPL) and India T20 series, key performance metrics such as batting average and strike rate are examined. This strategic approach enhances the precision of player assessment, providing insights into individual proficiency as well as broader implications for team composition and match strategies. The research highlights the critical role of logistic regression and random forest classification in advancing cricket analytics.

articleTitle: Voice Controlled Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The require for programmed Wheelchair is particularly show in care of undaunted individuals (individuals with tireless vegetative state, paraplegia, stroke and spinal line wounds), where the care requires a part of time and labor. This report is the result of a plan and advancement of an computerized multifunctional Wheelchair that would perform all capacities display in today's Wheelchair (Wheelchair with flexible parcel of back rest and leg rest additionally farther control with which we are able give all fundamental development) as well as modern capacities of fitting Wheelchair segments ( leg positions altering). It is anticipated that this modern programmed Wheelchair would empower people's superior therapeutic care, and would significantly decrease time and labor to the old-age domestic staff. Hence, The purpose of this model is to plan, design and build a wheelc hair audio control system. The frame of the wheelchair include a motor frame and a voice recognition module controlled by a microcontroller. Hence, the created voice controlled wheelchair can give simple get to for individuals with physical inability additionally offer programmed security from impediment collision in case the botch of any voice commands happens

articleTitle: Design Of Energy Efficient Motor For Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The depletion and cost of fossil fuels causes the automobile industry has started moving towards the development of Electric Vehicles. These vehicles are also classified as Green Transportation as they are free from harmful exhaust which affects the environment. In order to drive an electric vehicle, the motor should be able to overcome all the forces by producing sufficient power. Therefore, all electric vehicle manufacturers have their own customized electric motor to meet the necessary power and torque to produce motion. One of the most common public transports in India other than buses are three wheeled vehicles. It is easy to electrify those vehicles because they require less power for traction when compared to heavy public transports like vans, buses, etc. To electrify those vehicles, an appropriate motor is required. This project deals on the component design and electromagnetic analysis of customized Brush-less DC (BLDC) motor using ANSYS MOTOR-CAD software for small passenger vehicles.

articleTitle: ARchitect: Visualize Your Dream Space with Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a technology that gives an interactive experience by integrating the digital information with the real- time environment. AR has a high scope and potential in interior designing because of its ability to experiment with different digital decor items and see how they fit into their space without any physical changes. In this paper, we present an innovative solution that uses augmented reality (AR) technology to enable users to visualize and preview decor items such as furniture, clocks, paintings, and tiles in a real-world environment. Our app is built on the AR foundations platform using C#, which allows for seamless integration with mobile devices and ensures a high- quality user experience. The app provides a 3D view of the selected decor items with precise measurements, allowing users to see how they will look in the real world before making any changes. This feature is particularly useful for those who are looking to redesign a room or space but want to avoid the expense, time, and effort of physically altering it. Our app saves users time and money by eliminating the need for trial and error and multiple visits to furniture and home decor stores. Our interior design application is a user-friendly application that empowers users to make informed design decisions and create their dream space with ease.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Deep Learning Architecture For Accurate Brain Tumor Detection And Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Brain tumors are uncontrollably growing aberrant brain cells that replicate far more quickly than healthy brain cells and do not die according to normal processes, making precise classification essential for efficient treatment planning. The suggested approach makes use of a ReLU-powered U-Net architecture and the advantages of Capsule Networks (CapsNets). Because of this, they can distinguish between minute differences in tumor structure, which is essential for classification. The ReLU-driven U-Net segmentation module accurately locates the tumor location in the MRI image by making use of the quick and efficient ReLU activation function. There are several benefits to this special mix. CapsNets are also renowned for their data efficiency, and by enabling the CapsNet to concentrate on the pertinent tumor location, U-Net segmentation enhances training even more. The suggested deep learning method has a great deal of potential for better clinical decision-making because of its almost perfect accuracy, data efficiency, and quick segmentation capabilities. The 99.2% accuracy beats out conventional techniques, indicating a significant advancement in accurate brain tumor categorization.

articleTitle: Solar Energy based Smart Home Monitoring and Automation using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the pursuit of sustainable living and energy efficiency, integrating renewable energy sources with smart home technologies has become increasingly important. This paper presents a novel system that utilizes solar energy as the primary power source for a smart home, combined with Internet of Things (IoT) technology for monitoring and automation. The primary goal of this project is to reduce waste in conventional ways by making extensive use of energy recovery sources, enhancing safety, and removing environmental impact. Optimizing the equipment's use of program energy in accordance with the actual time of solar power generation is one of the key goals. Another is enhancing the effectiveness of energy transfer through remote monitoring and control using data and smartphone applications. The integration of Internet of Things (IOT) technology with solar energy systems is critical to the sustainability, efficiency, and administration of residential surroundings. This article investigates the deployment capabilities of the Internet of Things (IOT) for solar household energy system automation and monitoring. Future house automation will rely on solar energy and Internet of Things monitoring technologies once this work is completed.

articleTitle: Collision Detection and Evacuation Systems for Enhanced Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: When a car is on the verge of collision, a crucial safety measure will alert the driver and passengers to take action in order to avoid the accident and prevent potential harm. To address scenarios where accidents occur at high speeds, leading to the unconsciousness of the driver and passengers, it becomes impossible for them to manually unlock their seat belts or open the doors. In light of this, we propose a system that automatically unlocks the seat belts and opens the doors after a brief delay of 7-10 seconds once the collision and rollover motion cease. By incorporating such a system, we aim to enhance post-accident safety and rescue operations. The primary objective is to provide a means of escape for the occupants who may have lost consciousness due to the impact. The delayed timing of seat belt unlocking and door opening is strategically designed to ensure that any residual movement or potential hazards from the collision have come to a halt. This helps mitigate the risk of premature release, which could lead to further injuries or complications. The implementation of our proposed system relies on advanced sensors and intelligent algorithms that detect the cessation of collision forces and rollover motion. Once these conditions are met, a signal is initiated to release the door locks. This automated response can significantly aid in the timely extraction of unconscious individuals from the vehicle, enabling emergency responders or nearby individuals to provide necessary medical assistance or facilitate a safe exit. By removing the reliance on conscious action from within the vehicle, our system offers an additional layer of safety in scenarios where occupants are unable to regain control of their faculties promptly. This solution emphasizes the importance of automating critical safety measures to mitigate potential risks and enhance overall passenger well-being during and after collisions.

articleTitle: Drone Based Solar Panel Cleaning System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A drone-assisted solar panel cleaning technology addresses the maintenance challenges of expanding solar infrastructures. By utilizing autonomous drones for efficient and cost-effective cleaning, this solution enhances the performance and longevity of solar panels, particularly in low-income countries, supporting global renewable energy goals and reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

articleTitle: Perishable Innovative Agriculture Hub - An E-Commerce Website Application for Farmers and Consumers Trading Association
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The abstract of a forest fire detection system using deep learning techniques and IoT involves the integration of advanced technologies to address the critical issue of timely and accurate wildfire detection. This innovative approach harnesses the power of deep learning algorithms, specifically designed for image recognition, to analyze visual data captured by surveillance cameras deployed in forested areas. The Internet of Things (IoT) plays a pivotal role in this system by facilitating real-time communication between these cameras and a central monitoring system. The interconnected network enables swift data transmission and analysis, allowing for the rapid identification of potential fire incidents. By leveraging deep learning, the system can distinguish between normal environmental conditions and the presence of smoke or flames, ensuring a low rate of false alarms. This integrated solution not only enhances the efficiency of early fire detection but also aids in prompt response efforts, ultimately contributing to effective forest fire prevention and mitigation strategies.

articleTitle: Traffic Rules Violation Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Around the world, bikers frequently forget to wear helmets, which can result in mishaps and fatalities. The detecting method is laborious and manual. The process will be automated by the suggested solution to address this issue. The technology uses image processing and machine learning methods to find people who are not equipped with helmets. An algorithm is used in the extraction of the license plate: picture collection, preliminary processing, edge detection and segmentation, feature extraction, and character recognition using an correct method.

articleTitle: Real Time Violence Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Hearing about the violent activities that occur on a daily basis around the world is quite overwhelming. Self protection and societal cohesion are significantly endangered by violent conduct. Diverse techniques have been attempted to restrain these activities, including the installation of surveillance systems. The ability of shadowing systems to automatically sense violent activities and issue warnings or alerts would be highly valuable. This system can be materialized through a series of measures. First, the system must spot out the presence of humans in key frames. Then, frames anticipated to have brutal activities are excerpted while extraneous frames are discarded. Finally, a skilled model uncovers brutal behaviour, and corresponding clips are saved individually as images. These images are then enhanced to detect the faces of the people involved, if possible. The enhanced images, along with temporal and positional details, are forwarded as alerts to the concerned authorities. The projected approach ,a deep neural learning-based automatic detection approach using convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to discover violence in videos. However, using only CNNs has the disadvantage of requiring significant computation time and offering lower accuracy. Therefore, a pre-trained model, MobileNetV2, which gives superior accuracy and serves as a base line for the complete model, is utilized. Alerts are sent to the relavant authorities using the cloud based messaging application like Telegram.

articleTitle: Advancing Public Premises Surveillance: A YOLO-Based IoT Camera System with CHATBOT Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Traditional surveillance systems in public spaces rely heavily on 24/7 human monitoring, which can be labourintensive, prone to fatigue, and subject to human error, thereby potentially compromising security effectiveness. This work addresses these limitations by proposing an innovative IoT-based solution utilising the YOLO (You Only Look Once) model for real-time video analysis. The primary objective is to automate and enhance surveillance capabilities through the integration of IoT cameras with edge computing devices equipped with GPU acceleration. This setup enables local processing of video streams, allowing the YOLO model to swiftly and accurately detect various suspicious activities such as loitering, unauthorised access, or other predefined anomalies. Alerts generated by the YOLO model are efficiently communicated via a chatbot interface, facilitating immediate responses from security personnel or automated systems. By reducing the reliance on continuous human monitoring, the system improves operational efficiency and responsiveness to security incidents. It minimises the risk of oversight and delays in detecting critical events, thereby enhancing overall security measures in public premises. The scalability and adaptability of the proposed system make it suitable for deployment in diverse environments, from small-scale installations to large public areas, ensuring comprehensive surveillance coverage and proactive threat detection. This IoT-based approach leveraging advanced video analytics with the YOLO model represents a significant advancement in enhancing security surveillance capabilities. It offers efficient real-time detection, rapid response mechanisms, and scalability, ultimately contributing to safer public spaces and better resource utilisation in security management.

articleTitle: Multi-Purpose Wearable Biofeedback Accessories
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rapid advancement of wearable technology has opened new avenues for monitoring and improving individual health and well-being. In this context, we propose a multi-purpose biofeedback wearable device in the form of a necklace and bracelet, that integrates a variety of sensors with advanced algorithms to monitor and analyse physiological and mental parameters continuously. Designed for comfort and discretion, this device enables seamless, non-intrusive monitoring during daily activities, making it an ideal tool for promoting overall health.The device offers a comprehensive range of functionalities, including stress and anxiety monitoring through heart rate variability and skin conductance measurements, mood regulation, and providing personalised recommendations for songs and yoga, posture correction via motion sensors and posture detection algorithms, and physical performance enhancement with real-time feedback from motion tracking sensors. By delivering real-time insights and personalised interventions, this wearable device is poised to play a pivotal role in managing well-being, regulating mood, enhancing physical performance, and addressing posture-related issues. Incorporating cutting-edge technology with personalised feedback mechanisms, this biofeedback wearable device presents a promising solution for empowering individuals in their pursuit of optimal health and well-being.

articleTitle: Computerized Cognitive Retraining Program For Children With Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This home-based cognitive retraining program is designed to support children with disabilities by improving key cognitive skills such as attention, memory, reasoning, and problem-solving. What makes it unique is the integration of EEG neuro-feedback with at-home exercises, offering a comprehensive approach to cognitive development. Clinicians can track progress through a unified software platform that analyzes both the training data and EEG changes, enabling personalized interventions based on individual responses. The program also incorporates sensory feedback mechanisms like face detection, pressure, and heart rate monitoring to ensure a safe experience. If discomfort is detected, the program automatically pauses, promoting safety and comfort. This multi-sensory approach enhances inclusivity, catering to diverse needs during cognitive retraining. The home-based design offers convenience and allows children to develop cognitive skills in a familiar and comfortable environment. By combining technology, neuroscience, and personalized interventions, this program presents a promising avenue for cognitive rehabilitation, empowering children to actively engage in their development. This innovative approach highlights the potential of technology in improving the quality of life for children with disabilities.

articleTitle: Enhanced Accuracy of Weather Forecasting using Hybrid LSTM and Random Forest Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Due to adjustments in the composition of the environment and temperature swings that affect public fitness, Delhi’s air pollution has emerge as a severe emergency, requiring an instantaneous and clever solution. Our goal is to create a complicated prediction framework in an effort to permit set off interventions. The recommended technique combines Long Short- Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks with Random Forest-based totally getting to know algorithms to provide a dependable hybrid system. The accuracy of air pollution forecasts is greatly expanded by way of this hybrid approach, which combines the ensemble learning strengths of Random Forest with the temporal dependency modeling competencies of LSTM. We behavior an in depth quantitative investigation to affirm the efficacy of our hybrid technique. This entails contrasting its output with separate Random Forest and LSTM models. We use vital signs to assess the models: Square Root of Mean

articleTitle: Smart Wheelchair Based on Voice Recognition for Physically Disabled People
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: An advanced automated system for wheelchairs has been developed to improve the mobility and independence of individuals who have physical disabilities, including those who have been affected by paralysis, polio, or limb loss. The project has been designed to provide a user-friendly experience for people who have limited hand movements, and it incorporates voice recognition technology. The wheelchair system allows for smooth navigation in different directions based on voice commands, and it comes with interactive features to enhance functionality. The main aim of the proposed system is to promote voice recognition and to enable great communication between the user and the device. This means that users can easily access the wheelchair where they want to go within a specific location, such as a bedroom, and it will autonomously navigate to the designated area. The wheelchair system also integrates with the environment by allowing users to operate household fixtures such as fans and lights through voice commands. This interactive functionality is particularly useful for individuals with physical challenges, as it enhances their overall experience by adding a new level of convenience and accessibility. Overall, this innovative wheelchair system describes an advancement in assistive technology, providing a comprehensive solution to address the transportability needs of individuals with physical disabilities. The project makes use of an ESP32 Microcontroller, Voice recognition module, wheelchair mechanism, and Relay board, and it has been successfully implemented to benefit physically disabled individuals who are using the wheelchair.

articleTitle: Challenges and Opportunities for 100% Renewable Energy Grids: Managing Variable Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Having come to rely so heavily on fossil fuels, shifting towards a sustainable future will certainly require that, coming ahead, a 100% renewable energy grid will be extremely promising. First, there is the challenge of integration of variable renewable energy sources like solar and wind. Generation from both solar and wind is varied by weather conditions, unlike traditional power plants, which means that it will cause a mismatch between electricity supply and demand. This variability can destabilize the grid, leading to blackouts and problems in the delivery of reliable power. Thus, basically, these papers deal with the challenges and opportunities regarding handling variable power sources in the high-penetration-renewable-energy future. On the other hand, there is intermittency. At night, solar panels do not produce any energy, and wind farms turn off when it is too calm. This may lead to power shortage and may become a reason for forcing traditional power plants to ramp up or down quickly to balance the generation with demand, which is inefficient as well as destabilizing. The second is the difficulty in very accurate estimation for the available renewable energy, which needs to be factored into grid management decisions. Still, very exciting opportunities lie among these challenges. Together with energy storage solutions such as pumped hydro and advanced batteries, they can contribute to the overlay of variable renewable generation and fluctuating electricity demand. Storage can provide much more stable and reliable power delivery through storing excess capacity during high production periods and disgorgement during periods of peak demand.Our research will be on the new innovative methodologies and control strategies in managing variable sources of power supply in a 100% renewable energy grid. Taking advantage of advanced forecasting methodologies, optimization of the deployment strategy for energy storage.

articleTitle: Cardiomegaly Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research introduces an innovative method for forecasting cardiomegaly, a common heart condition marked by an enlarged heart, by combining deep learning and machine learning methods. Using the ResNet50 architecture, we examine chest X-ray images to identify cardiomegaly indications. At the same time, a Random Forest algorithm analyses clinical data in a table format, such as age, gender, and different cardiac indicators, to improve prediction accuracy. Our approach combines these models to use unstructured images and structured health data, resulting in a comprehensive diagnostic tool. The data, collected from public health databases, was carefully labelled to guarantee accurate training and validation. Preliminary results showed the promising accuracy of the hybrid model, surpassing individual approaches, and demonstrating the potential of integrated models to improve diagnostic capabilities in cardiology. This study helps improve medical imaging and predictive analytics in healthcare, providing a productive solution for early detection and management of cardiomegaly. The results highlight the promise of combining AI models to change diagnostic methods and enhance patient results.

articleTitle: Advanced Grid To Vehicle Integrated Charging Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The growing adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) in the automobile sector is driving up load demand on distribution systems. As EVs increasingly enter the market, Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology is gaining widespread attention. To address rising load demand, charging management must be optimized to reduce charging time and energy consumption, a critical challenge in promoting EVs over conventional vehicles. Meanwhile, traditional internal combustion engine vehicles face significant energy concerns. In contrast, EVs rely on variable power sources, with batteries charged and discharged through bidirectional converters that play a crucial role in EV systems. Analyzing energy consumption patterns is essential to meet load demand. This project explores using stored energy in EVs to supply the grid during peak periods, leveraging next-generation technologies like smart charging and demand response to meet individual, business, and future energy needs. Ultimately, the electric vehicle revolution is transforming the way we consume energy.

articleTitle: Application of Novel Machine Learning Methods in the Analysis of Safety and Efficiency of Stem Cell Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The implementation of ML in basic biomedical research has been instrumental for yielding novel insights into biological processes and confirming multiple biological processes. This trend is gradually being experienced in stem cell research especially in the characterization of stem cells and differentiation processes. As we proceed further, it becomes necessary to use computational approaches to assess the biosafety and bio efficacy of stem cells for clinical applications, mainly with respect to the highly important issue of tumorigenicity in stem cell therapy. Stem cells are very sensitive to the conditions used to initiate tumorigenicity as this is impacted on by many factors not reflected well in conventional laboratories. Furthermore, since tumorigenicity is shaped by numerous factors it is unlikely that there is a single method suitable for evaluation of these risks; such an approach might compromise safety and efficacy of stem cell therapies. As the availability and scopes of biological datasets have grown beyond genomics and expanded to include phenotype and function, together with the recent developments in informatics and artificial intelligence, there is potential for identifying safety and efficacy of stem cell therapies. In this regard, several ML methodologies, and we put forward standardized processes to enable stem cell studies. With regards to area 3, the following is the focus: Our overall principle is to balance the opportunities of these methods for assessing biosafety and bio efficacy risks. The purpose is to build accurate decision support systems to assist clinicians in deriving informed decisions about stem cell treatments that ultimately improve patient care and safety. Using ML, we propose an approach to stem cell therapy to handle enhanced difficulties in risk assessment in clinical contexts.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition using IR sensor camera
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the dynamic field of pattern recognition, there's a notable shift towards human skeleton recognition, particularly in computer vision. Recognizing skeletal gestures presents a challenging task, especially with homogeneous backgrounds adding complexity. Human posture recognition is a crucial aspect within gesture recognition. The rise of low-cost devices like Kinect, along with its Software Development Kit (SDK), offers an opportunity to tackle issues conventional cameras face. This paper explores using Kinect's human skeleton data for posture recognition in a monitoring framework. It investigates six depth distances, each linked to six gesture types derived from human skeletal movements. Results show that Kinect, powered by neural networks, accurately detects six key postures: Start, Stop, Forward, Right, Left, and Normal. This emphasizes the transformative role of neural networks in HCI, revolutionizing gesture recognition for innovative and intuitive interfaces

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Management System for Urban Mobility Enhancement Using RF Sensors, Cameras, and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces a Smart Traffic Management System (STMS)employing RF sensors, cameras, and machine learning algorithms to monitor and optimize urban traffic. The system dynamically adjusts traffic signal timings, offers real-time route recommendations based on GPS data, and incorporates adaptive control mechanisms to reduce congestion and improve overall mobility. Simulation studies and real-world testing demonstrate the effectiveness of the STMS in enhancing traffic flow, minimizing waittimes, and contributing to sustainable urbandevelopment.

articleTitle: Digital ID Card
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In modern educational institutions, smart cards are essential to bring feasibility and portability. The project will focus on developing a digital ID card system that integrates an RFID-based attendance management system with a student prepaid wallet. The RFID attendance system is intended to improve the process of tracking students’ attendance by automating them using radio frequency identification technology thus enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of keeping records of their presence while reducing possible errors in manual operations [1] [2]. On top of maintaining student attendance, this digital ID card will also act as a prepaid wallet allowing pupils to transact within the school campus through credit money hence, they need not carry cash when paying fines for late submissions, and library fees among other campus expenses [3]. It reduces administrative burden and improves the overall student experience by providing an all-inclusive user-friendly solution that supports both monitoring class attendance and making financial transactions in schools. It is worth noting that this single digital ID card encompasses these aspects implying that smart technologies are increasingly being used to simplify and enhance various campus activities.

articleTitle: An Assessment on Cyber Security Challenges and Issues Associated with Cyber-Physical Power System and Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As EVs become more widespread, the automotive industry is rapidly moving away from traditional gasoline-powered cars. This shift has led to a significant increase in the demand for EV charging infrastructure. The integration of electric vehicles (EVs) with power grids introduces intricate cyber-physical interdependencies that may be vulnerable to exploitation by malicious entities, thereby posing potential risks to some part or whole of the power systems. This paper explores the security vulnerabilities related to cyber threats arising from this integrated system and highlights both existing and evolving gaps in the security framework. Mitigating these issues is essential as the worldwide fleet of electric vehicles expands, increasing their influence on the power grid and hence affects the physical power system. The paper seeks to identify the cyber security challenges and issues in physical power system associated with compromised EVCS/EVs. This paper also encourages further research into the cyber-Security of smart EV charging systems and to strengthen the resilience of power system against such cyber threats.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Integrity Monitoring System powered by Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
