abstract: The production and utilization of electricity are key indicators of an economy's size and growth, making electricity theft a factor in slowing economic progress. While a few nations benefit from exporting electricity, most power is generated for domestic use. However, utility providers have been experiencing significant losses, which can be classified into – technical and non-technical losses. Technical losses, inherent to the power grid, have been largely mitigated, but losses still occur due to power dissipation in conductors and other equipment during transmission. Non-technical losses, on the other hand, arise from metering inaccuracies, electricity theft, and unmetered energy usage. Detecting electricity theft is a significant challenge for utility providers. With the expected surge in devices paired and connected to the internet, researchers suggest that the utility sector should leverage this technology to reduce losses. The proposed research aims to develop an architecture capable of detecting illegal activities between the utility server and customer energy meters. The system would allow real-time monitoring over the internet by utility providers.

articleTitle: Effective Approach for Energy Management System Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0, this paper harnesses artificial intelligence to improve energy efficiency across residential, industrial, and commercial environments. The system autonomously manages energy by analyzing real-time sensor data using ensemble algorithms and random forest models. This data is securely transmitted to the cloud, where it trains an AI model to predict the most cost-effective energy scenarios, optimizing the use of grid and microgrid resources. Additionally, the system curtails peak demand in the distribution grid and examines historical data to identify and correct faults, ensuring a reliable energy supply. This AI-driven solution enables real-time load management and strategic energy distribution, resulting in cost savings, enhanced environmental sustainability, and improved system resilience, thereby advancing smarter energy management in modern industries.

articleTitle: NutriGaze: AI-Driven Dietary Planning with OCR and NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: These days diabetes is among the most common diseases all over the globe. As a result, people suffering from diabetes need to change their way of life completely for the sake of their health. The health results may likely be interesting additions to overall wellness in this aspect. In this paper, we investigate the intersection of various software models including NLP and OCR for bettering diabetic dietary management. In this case, all different names given to sugar products in ingredient labels or items are indicated through natural entity recognition models by this application. This deals with two things mainly. First, it uses OCR to read text from the ingredient labels. Second, a custom NER model is advanced that establishes a threshold for the terms related to sugar. That is why the analysis can move faster and even slight occurrences of sugar or its derivatives could be detected through it. It therefore concerns about hard work between computer science and medical disciplines to minimize stress in life of patients suffering from diabetes mellitus globally.

articleTitle: Automated life suits with navigators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent times, Coastal regions face a critical issue as they lack an effective evacuation system for natural disasters. When storms or tsunamis threaten, people in these areas are at risk due to the absence of a well-organized plan. To address this, state officials often must mandate evacuations when a significant danger is predicted, particularly if it arises from the oceans and seas, highlighting the urgent need for a reliable and proactive evacuation and recovery strategy. Our project is a smart life suit with High RPM DC motors that allows the survivor to swim without human efforts. With the motor being activated, the person moves to the desired place. GPS obtains the location coordinates of the survivor and long range communication systems allow the navigators to path towards the survivor. Heart rate measurements are periodically updated by the communication system. This smart life suit project integrates high RPM DC motors, GPS and health monitoring to revolutionize water rescue operations. Addressing limitations of existing solutions, it enhances safety and survival, marking a significant leap in smart wearable technology for aquatic environments, promising to save lives and improve rescue efficiency.

articleTitle: Smart Safe Ride – An Intelligent Rider Safety System for Two-Wheelers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The paper addresses global road safety challenges by integrating innovative features to combat drowsy driving, drunken driving, and inadequate helmet use. By enforcing sobriety, helmet use, and alertness of the rider, this smart helmet substantially reduces the possibilities of accidents. Further, it integrates a speed controlling system depending upon the alertness of the rider and thus assures disciplined driving. This is an innovative solution for the prevention of fatalities and injuries, offering high social impact in riders' protection and enforcement of safety rules. The smart helmet thus serves as a proactive way of minimizing road accidents and loss of life. The idea provides a proactive approach to enhancing road safety and mitigating the impact of key contributors to accidents worldwide.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Predictive Telemarketing: Boosting Campaign Effectiveness in Banking
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Telemarketing, while often perceived as intrusive, remains a potent tool for banks to acquire new customers, cross-sell products, and deepen customer relationships. However, the old-style, unsystematic telemarketing continues to record low response rates and is damaging to a brand image. This is where machine learning comes into play in the picture. The collected customer data blended with the tools of the predictive analysis provide the opportunity to drastically enhance the telemarketing campaign results, focusing on the right customer at the right time with the right products. In this research, the following classification models are employed with the intention of evaluating their predictive accuracy in the context of customer response to telemarketing: XGBoost (XGB), Gradient Boosting (GB), Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). By assessment of classification reports, confusion matrices, and ROC curves, it was concluded that the XGBoost model has the highest accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Gradient boosting also identified good results, but logistic regression gave a more balanced approach though less accurate. As it will be recalled, the decision tree, while considered adequate, was observed to overtrain while K-Nearest Neighbors faced severe problems with misclassification where the minority class was involved. These results also indicate the importance of model selection in addressing the challenges associated with telemarketing data and for making the best strategies for allocating resources for the best performing model, which is XGBoost, when it comes to improving predictive precision and customer targeting in telemarketing.

articleTitle: Solar- Powered Automatic Dispenser
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Solar energy based Automatic Dispenser paper represents an innovation in sustainable energy generation and practical application of harnessing Solar Energy remotely by providing smart Dispensing machines. This is executed through an efficiently designed solar panel, sensing and viewing interface which minimizes reliance on conventional power sources, providing an eco-friendly alternative for a greener infrastructure which is the need of the hour. Integration of avant-garde components such as a precise dispensing mechanism, a real-time camera system for user interaction monitoring, and a sophisticated stock monitoring system utilizing RFID technology, weight sensors which ensures accuracy, security and optimized inventory control. The solar panel is designed for optimal sunlight exposure and maximum energy generation is made out of recyclable materials and a user-friendly interface which enhances the overall experience.

articleTitle: Advancing Underwater Object Identification Using Aerial Hyperspectral Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This This paper proposes a novel approach of Underwater object identification is a critical aspect of marine exploration, environmental monitoring, and underwater resource management. However, traditional methods face challenges such as limited visibility and time-consuming manual processes. This paper proposes an innovative approach to enhance underwater object identification using aerial hyperspectral imaging coupled with artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. Leveraging the advantages of aerial platforms equipped with hyperspectral sensors, this research aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of underwater object detection and classification. The methodology involves data acquisition through aerial platforms, preprocessing of hyperspectral data to enhance quality, and the application of AI algorithms for automated object identification. An experimental study is conducted to evaluate the proposed approach, demonstrating its effectiveness in accurately identifying underwater objects across different environments. The results highlight significant advancements over conventional methods, showcasing the potential of aerial hyperspectral imaging and AI for underwater applications. This research contributes to the advancement of underwater sensing technologies and underscores the importance of integrating aerial platforms and AI for improved underwater object identification.

articleTitle: Prevalence and Early Prediction of Diabetes using an Enhanced Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)

authors.preferredName: Narni V V S Srinivasa Rao

abstract: At present, diabetes is becoming one of the world's leading causes of adult death from any cause. The dangers of diabetes, especially if it is not managed, include an increased possibility of cardiovascular disease, cancer, renal failure, and vision loss. Timely treatment depends on early diagnosis of diabetes since it can halt the disease's progression if caught early enough. The suggested technique has the potential to aid in not just future diabetes prediction but also in identifying the specific form of diabetes that an individual suffers from. With so many variations between type 1 and type 2 diabetes, this approach will aid in ensuring that the patient receives the most effective care possible. Our model is mostly constructed in the deep neural network's hidden layers and employs dropout regularization to prevent overfitting by re-framing the issue as a classification problem. To produce a highly accurate prediction model from a deep neural network, we tweaked a quantity of attributes and employed the binary cross-entropy loss-function. The suggested DLPD (Deep Learning for Predicting Diabetes) model is shown to be effective and adequate in experimental settings. Train accuracy for the diabetes type dataset is as high as 96.3%, while train accuracy for the diabetes data set from Pima Indians is as high as 99.6%. Research on diabetes and diabetic type in Pima Indians has been extensive. The experimental findings validate the dominance of our suggested design contrasted to the current gold standard approaches.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Career Placement Predictor: An Analytical Tool for Optimizing Job Placement Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Students often struggle to understand their standing in terms of job readiness and the steps required to enhance their employability. The system identifies key problems such as inadequate insight into job market demands, lack of personalized career guidance, and the need for targeted skill development. By collecting and analyzing data on academic performance, skills, certifications, and system experiences, the Placement Predictor aims to provide a clearer picture of a student's placement potential. The application offers predictive insights and recommendations, helping students align their qualifications with job market requirements and improve their chances of securing desirable positions. This solution leverages data analytics to bridge the gap between student capabilities and employer expectations, promoting informed decision-making and career advancement.

articleTitle: Smart Delivery Machine with RFID
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This offer presents the design and perpetration of a new Arduino-grounded trolley system able of autonomously navigating to named objects using RFID technology and Bluetooth communication. The core factors of the system include an Arduino microcontroller, an HC-05 Bluetooth module, DC motors for locomotion, an RFID anthology, and a 12V 1.3 A battery for power force. The Arduino serves as the central control unit, orchestrating communication between the colorful tackle factors and executing the necessary algorithms for object discovery, route planning, and motor control. At the heart of the system's functionality lies the integration of RFID technology for object identification. Each object of interest is equipped with an RFID label containing unique identification information. When a stoner selects an object through a smartphone operation connected via Bluetooth, the Arduino receives the corresponding RFID label information and initiates the trolley's movement towards the named object. The communication between the Arduino and the smartphone operation is eased by the HC-05 Bluetooth module

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture for Crop Productive Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The majority of India's GDP comes from farming activities, which accounts for a sizable amount of the country's economy. This initiative was inspired by the increasing number of farmers committing suicide, which may have been brought on by poor agricultural yields. There are several risks to the agriculture industry from climate change and other environmental variables, which makes farming more difficult and uncertain. Using historical data on soil composition, rainfall patterns, temperature fluctuations, and previous agricultural practices, our goal is to create reliable predictive models that can reliably estimate crop yields by utilising machine learning techniques. Furthermore, the rise of e-commerce platforms has made it easier for customers and farmers to conduct direct business, cutting out middlemen and enabling farmers to determine their own prices. Because of this change, farmers now have more control over the products they produce and how they engage with markets, which helps to create a more just and sustainable agricultural ecosystem. Our objective is to incorporate these developments into our prediction models, resulting in a complete solution that helps farmers navigate market dynamics and enhances their standard of living while simultaneously optimising crop yield forecasts.

articleTitle: An Artificially Intelligent Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Developing a Battery Thermal Management System (BMS), a system for controlling and observing battery performance, is the primary goal of this project. A number of hardware elements will be used in this system, such as a DC-to-DC converter, potentiometer, DHT11 sensor, NodeMCU microcontroller, L293D motor driver, DC motor, power supply module, and rechargeable battery. By proactively monitoring and managing many parameters, the BMS seeks to improve the longevity and efficiency of battery-powered devices. The NodeMCU microcontroller functions as the central processing unit, enabling the capture and processing of data in real-time. Through its ability to measure temperature and humidity, the DHT11 sensor makes environmental monitoring possible and offers valuable information about operating conditions that affect battery performance. Comprehensive testing of the BMS is made possible by the L293D motor driver in conjunction with a DC motor to imitate real-world loads. In addition, the presence of a potentiometer provides manual parameter change for the system, providing flexibility in calibration and optimization. By reducing voltage fluctuations and assuring dependable operation, the DC to DC converter guarantees steady power transmission to the system's components. Overall, the combined hardware elements function harmoniously to produce a strong BMS that may improve battery life, increase performance, and maximize energy use in a variety of applications, from renewable energy systems to portable devices.

articleTitle: Climate Prediction Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Accurate environmental projections are essential for well-informed decision-making and efficientpolicy formulation as the effects of climate change become more apparent. In climate modelling, artificial intelligence (AI) has become a potent instrument that opens up new possibilities to improve the accuracy and dependability of climate projections. In order to increase the precision of environmental forecasts, this study investigates the incorporation of AI approaches in climate modelling, with a particular emphasis on machine learning and deep learning algorithms. We go over recent developments in AI-driven climate models and how they can be used to forecast long-term climate trends, temperature swings, and extreme weather. We also go over the difficulties and restrictions associated with using AI in climate science, including things like computational limitations, interpretability of models, and data quality. Examining case studies and current investigations, we highlight the potential of AI to transform climate modeling and provide actionable insights for mitigating the effects of climate change. The findings suggest that AI can significantly enhance our understanding ofcomplex climate systems, paving the way for more robustand adaptive strategies to address environmental challenges.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle – Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The aim of our study is to explore the different functions of drones in flood protection, emphasizing their usefulness for rescue operations and technical assistance in flood-affected areas. We show how drones can be used for aerial surveillance, recording and sharing high-speed video to determine the extent of flooding and identify potentially stranded people. Drones can enhance search and rescue operations in hard-to-reach or low-visibility locations by using thermal imaging and high-resolution cameras to detect the heat signature of human bodies. Drones can also create makeshift communication networks in places where no conventional infrastructure is available. This makes it easier for emergency services to coordinate effectively and pass on important information. After floods, drones are invaluable for assessing damage to infrastructure and enabling detailed inspections needed for repair and reconstruction efforts. They also deliver essential relief supplies to inaccessible areas, ensuring timely assistance to the affected population. Our research highlights these capabilities and demonstrates how drones can significantly improve the efficiency and effectiveness of flood management, ultimately improving community resilience and disaster response.

articleTitle: Automated Exoskeleton Prosthetic Suit With Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Automated Exoskeleton Prosthetic Suit with Monitoring System aims to develop a fully functional prosthetic suit with coordinated strength and response time. The suit is ameliorative and can be worn or removed as needed. Designed as a wearable inner suit, it operates autonomously, incorporating sensors and navigation systems to reduce inequality. In regions where the suit is worn, it analyzes blood flow using ultrasound Doppler principles and aids in improving circulation. The exoskeletons support or replace impaired body parts, allowing users to function properly. Electrical motors and precise position control form the core of its most common design. This suit explores the entire body using various actuators, tasks, and degrees of freedom. The product can be worn as an inner suit, featuring an autonomous sensor and navigation system to eliminate inequality. It measures blood flow in the regions covered by the suit, enhancing circulation. The primary goal of the product is to detect even small objects and prevent the wearer from falling.

articleTitle: Graphibabot-An Aiding Device for Dysgraphia
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: According to data from Indian Paediatrics,the prevalence of dyslexia, dysgraphia, and dyscalculia in Indian primary school students ranges from 2% to 18%, 14%, and 5.5%, respectively. Individuals with dysgraphia encounter difficulties with handwriting, typing, and spelling.They might have trouble with things like composition, grammar, writing speed, letter size and spacing, and letter formation. Our project addresses the challenge of dysgraphia in children by developing an assistive device that includes a display with software and a pen. This device helps children improve their writing skills by ensuring they write specific alphabets correctly on paper. It provides comprehensive analysis and improvement graphs of the child's writing, facilitating gradual enhancement without requiring constant parental assistance. This innovative solution aims to aid children with dysgraphia and similar writing difficulties, offering a practical alternative solution by designing the smart pen and software application which is attractive to kids with customisation of cartoons according to the kid’s interest replacing the existing therapies.

articleTitle: GREEN HARVEST: Using Machine Learning and Optimization Techniques to Predict Market Prices and the Ideal Crop Yield
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Over 50% of India's population is employed in agriculture, which is vital to the country's economy but confronts enormous hurdles from environmental variability. This study reviews machine learning approaches to improve crop yield prediction (CYP) and agricultural decision-making in general, with a focus on Random Forest algorithms and optimisation techniques. We tackle the drawbacks of conventional techniques, namely lower prediction accuracy and challenges in capturing intricate nonlinear interactions. A wide range of functions are integrated into the suggested system, such as real-time weather forecasting, crop disease detection by picture recognition, soil health analysis, and crop yield prediction based on weather and soil data. In addition, it provides tools for farm management, market price analysis, individualized irrigation management, and a decision support system for customized advice. Extra features consist of Community Forums for information exchange, data visualization for improved understanding, alerts for important occurrences, advice on crop selection, and tools for supply chain management. This project attempts to develop a more accurate, effective, and user-friendly model to assist farmers in controlling agricultural operations and maximizing crop yields by utilizing cutting-edge machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Enhanced Autism Detection Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research presents a pioneering framework for the identification of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). It employs deep learning methodologies to consolidate various datasets, which include behavioral, neuroimaging, and genetic data.. This innovative model ensures a comprehensive understanding of ASD by autonomously identifying intricate patterns, facilitated by advanced preprocessing techniques ensuring data normalization. Results indicate a remarkable accuracy in identifying individuals with ASD, accentuated by attention mechanisms that enhance interpretability. This study represents a substantial advancement in the field, enhancing the diagnostic processes for autism and establishing a groundwork for future innovations in the use of deep learning to address neurodevelopmental disorders. The study's focused approach involves the collection of facial images from both healthy and potentially autistic children. In the realm of feature extraction, deep learning models, pre-trained on extensive datasets, diligently extract significant facial features, offering a nuanced understanding of ASD-associated expressions. Model training follows, employing diverse classifiers such as Support Random Forest Classifier (RFC), and Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) to construct predictive models. The subsequent evaluation, guided by accuracy metrics, reveals Logistic Regression's noteworthy superiority in ASD prediction.

articleTitle: Border Alerting System using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Maritime activities, especially fishing, pose inherent risks to the safety and security of fishermen, vessels and coastal regions. To address these challenges, this paper proposes the development and implementation of a border warning system tailored specifically for fishermen that uses Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The system aims to increase the safety and security of fishing operations by providing real-time monitoring, warning and response capabilities. Through an IoT-enabled framework, various sensors and devices installed on board fishing vessels collect and transmit data related to the vessel's position, environmental conditions and operational parameters to a centralized monitoring station. Advanced analytical algorithms process this data to detect potential risks such as collisions, adverse weather conditions or unauthorized entry of vessels into restricted areas. In the event of a critical situation, the system generates alerts and informs the relevant authorities, which enables timely intervention and assistance. This article discusses the concept, design principles and technical components of the proposed border warning system. It also examines potential challenges, including technology integration, privacy and compliance, and suggests mitigation strategies. By improving situational awareness and response capabilities, this IoT-based border warning system holds the promise of improving maritime safety for fishermen and coastal communities, ultimately contributing to a sustainable and safe marine environment.

articleTitle: A Multimodal Diagnostic Framework for Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Deep Learning: An In-Depth Exploration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) represents a multifaceted neurodevelopmental condition, characterised by persistent and pervasive challenges in social communication, behavioural patterns, and sensory processing. The early and accurate diagnosis of ASD is imperative for timely intervention and support. This case study delineates a sophisticated deep learning-based multimodal diagnostic framework designed to augment the detection and analysis of ASD. By amalgamating various data modalities—encompassing neuro imaging, facial expressions, and speech patterns—this framework harnesses the capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) to enhance diagnostic precision. Furthermore, we delve into the intricacies of the challenges encountered, the preprocessing methodologies employed, and the comparative performance of the model vis-à-vis traditional diagnostic approaches.

articleTitle: Advanced Analytics for Proactive Cybersecurity Breach Prediction and Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As technology advances, so do the potential risks and security threats associated with it. It’s crucial to prioritize and invest in cybersecurity measures to safeguard these advancements. Balancing innovation with robust security measures is essential for staying proactive and implementing security protocols by this we can mitigate the risks and ensure a safer digital future. This project focuses on the development of a predictive model for cyber-attack detection on servers. Leveraging advanced analytics and machine learning techniques, the system aims to proactively identify potential security breaches before they manifest. This involves the analysis of server logs, network traffic, and anomaly behaviour to create a robust predictive model. Various types of Cyberattacks which include DDOS, PROBE, U2R, and R2L attacks. In this, we use the RNN algorithm for classification and training in order to improve the efficiency of IDS detection.

articleTitle: Smart Brain Controlled Prosthetic Arm Using hybrid Binary PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Brain Computer Interface (BCI) is a new way to communicate between the human brain and a digital computer. Genetic algorithm (GA) based Binary PSO is assisted in the operation of a prosthetic arm with a brain-computer interface that includes a virtual reality system and an electroencephalogram (EEG) is utilized in the paper. MATLAB is utilized with Visual Basic Arduino microcontroller in this paper. It provides a substitute for inborn control and communication. It is an artificial system that eschews the neuromuscular output channels, the body’s normally efficient conduits. One affordable prosthetic that may be installed on the head is the Arduino Prosthesis, a BCI device. Mind waves, or more accurately, the mind’s capacity for concentration and focus, govern the prosthetic arm. This is achieved by wearing a cheap EEG reader on the head, similar to a headband-equipped pair of headphones. This external device is much less expensive. Furthermore, the motors of some of the priciest prosthetics need to be controlled by micro electric impulses.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Approach for Traffic Sign Recognition Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Optical Character Recognition system translates scanned images of printed or handwritten text into audio output, using a Raspberry Pi, hence lies in the broader field of computer vision and a subfield of Artificial Intelligence. OCR systems for many global languages are already being used successfully. A Gaussian-based background subtraction technique is used to separate object regions. The system performs recognition and text localization in order to acquire text information. A combination of text localization techniques and the Tesseract algorithm, which utilizes edge pixel distribution, stroke orientation, and gradient feature learning in an AdaBoost model, enables automatic localization of text regions within an object. Once the localized text characters are binarized , they can be identified by common OCR software, particularly Tesseract. For visually impaired users, the text that has been identified is subsequently translated to speech. Noted is the effectiveness of the suggested text localization algorithm. After the recognition process is over on the Raspberry Pi, character codes from text files are further processed using Python programming and a Tesseract algorithm to give audio output.

articleTitle: Utilizing Lora For Real Time Traffic Signal Control In Ambulance Dispatch Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A novel approach to urban management for emergency vehicles through the integration of Lora SX1278 wireless communication and adaptive traffic signal control. The proposed system would speed up the movement of ambulances, reduce response time, and improve public safety by detecting an approaching ambulance up to a distance of 1 km in advance by dynamically changing the traffic signals. Long-range communication and adaptive glass panels can make the system intercommunicate seamlessly between ambulances and traffic infrastructure and allow the real-time adjustment of traffic signals. Simulations in the field and case studies prove there are vast improvements in the passage of emergency vehicles, traffic flow efficiency, and, therefore, in urban safety.

articleTitle: Adaptive SMC for modified three phase bridgeless Vienna rectifier for Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents the three phase modified bridgeless Vienna rectifier for electric vehicle (EV) charger. This topology has significant impact on power quality improvement such as power factor improvement. The modified topology is more advantageous in automotive industry. The EV charger developed using this technique is compact and economical. The DC bus voltage controlled in the designed Vienna rectifier is achieved through adaptive sliding mode controller (SMC) controller. The adaptive SMC controller is designed by incorporating the characteristics of internal model controller (IMC). This DC voltage control enables the control on charging of EV and battery. This adaptive SMC controller enhances the sinusoidal tracking performance and also reduces the steady state error. The proposed adaptive SMC controller also ensures the stability of the system. The proposed system is verified in simulation and the results are validated through comparison with SMC controller. The results are validated through power factor improvement in modified SMC.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Approach in Microgrids with Electric Vehicles and Renewable Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With the augmented level of infiltration of electric vehicles and renewable sources in microgrids (MGs), the frequency control is a challenging task. This is due to the variable nature of renewable sources as well as load power causing power imbalance. In future, electric vehicles will be extensively used. To overcome frequency control problems, a control scheme for tuning of the (I, PI, PID) controller’s gains for power control of EVs has been projected by means of Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) technique for studied MG. The idea is to control the MG frequency in presence of solar energy and a diesel generator under arbitrary load changes. The results demonstrate that the recommended PID control scheme has an improved frequency regulation capability related to PI and I based control strategy.

articleTitle: Prognosis of Brain Stroke Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Brain stroke is a medical emergency and one of the major causes of death worldwide. This primarily occur to aged people and the persons with unhealthy habits. Predicting stroke before they occur would greatly help in saving many lives. Healthcare is an industry where new innovations happen daily. The biggest outbreak occurred in healthcare industry is the incorporation of Machine Learning in it. Machine Learning, an advanced technology which uses algorithms, statistics, probability and many more for learning data to make predictions. In a human body brain is a sensitive and complex organ which controls every action in the body. It receives blood through nerves. Brain stroke can be defined as the blood vessel rupture or blockages which prevents the brain from getting oxygen supply. This leads to paralysis, numbness, vision blockage and even death. Major factors leading to brain stroke are unhealthy habits like smoking, alcohol consumptions etc. Medical conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure is also one of the major factors. The research mainly aims in building a ML model which predicts brain stroke before it occurs. A ML model has been trained which actively predicts the chance of stroke occurrence by getting attributes like diabetes value, blood pressure value etc. This model is integrated with a user interactive website where the values are entered manually to predict the possibility of the stroke

articleTitle: Optimizing Convolutional Neural Networks for Dermatological Disease Detection Using Ensemble Learning on Edge AI Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Access to dermatological care is a significant challenge in rural regions, where specialized services are scarce, wait times are long, and awareness is low. This aiding device aims to address these gaps by providing an accessible solution for detecting, diagnosing, and consulting on skin diseases. Using a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B with a camera module and LCD display, the system captures and displays images for analysis. Its core diagnostic capability is powered by a Weighted Average Ensemble Model, which combines three convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with 4, 5, and 6 layers, respectively. The model achieves an AUC of 0.98 in ROC Curve analysis, reflecting high accuracy with minimal false positives. During training, the model reached 99.4% accuracy, with a validation accuracy of 94.25%. Despite encountering loss increases of 60.9% and 79% during training and validation, the model remained effective, with an F1 score of 94.1%. This device is designed to reduce healthcare disparities and improve dermatology care in underserved rural areas.

articleTitle: Industry-Specific IoT-Based Air Pollution Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The main objective of the project is to nurture the Environment and Human Health thereby minimizing the release of Air pollutants by monitoring the Atmospheric Content Composition through a Sensor-Integrated-IoT Model collaborated with a Web Application. Through this, precautions could have been taken in order to avoid the unnecessary release of pollutants near & around the Industries Areas. By this Human & Environment Conditions are nourished, being Sustainable for Future Generations. As our Project Focus on SDG Goal of Climate action Under the Target of Integrating Climate Changes into Policies, Measures and Strategies. We also review existing system and categorized them based on deployment strategy employed. As an enhancement, we developing A-IoT model which helps in predicting the emission rate through the processing of collected data-sets. Finally, challenges involved in building such systems are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Smart SOS Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Women's safety is at risk in today's environment. The number of crimes against women is concerningly increasing rather than decreasing; the most frequent categories are rape, kidnapping, harassment, molestation, eve-teasing, and domestic abuse. Although the government has put in place a number of preventative measures to stop these misbehaviors, the rising crime rate has not been affected by them. Women are not as physically fit as men are, so in times of need, a helping hand would be very helpful. The gadget for this project is an ATMEGA328P, together with GPS, GSM, and a pressure sensor. Although there were some discrepancies between the position that was received and the actual position, the GPS device was able to gather location data with a respectable degree of precision. This apparatus sends the control room the database, which includes the name, Aadhar number, and residential area.

articleTitle: Portable Medicare Module for Automobile
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In an era where road safety is paramount, addressing driver health and alertness is crucial to reducing accidents. Current systems often fall short in real-time monitoring of drivers' physical and emotional states, leading to preventable incidents. The increasing demand for enhanced safety measures in vehicles highlights the need for innovative solutions that can provide continuous health and drowsiness monitoring, as well as emergency response capabilities. This project, an embedded system utilizing AI/ML technologies, aims to fill this gap by offering a comprehensive approach to driver safety. By integrating real-time health monitoring and emotion detection, the system ensures that drivers receive timely alerts and assistance, significantly reducing the risk of accidents and improving overall road safety. The implementation of such advanced monitoring systems in automobiles is not just a technological advancement but a necessary step towards safer roads and enhanced driver well-being.

articleTitle: Effective Farming for Zero Wastage and Enhancement of Farmer’s Income
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the field of agriculture, reducing waste while increasing revenue is still a difficult task. However, this initiative tackles this problem head-on by integrating Internet of Things (IoT) Sensors with Machine Learning (ML). By harnessing the power of IoT sensors to gather real-time data on soil moisture, humidity, temperature, and weather conditions, coupled with ML algorithms analyzing past agricultural crop harvested data, market demand, pricing trends, and previous wastage records, the project paves the way for predictive farming. This proactive approach enables farmers to make informed decisions regarding crop selection, planning times, and investment strategies, ultimately leading to minimised wastage and enhanced profitability. Furthermore, the development of a user-friendly mobile application serves as a central hub for disseminating valuable insights to farmers. Through intuitive interfaces and comprehensive data visualization, the application provides farmers with detailed information on investment projections, recommended crops for cultivation, and optimal planting schedules. Moreover, by incorporating Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities, the application ensures accessibility for farmers of diverse linguistic backgrounds, facilitating seamless interaction and decision-making. By empowering farmers with actionable information and accessible tools, the project aims to revolutionize agricultural practices, driving towards a future of sustainable farming and increased profitability.

articleTitle: Poultry Diseases Diagnostics using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Common poultry diseases including coccidiosis, salmonella, and newton can reduce chicken output if they are not caught in time. Due to poultry producers' restricted admittance to agricultural sustain services, many illnesses are not identified early in Tanzania. The probable for early identification of many poultry diseases exists with deep learning techniques. Through the classification of healthy and harmful faecal pictures, a deep convolutional-neural-network (CNN) was created in this study to identify poultry diseases. Unhealthy faecal pictures could be a sign of Newcastle, Salmonella, or Coccidiosis. In order to annotate the 1,255 laboratory-labeled faecal photos, we also collected faecal samples utilised in Polymerase Chain Reaction diagnosis. Using an Open Data Kit, we captured 6,812 images of chicken faces. The farm-labeled faecal pictures were annotated by specialists in agricultural support. Then, we applied the VGG16, InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and Xception models, as well as a baseline CNN model. We developed models utilising tagged faecal pictures from farms and laboratories. Farm-labeled photos were utilised for the test set. The test accuracy scores for the baseline CNN, VGG16, InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and Xception were 83.06%, 85.85%, 94.79%, 87.46%, and 88.27%, respectively. InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, and Xception all achieved model accuracy values of 95.01%, 95.45%, 98.02%, and 98.24%, respectively, after fine-tuning while glacial the batch normalization layer, with F1-scores for all classifiers over 76% in each of the four classes. We advise using this model to detect chicken diseases early on farms because to the trained MobileNetV2’s smaller weight and higher ability to generalize.

articleTitle: Conveyor Belt Breakdown Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Conveyor belts are the essential components in majority of the industries, facilitating the efficient movement of coal and minerals from one location to another. Unfortunately, over time, these conveyor belts may become damaged or develop cracks, leading to frequent stoppages and associated losses. To solve these issues, this paper present an innovative solution that leverages modern technologies. The approach involves the integration of an ESP32 camera system for early crack detection. By continuously monitoring the conveyor belt’s surface, the camera captures critical factors related to wear, tear, and potential damage. Machine learning algorithms analyze these images, identifying any signs of cracks. Additionally, harness the speed variation of the conveyor belt itself. This real-time data and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) system, allowing to track the belt’s performance and health. The proactive nature of our approach is twofold First, it enables early detection of cracks, preventing minor issues Second, by minimizing downtime due to unexpected belt damage, we enhance overall reliability and efficiency in mine production processes.

articleTitle: EV Wireless Charging Empowered By Solar Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The growing demand for sustainable and efficient electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions has led to the exploration of innovative technologies, including wireless charging systems empowered by renewable energy sources. This project focuses on the design and development of a solar-powered wireless charging system for electric vehicles. The system harnesses solar energy through Solar panels, converting the generated DC electricity into AC using an inverter. The AC output is then fed into a transformer, if necessary, to adjust the voltage level before being transmitted through a Transmitter coil embedded beneath the road surface. As the EV passes over the Transmitter coil, a Receiver coil, mounted on the underside of the vehicle, captures the magnetic field generated by the Transmitter coil through electromagnetic induction. This induced AC current in the Receiver coil is then rectified to DC using a rectifier circuit, allowing the energy to be efficiently stored in the vehicle’s battery. This innovative approach not only eliminates the need for physical charging connections but also leverages renewable solar energy, contributing to the reduction of carbon emissions and enhancing the convenience of EV charging. The project addresses key challenges such as optimizing wireless power transfer efficiency, ensuring the safety of electromagnetic fields, and complying with relevant regulations. Through this system, we aim to provide a scalable, environmentally friendly solution that supports the broader adoption of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: An Impact of Artificial Intelligence in Fintech
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Technological advancements in the last decade have greatly impacted the financial technology (fintech) industry by making financial services more accessible, efficient, and personalized. Out of all these innovations, artificial intelligence (AI) is having the most impact on how the industry is changing. AI is truly a game-changer for the financial sector. It can handle massive volumes of data, spot trends, and make choices with little to no human input. This article examines the function of artificial intelligence (AI) within the financial technology industry, outlining its uses in areas such as algorithmic trading, customer service, credit scoring, lending, investment management, and fraud prevention. It outlines the advantages of AI, which include better risk management, enhanced decision-making, a more satisfying customer experience, and reduced costs and increased efficiency. Data privacy and security, ethical issues, keeping up with regulations, and technical and operational dangers are just few of the issues covered in the article as they pertain to the integration of AI. To demonstrate the revolutionary effect of AI, the article presents case studies of prominent AI deployments in fintech firms. The report concludes by looking ahead to what's to come, speculating that new AI technologies will keep pushing the financial technology industry to innovate. Future financial services will be shaped in new ways by the constant evolution and integration of AI into fintech.

articleTitle: Methodology to Maximize the Output Voltage Harvested from Thermoelectric Generator by Using Luo Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this technical epoch we are dealing with sensible issues such as global warming, pollution, depletion of available resources, increase in power cost etc. Researchers are focusing to reduce the effects due to sensible issues in present time by looking out for neoteric energy harvesters, that is power generators. A physical phenomenon that converts heat energy into electrical energy is thermoelectric effect. Thermal energy is transformed into electrical energy by thermoelectric generators (TEGs) using the Seebeck effect. Energy harvested from TEG have no moving parts, can be integrated on other devices, produces no noise, can be positioned anywhere that is position independent. The operating life time is also high and has no maintenance. TEG can harness energy for 1-2K thermal discrepancy in the environment. Using any wearable application in the body thermo electric generator can forge power in microwatts and voltage in mv. TEG has low conversion efficiency that it produces voltage in millivolt. To mold this trifling amount of voltage to some electrical appliances mv is boosted using LUO converter. Luo-converters boosts the voltage in geometric progression fed from the thermoelectric generator. Thermoelectric generator fed Luo converter is controlled by PID controller to proliferate output volt-age at the LUO converter side. Thus, TEG has raised as emerging green technology to power devices. This paper discusses about TEG application for charging devices.

articleTitle: Automated Glioma Detection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study proposes an innovative approach for early glioma detection using advanced imaging and machine learning. enhanced by preprocessing. A trained machine learning model, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), demonstrates high sensitivity and specificity, surpassing traditional methods in accuracy. The system differentiates glioma subtypes and holds promise for transforming clinical practices by providing a powerful tool for improved diagnosis and personalized treatment planning. Validation on diverse datasets underscores its generalizability and robustness, highlighting the potential for early and accurate glioma detection.

articleTitle: Autonomous Drone-Based Fire Detection and Suppression Using YOLOv8 and 2D Blueprint Mapping for Industrial Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Lately, spotting and controlling fires quickly has become more vital than ever to limit damage and save lives. Traditional methods often suffer from delayed response times and limited coverage, making them less effective in preventing the escalation of fires. In this paper, we focus on developing and implementing an autonomous drone system that enhances the efficiency of fire detection and firefighting efforts. The system integrates advanced machine learning techniques with live CCTV camera feeds to detect the presence of fire accurately. Upon detection, the system pinpoints the precise location of the fire and autonomously navigates a drone equipped with fire extinguishing tools, such as the AFO (Auto Fire Off) ball, to the affected area. Our proposed solution leverages a convolutional neural network (CNN) to process real-time video footage and accurately identify fire. The drone’s navigation system employs a combination of GPS and computer vision to traverse the environment and reach the fire site quickly and efficiently. Integrating these technologies ensures a rapid and reliable response to fire incidents. This study explores the design, implementation, and testing the autonomous drone platform, highlighting the challenges encountered and the solutions developed to address them. The findings suggest that integrating machine learning and autonomous navigation in fire response systems can lead to more effective and timely interventions, ultimately reducing the impact of fires on communities and infrastructure.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Internal Fault Detector for Cables and Wires
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project uses an Arduino microcontroller to find and locate internal cable line faults. In many environments, electrical cables are buried rather than overhead, making it difficult to locate faults when they occur. The proposed system aims to accurately identify the location of these faults by utilizing an Arduino and relay.Faults are simulated using a series of switches, with relays being managed by a relay driver. The system displays the fault location in kilometers from the central station on a 16x2 LCD screen connected to the microcontroller. When a fault occurs, voltage changes across a set of resistors are converted into digital data via an ADC . The Arduino processes this data to determine and display the distance to the fault.

articleTitle: Optimizing Safety Messaging in Cognitive Radio VANETs with Smart Message Sorting and Spectrum sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) are infrastructure networks composed of stationary or mobile vehicles that are wirelessly connected. These vehicles engage in the exchange of vital data pertaining to road construction, traffic conditions and accidents. In order to efficiently classified and rank these messages, an obsolete algorithm known as the Message Categorization and Ranking Algorithm (MC-RA) is devised. In order to effectively manage distinct message categories, the proposed algorithm creates three separate queues: one designated for emergency messages, one for messages pertaining to traffic, and a third for commercial messages. By applying this model, non-priority messages are treated fairly and are processed in the sequence in which they were received, thus enhancing the structure and predictability of the message management system. Constantly adjusting priorities, the MC-RA algorithm continuously monitors messages with allotted indices of 1, 2, and 3. Even in congested networks, this method ensures the timely transmission of critical messages. Moreover, the integration of fuzzy logic permits the management of ambiguous and uncertain data, including fluctuating signal strengths and interference levels, thereby enhancing the system's capacity for sound decision-making.

articleTitle: Unmanned Coconut Tree Climbing Machine with Improved Gripping Using Gecko Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Climbing coconut trees is a physically demanding and hazardous task, traditionally performed by skilled workers who rely solely on their hands and feet, often without any safety gear. This manual approach not only endangers the climbers but also limits the efficiency of coconut harvesting. To address these issues, this work introduces a conceptual design for a coconut tree climbing system that leverages a linear actuator mechanism to improve safety and productivity. The proposed system features a lightweight, portable frame equipped with a linear actuator that extends and retracts a specialized attachment designed to securely grip the tree trunk. The system operates on two primary mechanisms: gripping and climbing. The gripping mechanism is improved by using gecko technology. The Van der Waals force, which is applied between the sticky surface and the micro-synthetic gecko, allows the synthetic gecko foot hair to perform its adhesive function. The use of a linear actuator mechanism in the climber enhances safety, boosts harvesting efficiency, and reduces labor costs. Its portability and ease of use make it suitable for deployment across various coconut plantations. This technology is especially useful in places where manual climbing methods are still practiced and coconut farming is prevalent. The device allows remote operation by a person stationed on the ground. In this paper, we design a low-cost coconut tree climbing prototype and use MATLAB Simulink to evaluate its performance.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring System By Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study provides a thorough description of a unique Internet of Things-based health monitoring system designed to continuously collect, analyze, and interpret vital health data in real-time. Leveraging a network of interconnected sensors, wearable devices, and mobile applications, the proposed system offers seamless monitoring of key. physiological variables, including blood pressure, temperature, heart rate, and degree of activity Through intelligent data processing algorithms and cloud-based analytics, healthcare professionals gain timely insights into patients' health status, enabling proactive interventions and personalized healthcare recommendations. Furthermore, the system gives users the ability to actively manage their health by giving them access to customized health dashboards and facilitating remote consultations with healthcare providers. By fostering continuous monitoring, early detection of health anomalies, and proactive intervention, This Internet of Things-enabled health monitoring system has the power to transform the way that healthcare is provided while also lowering costs and enhancing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Control for Efficient Operation of Fuel Cell-Powered Buck Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research provides a fuzzy logic-based fuel cell stack-powered buck converter control system. Fuel cell output is unpredictable and nonlinear, necessitating a control strategy that can adjust to shifting circumstances and keep the output voltage steady. Using a rule-based methodology, the suggested fuzzy logic controller (FLC) handles the variation in inaccuracy as well as the discrepancy between the desired and actual output voltage. Because the FLC is not dependent on a precise mathematical model like other controllers are, it can adjust to the intricacies of fuel cell dynamics. The FLC provides higher overall efficiency, fast response to load fluctuations, and improved voltage stability, as shown by simulation and experimental findings. This methodology offers a resilient and flexible resolution for power conversion in fuel cell systems, guaranteeing peak efficiency and prolonging the fuel cell’s operational life.

articleTitle: Effective Sentitrash System for Urban and Rural Environments Using IoT and ML Technology- : A comprehensive solution integrating multiple sensors with ESP32 and Arduino platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Due to the daily increase of garbage, we regularly see trash bins overflowing in public areas these days. For that the solution is concluded by using the embedded devices at a cheap price which tracks this issue. The main objective is to develop an innovative solution through alert systems by sending notification to the server. This utilises IoT technology to improve waste collection efficiency. The sensors (ultrasonic, gas, rain) monitor waste level in bins, rain and odour detection enabled with the real-time monitoring using Arduino UNO. In the evolving era of urban development waste management presents an advanced solution to enhance the waste collection process through an implementation of LED visuals in IoT domain and in addition to that interfacing machine learning for an ease of segregating wastes by using inter-connecting sensors and controllers, the system provides a real-time data. This innovative system provides the potential of IoT (internet of things) in addressing complex challenges and promoting sustainable development of the urban community.

articleTitle: Blackbox: Enhanced Road Safety and Vehicle Data Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The accident investigation process takes a significant amount of time to close the case and the vehicle parameters are not continuously logged in the existing method. There is no evidence available for accident cases. This approach involves recording of accident information for a vehicle involves the real-time storage of picture data captured by a camera during the act of driving. Currently, an ongoing investigation is being conducted on a vehicle black box that captures driving data, namely vehicle speed, with the aim of acquiring information regarding the circumstances surrounding a car crash and identifying any problems within the involved parties. The vehicle accident data recording apparatus has garnered significant interest in recent times. This apparatus utilizes a camera mounted in the vehicle to capture image data of external factors during accidents. By analyzing pre- and post-accident external image data, as well as driving data, the apparatus aims to determine the underlying cause of the accident. The occurrence of a vehicular accident refers to an unforeseen incident that has the potential to result in harm to either the vehicle's structure or an occupant. In this proposed method, STM32 microcontroller is used to interface with the sensors and to the communication devices. The crash sensor, temperature sensor, and gas detection sensor are employed to acquire data pertaining to the main three kinds of road accidents. The SD card module and IoT module is utilized for data storage locally and globally. The I2C LCD module is used to connect the LCD using ONEWIRE protocol. The LCD is used to update the latest sensor and communication information. The GPS device is utilized to obtain accurate location of the vehicle. The GSM is used to send the accident information to the police or respective personal care takers.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Traffic Solutions for Preventing and Detecting Incidents for Safer Roads
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The demand for creative solutions to handle traffic incidents and speed up emergency response times is higher than ever at a time when road safety is of the utmost importance. Conventional traffic control systems frequently rely on manual reporting, which causes inefficiencies and delays that can worsen traffic risks and jeopardize safety. To close this gap, we suggest a real-time system that combines cameras, sensors, and artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to transform traffic incident detection and response. This state-of-the-art system instantly notifies emergency services of traffic events in real-time, automating the process of improving road safety and streamlining emergency response procedures. Through the elimination of human reporting delays, this technology fixes existing inefficiencies and enhances traffic management as a whole. The technology foundation consists of smartphone applications for real-time updates, AI-driven incident detection, continuous monitoring, and linked car technologies. To reduce dangers related to driver weariness and stress and to provide early warnings, this system also includes driver stress level detection using computer vision. In the end, this system hopes to establish a new benchmark for proactive incident avoidance and traffic management, encouraging safer driving behaviors and more effective emergency response.

articleTitle: Distributed Machine Learning Based Intrusion Detection in IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: IoT systems face significant security challenges due to their extensive attack surfaces and limited resources. To effectively counter these threats in real- time, intrusion detection algorithms must be both energy-efficient and compatible with the constrained computational capabilities of IoT devices (including memory, CPU, and storage). While deep learning approaches have proven effective for intrusion detection, their high computational demands make them impractical for resource-limited IoT devices. In this study, we propose developing a hierarchical model for IoT intrusion detection. This model will deploy machine learning (ML) algorithms tailored to the capabilities of IoT devices, while offloading more complex processing tasks to more powerful edge or cloud-based systems. These advanced systems will handle tasks such as updating ML model parameters and executing detection algorithms that exceed the capabilities of the IoT devices. Additionally, our approach will address not only traditional network attacks but also IoT-specific threats related to protocols such as REST, Zigbee, and MQTT.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Consumption with Theft Detection and load Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The novel system presents a viable approach to sustainable energy management by tackling the pressing issues of energy theft and the impending energy crisis. Fundamentally, in order to identify and stop energy theft, the system integrates sophisticated sensors with Arduino UNO (ATMEGA328P) and ESP8266 modules. Together, the Arduino UNO and ESP8266 modules enable real-time energy consumption monitoring.These modules, which come with voltage and current sensors, guarantee precise identification of irregularities or questionable activity in the power system. Users can see theft voltage and detection status instantly thanks to real-time data that is sent to an LCD display. Additionally, the system integrates with the Gmail and Blynk apps to take preventative measures, making sure users receive immediate alerts when theft is detected, allowing for quick action to protect energy resources. This system's cost-efficiency, which is attained by lowering the requirement for human intervention in power maintenance, is one of its main advantages. The system reduces the need for manual monitoring by automating detection and notification procedures, which enables more efficient resource allocation and cost savings.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis and Performance Comparison of Anti-Lock Braking Controllers: Mechanisms, Variants, and Simulation Results
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This anti-lock braking system (ABS) can identify when a wheel locks up and modify the brake pressure to avert it. The primary goal of control is to apply the appropriate rotational force towards in achieving the wheel slip rate possible. There would exist an inherent correlation between this slip rate and the speed of the rotation of the wheels and the vehicle’s linear velocity. This paper offers an analysis that (ABS), including a detailed look at its mechanism and the different types of controllers that have been developed. It explores the fundamental principles, operational aspects, key components, advantages, and limitations associated with ABS. The controllers used in ABS are categorized into several types, including control types, which include PID, PD, ON-OFF (Bang-Bang), EBFD, and Fuzzy Logic Control. A quarter-vehicle model is used in the evaluation of the controllers both for longitudinal and rotational dynamics. The authors then compare the performances of different controllers using simulations of the breaking point delivered into the system.

articleTitle: Advancements And Difficulties Of Machine Learning Applications In Customised Medicine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Machine learning has been a huge boon to the healthcare industry's progress toward individualized medication. This article provides a comprehensive evaluation of the current situation, with a particular emphasis on the applications, benefits, challenges, and possible advances of ML in customized healthcare. Through a detailed examination of the literature, we demonstrate the extensive range of machine learning algorithms utilized in disciplines such as illness prediction, diagnosis, therapy selection, prognosis, and patient monitoring. In addition, we look at the possibility that machine learning models could be improved upon by combining data from several sources, such as genetic information, imaging data, electronic health records, and data collected by wearable sensors. Furthermore, we explore the ethical, regulatory, and privacy difficulties associated with ML in healthcare, as well as approaches for overcoming these challenges. After reviewing current trends, we outline potential research prospects in using machine learning for customized medicine, emphasizing the necessity of multidisciplinary collaboration and continual inventiveness.

articleTitle: A Modular Design Approach for Underwater ROV: TRIDENT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Trident project introduces an innovative underwater Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) designed with a focus on multi-functionality and cost-efficiency. Utilizing a Modular Design Methodology, Trident aims to enhance operational versatility by allowing for the easy reconfiguration of its components based on mission requirements. This Approach enables the ROV to perform a wide range of tasks by simply swapping out non-essential parts for mission-specific components, thereby minimizing unnecessary costs and optimizing performance for each unique mission. The modular system not only reduces the overall cost of mission-specific implementations but also simplifies the adaptation of the ROV for various underwater applications.

articleTitle: Injection Molding Hot Runner Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: the design and setup of a hot runner system in an injection molding machine is covered in this abstract, a hot runner injection molding machine is a machine specifically designed to produce biomedical plastic items. The hot runner system is a crucial component of injection molding that ensures molten plastic flows into mold cavities efficiently and reliably, reducing waste and speeding up production. The hot runner system ensures that the final products meet strict safety and biocompatibility standards by maintaining the integrity and sterility of medical-grade polymers for use in biomedical applications. Homogeneous pressure distribution and precise temperature management are highly valued in the system design in order to minimize the risk of contamination and stop the degradation of delicate polymers.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different DC –DC Converters performance for power management in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: DC-DC converters are essential for power management systems as they guarantee the efficient, dependable, and secure functioning of electronic devices and systems. DC-DC converters minimize power wastage, leading to lower heat generation and improved system effectiveness. DC-DC converters employ PFC techniques to increase system power factor, reduce strain on power grids, and improve energy efficiency. By allowing precise voltage control, they allow designers to use components designed for particular voltage levels, which could reduce system cost and complexity. Efficient regulation of power with DC-DC converters reduces stress on electronic components, leading to prolonged durability of devices and lowered maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Automatic Driving Assist Systems in Internal Combustion and Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Increasingly, the use of Automatic Driving Assist Systems (ADAS) in automobiles has become an important milestone toward a much safer road network system and more comfort during vehicle operation. This paper presents an in-depth review of ADAS in both internal combustion and electric vehicles, focusing on clearly understanding how these systems work in each kind of vehicle. The paper considers operational differences and technological fine points of energy efficiency, sensor technologies, overall performance, and how ADAS merges with vehicle control systems. Furthermore, it takes into account problems in the implementation of ADAS into IC and EVs. It characterizes the prospects for their development, elaborating on how the technology of autonomous driving has evolved and what can be expected soon from this fast-moving industry.

articleTitle: Safecurrent:Arduino Guardian with GSM Defense
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project texplores the differential protection of transformers using an Arduino-based system combined with a GSM module. It aims to enhance transformer safety by detecting faults through differential current measurement. The Arduino processes real-time current data from both primary and secondary windings, comparing them to identify discrepancies that indicate potential faults. Upon detecting a fault, the system activates protective measures and sends instant notifications via the GSM module to inform maintenance personnel. This approach offers a cost-effective, reliable, and automated solution for transformer protection, improving operational reliability and reducing downtime.

articleTitle: Analyze and Highlight the Abnormal Activities While Recording in CCTV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: More and more settings, including workplaces, hotels, and public areas, are installing closed circuit television systems (CCTV). There have been several installations of monitoring systems in American and European cities. Due to human limitations, the number of camera views that a single chairman can screen is restricted, making this a massive mountain for the CCTV directors to climb. The task of computerized area and affirmation of dangerous conditions for CCTV systems is the focus of this study. Our proposed computations can detect when a cut or weapon is obvious in the picture and alert the human director accordingly. In order to enable the system's practical implementation, we have focused on reducing the number of dishonest warnings in the orchestra. There has been a substantial improvement over previously released cuts in terms of both specificity and affectability. We have also been supervising the proposal of a weapon area calculation that provides an almost-zero rate of dishonest warnings. To reduce the number of possible victims and increase response times, we demonstrated that it is possible to create a system capable of early warning in a dangerous situation.

articleTitle: An Efficient ODR for Computer Night Vision Using Multi-Scale Retinex Network-Aided Enhanced Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the current scenario, recognizing various objects and tracking their movements in the real-time surveillance footage is the most difficult task. To detect objects, a combination of image processing and computer vision algorithms is utilized. Computer-vision based automatic human activity recognition from surveillance video can be utilized for applications such as the identification of violent acts and the study of human behavior. Consequently, this work implements a new "Object Detection and Recognition (ODR)" model for computer night vision utilizing a deep learning technique.
