In order to improve the supplied input image, the combined images are first transmitted to the "Multi-scale Retinex (MSR)" model. The You Only Look Once Version 7 (YoloV7) model uses the improved image from MSR as input to identify and recognize things. After conducting experiments, the implemented ODR model on the ExDark Dataset obtained an efficiency of 94.8%.

articleTitle: Gesture-Controlled Autonomous Trolley for Seamless Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The "Develop and Implementation of Automatic Trolley System for Aged and Disabled Using Arduino Controlled by Hand Gestures" project aims to enhance the mobility and independence of aged and disabled individuals by introducing an innovative assistive technology. The system utilizes Arduino microcontroller-based control, hand gesture recognition, and actuator control to enable users to control the trolley's movements through intuitive hand gestures. These project addresses the challenges faced by aged and disabled individuals in handling trolleys or carts, particularly in public spaces or while shopping. Existing solutions often lack ease of use, limiting the mobility and convenience of users. The proposed system offers an automatic trolley control mechanism that responds to hand gestures, eliminating the need for physical manipulation of the trolley and system's architecture consists of a trolley mechanism, hand gesture recognition system, Arduino microcontroller, actuators, and communication interfaces. Hand gestures are captured and processed using a gesture recognition algorithm, which translates them into control commands. The Arduino microcontroller receives the gesture commands, generates appropriate control signals, and communicates with the trolley's actuators to adjust the trolley's movement. Extensive testing and validation procedures are conducted to ensure the system's functionality, reliability, and performance. The system's effectiveness is evaluated based on gesture recognition accuracy, response time, trolley movement precision, and overall user satisfaction. User feedback and usability assessments are also considered to refine the system's design.

articleTitle: Arduino Child Caring Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The creation of intelligent computers that are able to do activities like perception, learning, reasoning, problem-solving, and decision-making that typically need human cognition is the aim of artificial intelligence, a fast- growing field within computer science. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the study of creating algorithms and computer programs that can replicate human cognitive abilities and, through machine learning and deep learning, gradually enhance such abilities. By increasing efficiency, accuracy, and speed across a range of processes, The artificial intelligence (AI) is to create intelligent computers with human-like thinking, reasoning, and learning abilities. These machines will be able to execute complicated tasks including production. There are various kinds of artificial intelligence (AI), such as rule-based AI that bases choices on a predetermined set of rules and machine learning-based AI that gains knowledge from data.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Text-Image Response System for Enhanced Customer Interaction Using Advanced Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent times, the integration of chatbots into customer interaction systems has transformed the way businesses engage with their customers. As businesses worldwide seek to implement chatbot systems to improve customer relationships, the evolution of these chatbots extends beyond text-based capabilities. With advancements such as Google’s Gemini pro and OpenAI’s GPT-4, chatbots now possess the ability to comprehend image-related queries. However, the challenge lies in developing interactive chatbots tailored to specific needs, capable of providing responses not only in text but also with relevant images—a feature that can significantly enhance problem-solving for small businesses. This paper proposes an innovative system designed to address user queries using both textual responses and pertinent images. Drawing inspiration from recent research, we present a novel approach that leverages the power of Lang chain, Meta’s Llama-2-7b chat model, coupled with sentence transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model for mapping the right image for the user query. This amalgamation of advanced models aims to create a sophisticated chatbot system adept at delivering informative responses enriched with both text and visual content. Our system represents a significant step forward in customer interaction, offering a versatile solution applicable across diverse domains, including customer service, education, and research.

articleTitle: Integrated Solar- VAWT Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper focuses on power generation using Solar and Vertical Axis Wind Turbine" also called as hybrid system. Electricity has eased the physical efforts to a very large extent, but the way to generate it is a question mark. Today, in the greatest part, the electricity we consume is generated through conventional ways. These traditional techniques often rely on the non-renewable sources of energy in the generation of electricity. Not only are these methods costly, but also they have a very negative impact on the environment. The burning of fuels for generation of electricity leads to high costs and high levels of emission of dangerous pollutants. The only way out is the new method that is comparatively cheaper, efficient and most of all, environmental friendly. The Solar – Vertical Axis Wind Turbine System can meet these two conditions. Besides the fact that it is environment friendly it is also relatively cheap compared to the other methods of electricity generation. This is both Solar and Wind Energies to produce electricity. Therefore, we have two efficient and inexhaustible sources for the generation of electricity which will not be interrupted. The system has two principal parts – one for the generation of electricity from Solar Energy and the other from Wind Energy. In the event that one of these two sources of supply was absent in the market, then the other remaining source could be utilized in the supplement of the former. Not only are they cheaper but they are economical and very effective in use.

Author Keywords: Solar and Vertical axis wind turbine

articleTitle: Maximum Energy Transfer Efficiency in Solar-Powered Bilateral Dual-Stage AC to DC Converters for Vehicle-to-Home and Vehicle-to-Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Transition to alternative sources of energy is essential to halting global warming and lessening its effects on biodiversity. In this research, the beneficial environmental effects of integrating powered by solar energy multiple stage bidirectional AC to DC converters in Vehicle-to-Home (V2H) and Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) systems are investigated. By enabling efficient energy transmission between electric vehicles (EVs), the grid, and household energy systems, these converters enhance the handling of energy and long-term sustainability. Due to its simple construction and customizable properties, 2 stages isolated AC/DC converters are frequently employed in the rapidly expanding renewable energy vehicle industry. Here, we construct and assess a highly effective dual-stage in-car charger that operates effectively across a broad voltage range for both I/P and O/P. The main portion comprises PFC (power factor correction) converters with bridgeless buck-boost completely soft switching design, while the battery end converter is powered by an isolated filter-in-built direct current converter. The primary stage’s principal benefit is the elimination of electromagnetic interference (EMI) caused by sudden voltage fluctuations by creating an I/p and O/P common ground. This lessens the requirement for EMI filtering in common mode. Both the common mode (CM) noise and the total leakage current are maintained at a reasonable level. Greater efficiency and power density are the main advantages of the second stage. In order to make sure the safe charging and discharging of batteries, a converter that offers controls battery current and galvanic isolation is needed.

articleTitle: Blockmac: Healthcare Management System Using Blockchain and Machine (HM-BML)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper provides a concise overview of an optimal solution that addresses the need and concern for a proper healthcare management system. With the current growth in population and demand, managing healthcare data has become a paramount challenge. The unstructured, complex, and vast nature of this data poses significant hurdles to traditional centralized platforms, which, while commonly employed, raise concerns about security and erode user trust. This paper introduces a pioneering solution to address these challenges and establish a resilient hospital data management system. This proposal embraces the transition from Web2 to Web3, integrating the principles of decentralization, Automation, and machine learning. This transformative strategy not only tackles the immediate security and data management challenges but also lays the foundation for a revolutionary trend in healthcare data management. By leveraging the principles of decentralization, the system ensures heightened security, mitigating the risks associated with centralized platforms. Automation is employed to streamline processes, making data management more efficient and reducing the margin for human error. Machine learning algorithms play a crucial role in enhancing the system’s capabilities, facilitating advanced analytics, and contributing to predictive healthcare. The integration of these cutting-edge technologies not only fortifies data security but also creates an innovative environment conducive to future advancements in healthcare. This solution not only meets the pressing needs of the present but also anticipates the evolving landscape of healthcare data management, fostering a secure and innovative paradigm shift. This solution also generates a way to solve the overwhelming insurance bills on the clients.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Rice Plant Nutrient Deficiency Prediction using CNN and Optimization through Invasive Weed Optimization (IWO)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper aims to create a strong algorithm for predicting nutritional deficits in rice crops, which is crucial for improving agricultural operations. The research focuses on accurately predicting shortages in Nitrogen, Calcium, and Potassium utilizing a recently gathered dataset. The study assesses the efficacy of four important deep learning architectures: ResNets, GogLeNets, AlexNets, These models undergo thorough comparison using numerous performance criteria to establish the most successful method. In addition, the research investigates the advantages of adjusting pretrained models through Conducting many experiments to enhance the precision of forecasts. The dataset that is gathered by oneself is rigorously tested to confirm its reliability, and the recommended architectures are carefully fine-tuned with hyper parameters. The study utilizes a stratified train-test split to preserve the impartiality of the assessment procedure. The study presents a thorough empirical examination, offering insights into the temporal properties of the models and their capacity to generalize under various scenarios. The comparison of the designs elucidates the merits and drawbacks of the given strategy, offering significant deepth for choosing the most closest model for predicting nutritional deficits in rice. The research findings enhance the advancement of more efficient agricultural practices by facilitating accurate detection of nutrient shortages, eventually resulting in enhanced crop yields and sustainability. This work is a significant advancement in utilizing sophisticated DL techniques to improve the precision and efficiency of agricultural predictions. It establishes a basis for future research in this field.

articleTitle: Efficient Design and Analysis of Inverse Definite Minimum Time Overcurrent Relay: A Matlab Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The paramount importance of generator security in modern power systems is highlighted through a study using MATLAB-based simulation strategies for optimizing reverse power relay protection. The methodology involves developing detailed models of generators and power systems, implementing reverse power relay algorithms, and simulating real-world scenarios. The simulations evaluate the effectiveness of the protection system in detecting and mitigating abnormal conditions, ensuring robust generator security under various scenarios. The improved protection system is rigorously tested against real-world data or set criteria in order to validate and verify its functionality. The study explores MATLAB optimization methods for refining reverse power relay algorithms' parameters, aiming to increase system reliability, reduce frequency of visits, and balance sensitivity and selectivity. To make sure that the protective system's performance and reliability requirements are satisfied, its performance is evaluated against predefined standards. The study also emphasizes the significance of reporting and documentation, offering a thorough explanation of the methodology, simulation configuration, outcomes, and conclusions. To sum up, this research offers a thorough method for optimizing generator security using simulation methodologies for reverse power relay protection that are based on MATLAB. Through the utilization of MATLAB's functionalities, the suggested approach provides a strong and effective means of augmenting generator security, consequently adding to the general dependability and stability of power systems.

Author Keywords: Inverse Definite Minimum Time overcurrent relay

articleTitle: Journea: The Journey Beyond Boundaries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Journea: The Journey Beyond Boundaries stands as a groundbreaking educational platform that aims to break down physical obstacles to learning through virtual discovery. It uses cutting-edge virtual reality tech to plunge students into various settings like museums, space stations historical landmarks, dig sites, plant gardens, and science labs. Each location comes alive with the addition of famous figures from related fields, who offer personal guidance and knowledge. Take the virtual space station, for example. Here, students can talk with Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam and hear his teachings in his voice. This hands-on approach not only boosts understanding but also fires up the imagination of younger students who look up to these big names. By letting people interact with world-famous experts, Journea has a huge impact on old-school teaching methods. It opens up access to places and expert know-how that were out of reach before. This new way of doing things promises to create a more captivating learning experience pushing the limits of what we think of as modern education.

articleTitle: Development and Integration of a Dual-Mode Drone-Rover System for Enhanced Search and Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The increasing frequency of natural and man-made disasters has highlighted the need for innovative solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of rescue operations. This research focuses on the development and deployment of drones specifically designed to assist rescue services. This research presents a novel system comprising two key components: a drone for aerial surveillance and a multifunctional rover. The drone equipped with an X-ray camera could capture images to aid a human detection program, ensuring no victim is overlooked behind obstructions. The rover serves a dual purpose: it approaches victims to reassure them that help is on the way and assesses their health status by measuring heart rate using photoplethysmography (PPG). The system is designed with an innovative attach-and-detach mechanism controlled by a magnetic switch, allowing the drone and rover to operate both independently and in tandem, enhancing the overall search effectiveness. This approach offers a comprehensive solution to ensure thorough and timely rescue operations in complex and challenging environments.

articleTitle: Density Based Traffic Signal System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Urban areas around the world continue to face significant challenges due to traffic congestion., often exacerbated by outdated fixed-timer traffic signal systems that fail to adapt to varying traffic conditions. To address this challenge, proposed work focuses on developing a dynamic traffic signal system that adjusts signal timing based on active traffic flow at intersections. In this system, traffic density is monitored using PIR (proximity infrared) sensors. These sensors detect the presence of vehicles and send the data to a controller (Arduino). The controller then calculates the appropriate duration for green and red lights based on the current traffic flow. This approach ensures that lanes with higher traffic density receive longer green light durations, optimizing traffic flow and reducing congestion. The proposed system not only enhances traffic management, but also contributes to reducing delays and improving safety at intersections. This approach represents a significant advancement in traffic signal control technology, addressing the limitations of current methods and offering a scalable solution for urban traffic management.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Security Systems for Fishermen
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A plan to interact with mariners operating in oceans and seas and support naval authorities in tracking their real-time whereabouts in order to stop them from breaching international borders. Our idea is to install and integrate current technologies to create a single, distinctive system. We have utilized the elements already present in the oceans for weather forecasting, such as buoys and radio frequency communication systems; we have also developed and implemented new technologies, such as Li-Fi, which is installed in boats and buoys; solar panels equipped in buoys serve as an energy source and facilitate communication with seafaring fishermen. The utilization of already-existing oceanic components, such as buoys used for weather forecasting and positioned every square nautical mile, as an energy source for Li-Fi networks that are set up to give fishermen access to the internet. The operation of QR code systems, which track fishermen's real-time whereabouts in seas, depends on the internet. Radio frequency systems are also utilized as an extra means of communication for fishermen.

articleTitle: Accident Avoidance and Response System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: One of the main issues facing our nation these days is traffic accidents. The alarming number of accidents and uncontrollable cars on the road necessitate the development of an accident avoidance and response system. Controlling the speed of the vehicle while encountering an obstacle and warning the driver. Sending message to emergency contact in case of collision to ensure quick response. Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks can be used to develop a comprehensive mechanism with expanded capabilities through sensor integration and GPS location systems.

articleTitle: Medicament Medico - Drug Tidings and Doctor Consultation Forum using Data Analysis with Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The integration of complete medication information into telemedicine services represents a major step forward in digital healthcare. This paper presents, a new online platform designed to meet the growing demand for accessible and reliable medical information and advisory services provides comprehensive drug and pharmaceutical information, provides detailed information on medication use, dosage, side effects, interactions and patient reviews. The platform prioritizes user privacy and data security through advanced encryption techniques, ensuring confidentiality of patient information. This paper examines the design, implementation, and user experience of, focusing on its potential to enhance healthcare delivery through a reliable, user-friendly, and it is comprehensive to provide access to medication information and telehealth services.

articleTitle: Electrolyte Enriched IV Bottle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Healthcare professionals find it difficult to keep an eye on electrolyte bottles, especially during a pandemic. For this reason, we want to develop a reusable electrolyte-level sensor that uses an Arduino Nano, an ultrasonic sensor, and radio frequency communication. The sensor measures electrolyte levels and wirelessly transmits the data to a receiver circuit, displaying the percentage on an LCD and sounding an alarm when the bottle is empty. This system lowers patient risks, increases healthcare accuracy, and does away with the need for manual checks, especially during night shifts when there is a chance that air bubbles might enter the blood stream and cause serious harm. Additionally, future developments could permit sending warnings to healthcare personnel’s phones with patient details. Constructing such a monitoring system boosts the precision of healthcare services and assures patient safety.

articleTitle: An Innovative Framework for Human Biometric Identification Using ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Biometric techniques, like fingerprint, iris, and facial recognition, provide ways to identify people based on their distinct physiological characteristics. An electrocardiogram can additionally function as a unique biometric signature, according to recent research. Empirical methods are the mainstay of current ECG-based identification algorithms for feature extraction. A different strategy is presented in this study, which makes use of a time-domain system of the ECG signal. Characterizing ECG signals is a good fit for auto-regressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) models, which are renowned for their reliable representation of periodic time series data. We describe a process for modeling electrocardiograms, taking features out of the resulting model representations, and using these features to identify specific people.

articleTitle: Categorization of Rice Plant leaf disease using feature fusion and Entrenched CNN and LBP
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Plant diseases are a leading factor in the reduction of both the quality and quantity of agricultural production. New plant diseases are continuously emerging on leaves due to evolving plant structures and advancements in cultivation techniques. Therefore, identifying and detecting rice leaf disease accurately in initial stage can help prevent the infection from spreading and promote the healthy growth of plant output. This study introduces a new compact Entrenched CNN model aimed at capturing advanced unexposed feature extraction. The entrenched characteristics are combined with manually created local binary pattern (LBP) feature to identify local texture details in rice leaf images. The suggested model is trained and evaluated on dataset that are accessible to the public. The experimental outcomes indicate that the suggested method can offer an improved control strategy for plant illnesses.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Extreme Learning Machine for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Predicting crop yields (CYP) is a major obstacle for policymakers at all levels, from the local to the national. If the CYP model is accurate, it might be used by farmers to make decisions about what to grow and when. Precision agriculture (PA) seeks to boost crop growth and output while cutting down on production costs and emissions. To help farmers make informed decisions about which crops to plant where and when, as well as how to maximise harvest and growth yields, machine-learning (ML) is increasingly being put to use in crop yield prediction. In order to aid in agricultural yield prediction studies, a number of deep-learning (DL) strategies, neural network topologies, and anticipation techniques have been implemented. This research suggests employing an enhanced version of the Extreme-Linear-Machine (ELM) for crop prediction. The data was preprocessed with the Kalman Filter Algorithm, and features were extracted through Linear-Discriminant-Analysis (LDA). Geographical, seasonal, and agricultural area factors have all been used to make predictions about rice crop yield. Comparing the experimental results to the traditional, they reveal a higher accuracy of 99.99%.

articleTitle: Examining the Structure for Handling and Addressing Consumer Issues within the Water Utilities Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Authorities' reactive approach to water quality issues and infrastructure can cause delays. Predicting future complaints based on environmental factors can help to improve infrastructure and prevent complaints. It is possible to predict the number of complaints for future years by analyzing water-related complaints data and identifying correlations between various environmental factors using machine learning algorithms such as Random Forest. This data can help manage water quality issues and enhance infrastructure. Identifying common difficulties in specific areas can also aid in determining the main cause of a problem and preventing future complaints. In this study, Python libraries are used to examine data on water quality complaints in New York City from 2010 to 2020. The first dataset filtered out water-related searches from a vast dataset, while the second comprised data on water quality and environmental aspects from 2015 to 2021. According to the findings, there is a link between specific environmental conditions and the frequency of complaints. Based on past data, the Random Forest algorithm was used to forecast complaints.

articleTitle: AI Based Underwater Noise Cancellation to Reduce Ship-induced Marine Noise Pollution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent years, the impact of human activities on marine environments has drawn increasing attention, particularly concerning the detrimental effects of marine noise pollution. This anthropogenic noise in oceans has disrupted marine ecosystems, especially marine mammals that rely on sound waves for vital life processes. Commercial shipping is a primary contributor to this issue, prompting increased efforts to develop technologies that mitigate vessel noise. This paper introduces an AI-driven device that leverages machine learning algorithms to detect and locate sources of ship-generated noise. The device employs hydrophones to capture the noise, and uses an AI system to determine the frequency of the sound waves. The AI system then computes an anti-signal that is 180 degrees out of phase with the original noise. This anti-noise is emitted through an Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) speaker thereby providing a real-time solution that surpasses the existing traditional methods.

articleTitle: Automated LPG Cylinder Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The automated LPG cylinder monitoring system will offer a strong solution for continuous household LPG cylinder monitoring in terms of safety and convenience. This system could be segregated into two major functionalities: the first one related to gas leakage detection. It has a sensor network that detects any leakage of the LPG gas. It then automatically shuts off the gas outlet and triggers an exhaust system to clear the leaked gas from a confined area. At the same time, this system sends real-time alerts to the users through its communication network, thus keeping them updated on time in case of problems. The second function that this device does is automatic pre-ordering of an LPG cylinder. The system monitors the cylinder weight and once the weight falls beyond a certain threshold, thereby indicating that the cylinder is running out. The system generates a warning to the user and an order for a new cylinder, then confirms the same to the consumer. This two-functionality system improves safety, makes cylinder management easy, and provides a very user-friendly experience.

articleTitle: Enhanced Route Optimization: Incorporating Road Safety Factors for Optimal Path Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Efficient route optimization is a crucial concern in modern transportation systems, influencing travel time, resource consumption, and user satisfaction. By empowering users to select their priority parameters, such as safety or efficiency, this project enables travellers to make eco-conscious choices and select routes that minimize their environmental footprint. Real-time data integration ensures users can bypass traffic jams and accidents, reducing emissions and fuel consumption. Furthermore, the focus on safety factors helps prevent accidents, thereby fostering safer road environments. Existing systems often fall short, providing limited customization and overlooking safety and sustainability priorities. To bridge these gaps, this project introduces an advanced route planning system that empowers users to select their priority parameters, integrates real-time data for up-to- the-minute updates, and prioritizes road safety. It introduces a pioneering approach that enhances the Dijkstra Algorithm by integrating real-time accident rate and travel time data into the route optimization process. By considering these additional factors, the algorithm produces routes that not only minimize distance but also prioritize safety and time efficiency in dynamic real-world conditions. The algorithm's multi-factor optimization considers distance, accident rates, and travel times, enabling the creation of routes that balance these criteria and offer improved decision-making for users through a user- friendly interface. The algorithm's dynamic adaptability, multi- factor optimization, and practical implementation showcase its potential to revolutionize how routes are planned, leading to safer, faster, and more informed travel experiences.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Alzheimer Stages by Using CNN Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease a neurodegenerative disorder that progresses over time – condition that gradually damage and destroy the cells of central neuros system leads to memory loss, especially in the part of brain. The disorder that affects millions of people, mostly people in the elderly age. Timely diagnosis and staging are very important test or decision for effective action taken to improve a medical disorder and patient care. The proposes methodology is an inventive method for diagnosis and staging the Alzheimer’s disease by utilizing CNN architectures on brain imaging data. The dataset uses MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) scans and patient details gathered from individuals at various disease stage. By using CNN, automatically extract important features from MRI scans, identifying local and global patterns that are associated with disease progressive.

articleTitle: Smart Jacket : Integrated Sensor System for Real-Time COPD and Sleep Apnea Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Respiratory health is a crucial aspect of human well-being. According to a survey conducted in 2023, India accounts for 32% of the global burden of respiratory diseases. It is essential to regularly monitor respiratory parameters for effective treatment of patients. The primary objective of this project is to develop a sensor-based approach for detection and monitoring respiratory parameters in individuals with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease(COPD), sleep apnea, and other related conditions. The aim is to enhance the understanding and management of these chronic conditions. This project utilizes advanced sensor technologies to capture real time data related to key respiratory parameters, such as heart rate , body position or movements, respiratory rate and spo2 level. The solution is a wearable jacket equipped with sensors that can be removed and attached to a belt for measuring the parameters . The collected data is transmitted to a centralized system for analysis and interpretation. Additionally, the proposed system facilitates remote monitoring , allowing healthcare providers to access real-time respiratory data and make informed decisions regarding patient care. This approach not only enhances the efficiency of healthcare delivery but also reduces the need for frequent hospital visits. The management of COPD and sleep apnea holds great promise for personalized and proactive healthcare. By providing continuous, real-time monitoring of respiratory parameters this system contributes to early intervention, better disease management and improved outcomes for individuals living with chronic respiratory diseases . Furthermore, this system can be useful for monitoring the respiratory parameters of athletes, and their training methods can be adjusted to suit their physical parameters.

articleTitle: Ground Penetrating Radar For Identifying Mines In A Minefield
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Land mines have been widely used since 1939, with increasing ingenuity going into both their design and their detection. Antipersonnel mines developed into a weapon of particular significance in the numerous guerrilla conflicts in Asia and Africa. Vast quantities of deadly mines were still present in remote or thinly populated regions after the wars in these nations were over. About 25000 individuals were killed or crippled every year as a result of it. Therefore, this research suggests a Ground Penetrating Radar that provides a way to find hidden mines that cannot be found by existing techniques. Both metallic and nonmetallic mines can be found using a ground-penetrating antenna. The system projects electromagnetic signals onto the surface, then it receives and analyzes signals that exhibit anomalies for various dielectric constants. One of the most common issues with GPR data analysis is excessive ground reflection, which distort signals entering from just beneath the surface. Deconvolution might weaken this reflection. This method is extremely beneficial when GPR is used to locate hidden landmines. Noise reduction is then achieved using wavelet decomposition/reconstruction. When the suggested signal processing technique is applied to GPR data, the target reflection is much improved, allows us to determine and target position. The study' conclusions may allow us to discover landmines.

articleTitle: Smart Garbage Reward System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Waste management is one of the central themes of the circular economy. The expectations from waste collection have grown remarkably in the past years. Garbage pickup and waste collection alone are no longer enough for cities. They look for flexibility, availability of on demand waste collection, service verification, and easy to deploy Pay as you throw systems. There is an expansion in commercial, residential and infrastructure improvement because of the populace development and this negatively affects the environmental solid waste management. One of these effects is because of the area of the dumping site in unsuitable regions. The objective of this work is to segregate the garbage waste into Biodegradable and Non-Biodegradable waste. Rewards will be provided to the segregator on the basis of points they achieved by properly separating the waste and providing to the garbage collector. People can utilize the points in land tax payment. According to the points they can be redeemed by purchasing any farming products required for cultivation.

articleTitle: Collaborate Like-Minded People Using Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In nowadays interconnected international, inexperienced persons frequently face considerable demanding situations in obtaining new abilities or completing initiatives individually because of difficulties in finding and connecting with like-minded individuals. This paper proposes a cell utility that serves as an all-in-one mastering hub, integrating each educational resources and social networking abilties. by means of leveraging AI and device learning algorithms, the app personalizes the mastering revel in, enables group collaboration, and simplifies person interactions by means of getting rid of the need to interchange among more than one structures. Our solution allows users to connect with others who percentage similar pastimes, thereby improving the gaining knowledge of manner. The proposed machine is carried out the use of Java and Node.js, with device studying algorithms tailored for person profile matching. The results demonstrate the app’s effectiveness in improving person engagement, collaboration, and studying consequences, positioning it as a significant contribution to the sector of digital getting to know systems. [7] "User Persona Mapping" is used to identify the learners mindset based on the previous courses viewed.

articleTitle: Autotrash Collecting Boat
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The paper presents the design and development of an autonomous boat with enhanced waste management capability. It is designed to collect trash efficiently from any water body, segregating it into biodegradable and non-biodegradable components. Some of the core functionalities include autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, waste detection, and collection by a specialized mechanism. It is a combination of computer vision and machine learning algorithms that will do real-time identification and sorting of wastes. Biodegradable waste collected could either be treated on board or taken to a land-based treatment facility. The non-biodegradable fraction is stored for proper disposal. This offers an opportunity for significantly reducing marine pollution and impacts on a cleaner and healthier aquatic environment.

articleTitle: Street Light Intensity Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Nowadays the usage of light sources has increased drastically. Particularly in the highways, streets when there is no vehicle movement, a huge amount of light source has been wasted. Nearly 20% of electricity is lost due to technical and commercial reasons according to the Ministry of Power. The actual consumption for public lighting in India is 7753 GWh. The core components of this system include Arduino and sensors. This system not only helps conserve energy but also lowers operational expenses and reduces carbon emissions, offering a sustainable and cost-efficient solution for contemporary urban lighting infrastructure. Our project gives the solution for electric power consumption by street light intensity control. Traditional street lights are being replaced by light emitting diodes, which reduces power consumption the prototype uses LDR (light-dependent resistors), infrared sensors (IR) for detecting the motion of objects, ultrasonic sensors for measuring the distance of moving objects, lithium batteries, piezoelectric sensor, solar PV as a source of electricity.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization and Control of Reverse Osmosis Desalination Plant Using MATLAB Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive approach to optimizing energy consumption in a Reverse Osmosis (RO) desalination plant using MATLAB Simulink. The model integrates a enthusiastic drain, a PID boss, and an Energy Recovery Device (ERD) to enhance bureaucracy's effectiveness. The basic focus act underrating strength usage while upholding the essential pressure for persuasive desalination .The ERD subsystem is modeled to capture and reuse energy from the brine stream, significantly reducing the overall energy demand. Additionally, the system is tested under dynamic conditions, including varying seawater pressure and fluctuating water demand, to simulate real-world scenarios. The results demonstrate that the combined use of the PID controller and ERD not only ensures stable operation but also achieves substantial energy savings. This study underscores the importance of dynamic modeling and control strategies in regions. Among the various desalination technologies, Reverse Osmosis (RO) stands out due to its relatively low energy consumption and high efficiency in removing salts and other impurities from seawater and brackish water. However, RO desalination is still energy-intensive, and the cost of optimizing desalination processes, providing valuable insights for improving the sustainability of RO plants.

articleTitle: Mobile Charging Port for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The "Mobile Charging Port for Electric Vehicles" addresses the logistical challenges inherent in the current electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. This innovative solution introduces a solar-powered portable charging unit integrated with electric vehicles, designed to provide emergency power when the vehicle’s battery is critically low and the driver is stranded away from established charging stations. The system dynamically calculates the distance between the vehicle’s present location and its destination, determining the necessary charge to ensure the vehicle can reach its intended endpoint using a charge controller. By leveraging solar energy for the portable charger, this project enhances the reliability and convenience of EV usage, offering a sustainable and immediate solution to prevent and manage range anxiety in remote locations.

articleTitle: Powering the EV Revolution: Charging Infrastructure Challenges and Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With increasing momentum and strong charging infrastructure, EVs are to become a mass market. In the paper, various challenges and innovations of EV charging infrastructure have been assessed with respect to their interaction with the power grid. Several important questions arise, like grid capacity, number of charging stations, allowance, and integration of renewable energy sources. On the other hand, some innovative solutions include smart grid technology, wireless charging, and vehicle-to-grid systems. The present paper is an insight into the current status and future developments of charging networks for EVs and their role in zero-carbon footprint transportation, based on comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: Power Generation Using Barium Titanate Piezoelectric Material [Tizo-Gen]
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the modern world, the technique needs power for various operations. These processes consume significant amounts of fossil fuels. To address this high power and fuel consumption, alternative solutions are needed. In this project, we have presented a method to produce pollution-free electricity using the piezoelectric effect technique. This is a kind of green solution for power generation. The project focuses on harnessing energy from vehicle tires using piezoelectric materials to generate electricity. The system captures the energy produced by the movement of the wheels and converts it into electrical current, which is then stored in a battery.

articleTitle: Investigation of Space Vector Controlled Multi-Level Induction Motor Drive for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The proposed study focuses on the effectiveness of a space vector-controlled multi-level inverter in driving a three-phase induction motor within an electric vehicle. The induction motor is selected for its robust construction, high torque, and durability, which are essential for the challenging demands of EV applications. In an EV, the primary power source is a DC battery, which needs to be converted to AC power to drive the three-phase induction motor. This conversion is achieved using an inverter, with a multi-level inverter being especially advantageous as it produces a nearly sinusoidal AC output from DC input. This is vital because a smoother sine wave output minimizes harmonic distortion, thereby enhancing the motor’s overall performance. The multilevel inverter is designed to reduce the voltage stress on the Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) modules within the inverter, leading to the more reliable and efficient operation. To achieve the desired sine wave output, the inverter employs the Space Vector Controlled Pulse Width Modulation (SVCPWM) technique. This approach not only refines the output waveform but also elevates efficiency and optimizes the motor drive system’s performance. The simulation and performance analysis of the multi-level inverter with SVCPWM control are conducted using MATLAB software, which offers a robust platform for modeling and simulating electrical and control systems, enabling precise predictions of the inverter’s behavior under various operating conditions.

articleTitle: Smart Menu Ordering System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In a restaurant, handling a large number of patrons is necessary, and ensuring that they are satisfied is essential to success. Nonetheless, the majority of restaurants in use today provide traditional services. Because order tracking and bill creation are manual processes, things are tough to manage when there are more orders than there are staff members if resources are few. Dealing with a pile of papers becomes a laborious process under such circumstances. There is a discrepancy between restaurant services and patron pleasure because of these issues. We employ a computerized menu ordering mechanism to get over these issues with the manual system that will free the chefs from manual serving. This application supports services like display of menu items, taking orders, order update and confirmation of the order. It is accurate menu ordering software that features reliability, ease of maintenance, faster services, and handle multiple orders at a time.

Author Keywords: order update and confirmation of the orders

articleTitle: Biogas Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The development and implementation [2] of a real- time biogas monitoring system plays a vital role which ensures the optimization of efficiency and safety of biogas production. The system integrates various sensors, including pressure, temperature, and pH sensors, to continuously monitor the critical parameters within the biogas digester. By providing real-time data on the internal conditions, the system enables precise control and timely interventions, ensuring optimal microbial activity and maximizing biogas yield [5]. The data collected by the sensors is transmitted to a centralized monitoring platform, where it is analyzed and displayed through an intuitive user interface. This approach not only enhances the operational efficiency of biogas plants but also improves safety by allowing for early detection of potential issues such as pressure build-up, temperature fluctuations, or pH imbalances. The system’s modular design [2] allows for scalability and easy integration with existing biogas infrastructure, making it a valuable tool for sustainable energy production [6].

articleTitle: Mitigation of faults in power quality using Automatic Regulator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project is designed for enhancing power quality in electrical systems. This paper introduces an advanced UPQC system integrated with fuzzy logic control. By combining series and shunt active power filters, the system ensures a stable and high- quality power supply while significantly reducing total harmonic distortion (THD). The fuzzy logic controller dynamically optimizes compensation parameters based on real-time monitoring, providing superior performance over conventional control methods. The effectiveness of the system is demonstrated through comprehensive MATLAB/Simulink simulations, which highlights the potential of the proposed UPQC with fuzzy logic control as a reliable solution for maintaining optimal power quality in industrial, commercial, and distribution network environments.

articleTitle: Aerial Lifesavers Enhancing Rescue Missions With Drone
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Failure to recognize the number of persons living in affected regions of a disaster can hinder efforts to rescue and make it difficult to know where help is most needed or to respond faster enough to those under greatest threats. Such delay increases casualties and poorly allocates and coordinates resources, wasting chances of saving lives. This study presents an innovative technique for using drones fitted with cameras that can produce real time heat maps during emergencies. The main objectives are to accurately estimate human density using a pre-trained model as well as prioritizing rescue operations effectively. The conventional approaches used in surveying areas affected by disasters are often slow and could be inaccurate thereby delaying critical interventions. Integrating drone imagery with real-time data visualization tools like Folium provides precise, timely information, which enables better emergency responses. These heat maps depict the changing extent of human overcrowding in terms of its levels that facilitate prompt identification of rescue sites. Drone Technology offers extensive coverage in large-scale remote areas leading to quickened data gathering.

articleTitle: VeriDrone - A real time AI Enabled System to Monitor and Report Safety in Construction Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Drone when used with an AI model can do wonders in the field of transportation, construction, agriculture, research, environmental monitoring, delivery services and research. The main purpose of this work is to build a real time model which monitors and reports safety related information in a construction environment. The AI model used in this project gets its input data from a drone and processes it real time and reports safety related incidents and information as a short message as well as an email to the management. The proposed method uses a customized veridrone dataset collected from bench mark image datasets containing construction sites with workers wearing hard hats, safety glasses, gloves, protective clothing, and ear protection plug images. A hybrid orientation bounding box(HOBB) algorithm is introduced in this project which uses bounding polygons customized for the detection of five different classes of safety equipment used by construction workers to ensure the smallest accurate bounding box. The SSD(Single Shot MultiBox Detector) model is implemented with HOBB in detecting real time safety measures and the model is found to be 89% accurate on average in detecting safety equipment usage in a construction environment. The model is connected to a web API which sends email and a short message to the management in the event of safety violations.

articleTitle: Vehicle Insurance Damage Estimation Using YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Accident assessments for insurance companies are currently conducted manually, which can be time-consuming and prone to human error. The proposed method seeks to automate this process, aiming to save time and enhance accuracy. This paper introduces an innovative approach to analyzing object damage by leveraging the advanced YOLOv5 (You Only Look One Level) deep learning architecture. The research is meticulously crafted to address the imperative need for robust and precise detection and classification of damaged objects in images, crucial for effective assessment of structural and environmental integrity. Leveraging the unparalleled real-time object detection capabilities of YOLOv5, the framework is finely tuned and trained on a comprehensive dataset encompassing diverse scenarios of damaged objects. Through exhaustive experimentation and validation, our methodology demonstrates substantial advancements, offering unparalleled efficiency and accuracy in the domain of object damage analysis. The findings of this study hold significant implications for a broad spectrum of applications, ranging from infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, underscoring the transformative potential of deep learning in enhancing critical assessment processes.

articleTitle: Efficient Chaos Based Homomorphic Permutation and SPM-BOW Algorithm for Secure Image Storage and Retrieval in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Storing digital images in the cloud, managed by third-party services, offers numerous advantages over traditional on-premises storage. It empowers scalability, accessibility from anywhere with internet, reliability through redundancy, cost-effectiveness with pay-as-you-go models. Given the rising reliance on cloud storage and mounting concerns regarding data privacy, a pioneering technique to securely retrieve images within cloud environments. The proposed approach focuses on safeguarding sensitive image content while ensuring compliance with privacy regulations. By leveraging advanced encryption techniques, this approach safeguards image data prior to its transmission to cloud servers, effectively reducing the likelihood of unauthorized access and potential data breaches. The technique involves extracting features directly from encrypted files, ensuring streamlined image retrieval while upholding user privacy and maintaining the integrity of the encrypted data.By applying discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients and sophisticated encryption techniques, image content is obscured to ensure confidentiality. Local features extracted from encrypted big-blocks serve as the foundation for image representation. Leveraging these features, a feature vector is constructed using the Spatial Pyramid Matching and Bag of Words (SPM – BOW) model, facilitating efficient image retrieval while maintaining privacy. The proposed framework significantly advances cloud storage solutions by achieving 91.8% accuracy in image retrieval, surpassing the performance of other existing retrieval algorithms in terms of security and efficiency.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Based Smart Waste Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Waste management is becoming more difficult in urban areas due to the substantial amount of trash produced by the area's fast population growth. Traditional systems are expensive and ineffective. To maximize resource usage, a deep learning model and Internet of Things are being integrated into a smart waste management system. introducing bin status monitoring and strengthening waste segregation. The system use EfficientNet which was trained on a dataset comprising paper, cardboard, glass, metal, and plastic, to classify rubbish. This method is used by both pyTorch and the Raspberry pi 5. Trash is recognized by a camera module, sorted by a servo motor into the proper sections on a plastic board, and its fill levels are tracked by an ultrasonic sensor.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation Using Image Processing In MRI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Brain tumors are a significant health concern in India, with an estimated 40,000 to 50,000 new cases diagnosed annually. The country's limited healthcare resources and infrastructure exacerbate the challenge, leading to delayed diagnosis and treatment. Improper or late segmentation of brain tumors can have devastating consequences, including increased morbidity, mortality, and reduced quality of life. Inaccurate segmentation can lead to incomplete tumor resection, resulting in recurrence and reduced survival rates. Furthermore, delayed diagnosis can cause irreversible damage, such as vision loss, cognitive impairment, and motor dysfunction, significantly impacting patients' daily lives and socioeconomic productivity. Many people are not able to afford for the treatment for this particular disease and this disease becomes fatal for them. Therefore, in order to overcome this problem, an accurate and efficient segmentation method, Vision Transformer (ViT) approach is crucial to improve patient outcomes and alleviate the burden on India's healthcare system.

articleTitle: IoT Based Soil Moisture Monitoring and Nutrients Suggestion Based on the Soil PH Value
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has a massive influence on machine-to-machine (M2M) and machine-to-human (M2H) technologies, which in turn have caused major changes in society. Country's ability to provide its citizens with food is largely dependent on its agriculture industry. Farmers continue to lack access to technological innovations and advancements in their industry, which causes them to suffer financial losses so we need soil monitoring system. Many chemical and physical possessions of the soil, such as temperature, moisture, and concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, have a significant impact on crop yield. In order to preserve soil fertility and productivity, farmers can benefit from the increased awareness of continuous cropping and minimum fertilizer use provided by technology and digital gadgets. In order to help farmers in the future with affordable and equable automated irrigation system, a budget friendly prototype for quantifying soil moisture, temperature, pH level and we plan to measure the soil NPK values using sensors. Our proposed work suggests the farmers what nutrient to be added to get better yield using a microcontroller, sensor in conjunction with GSM technology and IoT for continuous analyses of the soil. It will support the efficient cultivation of the land by encouraging moderate pesticide application and soil fertilization.

articleTitle: Automated Driving License Testing System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Automated Driving License Test System (ADLTS) is a cutting-edge project that aims to automate and enhance the process of evaluating candidates for driving licenses. It uses a combination of sensors and algorithms to objectively assess an applicant's driving skills and provide instant results on their performance. The ADLTS is a forward-looking approach to modernizing driving license testing in an era of evolving automotive technology.The applicants are fingerprinted with fingerprint sensor to ensure that no one else can impersonate them. This application and authentication process is handled by software application. The testing procedure is monitored by three sensors: a proximity sensor, an RPM sensor, and a human face identification system powered by OpenCV, a Machine Learning Library. Proximity sensor is used to monitor the distance between the vehicle and the external objects, while the RPM sensor is used to determine if the vehicle is turned on thereby monitoring the status of the engine. The Face Detection sensor monitors the presence of candidates in the vehicle. Violations of these testing procedures result in license rejection. The license is approved once the car is successfully parked without violating the cues.The sensors and the software system are integrated with a user-friendly UI to form a comprehensive model. This automated system improves safety, consistency, and cost efficiency in the licensing process, reducing the reliance on human evaluators and the risk of accidents during testing.

articleTitle: Skin Disease Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Skin diseases are a major global health concern that impact millions of people globally. For appropriate therapy to be administered and subsequent difficulties to be avoided, early and precise diagnosis is essential. Within this framework, we suggest a Skin Illness Identifier that utilizes sophisticated machine learning methods and visual evaluation. The Skin Disease Detector is a sophisticated and clever technology that combines image processing and artificial intelligence to enable automated dermatological diagnosis. The Skin Disease Detector is a tool that uses image processing technology to analyse the skin disorders that affect our bodies. The contaminated skin area is scanned using the device's assistance. It provides details regarding skin diseases. The system employs a diverse dataset of skin images, encompassing various dermatological conditions, to train a robust Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The CNN is designed to extract intricate features from input images, enabling accurate classification of skin diseases. The model is trained on a large and diverse dataset to enhance its generalization capabilities across different skin types and conditions. To evaluate the model's performance, extensive testing is conducted using a variety of skin disease images, including common dermatological conditions such as acne, eczema, psoriasis, and melanoma. The system demonstrates high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in identifying various skin diseases, showcasing its potential as a valuable tool for healthcare professionals and individuals seeking preliminary assessments.

articleTitle: The Impact of Sustainable Electrification on Stock Market Performance: An Empirical Study of Indian Energy Companies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between sustainable electrification programs and stock market returns in the energy firms in India. Given these, the study adopts event study methodology with regression analysis to measure the effects of renewable energy announcements in the short and long run. Real-life data of sustainable electrification or green energy companies like Tata Power, NTPC, and Adani Green Energy also corroborate this hypothesis that sustainable electrification means an apparent short-term anomalous stock return and hence, considering the modern world’s financial stability, a better investment decision in the long run. This research also presents another novel factor, namely market sentiment, to complement the evaluation of the stock performance.

articleTitle: Disaster Management Strategies: A Systematic Review of Current Practices and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In India, nearly 1,38,000 people have lost their lives due to disasters between 1970 to 2021. The major challenge people face during such crisis is that there is no proper communication between the rescue team and the people due to low connectivity. To overcome this situation, we propose an app "RESCUE HUB" through which all the rescue agencies that are registered can communicate with each other and save people lives. The app promotes coordination and communication between people who are exposed to hazard and the rescue team. It is also developed in a way such that it is easy to use for everyone. The app also works in low connectivity with mesh technology and also uses GPS for real-time location tracking. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is used for finding the shortest path to reach the victim and provide them service.

articleTitle: Design Of Performance Improved 4-Bit Baugh Wooley Multiplier Using LUT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the realm of digital design, the multiplication operation stands as a fundamental yet computationally intensive task, often requiring dedicated hardware solutions for efficient execution. In this context, the utilization of Look-Up Tables (LUTs) within Xilinx Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) emerges as a promising avenue for implementing high-performance multipliers. This project aims to explore and develop a LUT-based multiplier design using Xilinx technology, leveraging FPGAs' inherent flexibility and configurability to achieve optimized performance metrics. The proposed multiplier design harnesses the computational power of LUTs, which serve as configurable memory elements capable of implementing complex logic functions. Through careful architectural design and optimization techniques, the project seeks to maximize the efficiency of the multiplier while minimizing resource utilization and latency. By exploiting the parallelism inherent in FPGA architectures, the multiplier aims to deliver accelerated multiplication operations, catering to diverse application requirements across various domains. The project endeavors to explore potential enhancements and optimizations, such as pipelining, parallel processing, and resource sharing, to further improve the speed and efficiency of the multiplier implementation. Through iterative refinement and experimentation, the aim is to achieve a balance between performance, resource utilization, and power efficiency, thereby demonstrating the practical viability and applicability of the LUT-based multiplier design in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent Farming System Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Intelligent Farming System leverages Artificial Intelligence (AI) to transform traditional farming practices, enhancing productivity and sustainability. Designed for both experienced and new farmers, it features AI-powered crop disease recognition, soil nutrient analysis, and weather pattern prediction. These capabilities provide timely and accurate insights, helping farmers optimize crop health and yield. The system offers personalized guidance on crop cultivation, recommending suitable pesticides and fertilizers tailored to specific crops. This ensures effective nutrient management and minimizes the use of harmful chemicals, promoting sustainable farming practices. Additionally, the system integrates a dynamic news feed with the latest agricultural updates, market trends, and innovative techniques. This keeps farmers informed and equipped with the knowledge needed for efficient and sustainable agriculture. Overall, the Intelligent Farming System empowers farmers with advanced tools and insights, fostering a more productive and environmentally friendly agricultural sector.

articleTitle: Gestural Reality: Hand Gesture Augmented Reality for Next-Level Video Conferencing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: AR Collab is a state-of-the-art solution that combines hand gesture control with augmented reality (AR) technology to completely reinvent the remote communication landscape. By leveraging augmented reality, this web application for video conferences offers a captivating and immersive experience, allowing users to interact with the virtual realm using simple hand gestures. Through the seamless integration of virtual overlays with live video feeds, users can effortlessly blend their actual environment with digital components, transforming traditional video conferencing into an engaging and dynamic platform. The most notable feature of the application is its hand gesture detection, which makes it easy to navigate, manipulate, and control a variety of virtual objects. Modern computer vision algorithms enable the system to recognize and interpret user hand movements in real time, allowing for natural gestures that initiate conference room events. By facilitating participants' easy interaction with the virtual environment, these nonverbal cues improve communication. AR Collab holds great promise for a variety of professional domains, such as education, and remote teamwork. Using expressive and natural hand gestures to control the virtual environment, AR Collab ushers in a new era of remote engagement, communication, and collaboration.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Prognosis of Cancer (NSCLC and Breast Cancer) Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The primary aim is to ensure optimal healthcare for individuals through the utilization of advancing technology such as artificial intelligence (AI). One crucial element of an all-encompassing approach to cancer control is the implementation of a proactive strategy for early detection. Within the realm of cancer diagnosis, the utilization of the Monte Carlo Markov chain algorithm and the K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm plays a pivotal role in identifying cases at their nascent stages, thereby facilitating more effective treatment and increasing the likelihood of successful outcomes.The integration of AI into this process acts as a catalyst, transforming the goal of curing cancer and enabling patients to lead fulfilled and prolonged lives. This vision of comprehensive cancer care is aimed at improving the overall well-being and quality of life for all individuals.

articleTitle: ECG Biometric Human Identification using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Biometric systems have been used for authentication more often within the last ten years. Conventional biometric systems frequently depend on physiological traits that are external to the user, such as finger prints, palm prints, iris scans, and facial recognition. On the other hand, several scientists have looked into the possibility of using internal physiological traits for biometric verification. The aim of this work is to develop an ECG biometric by integrating machine learning and deep learning techniques. Electrocardiograms, or ECG’s, provide detailed information on the electrical signals in the heart. Because this activity is so individualized, ECG’s are a helpful tool for authentication. A variety of ECG pattern datasets are used to evaluate the system, including the QT Database, the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (MITDB), the FANTASIA Database, and the Normal Sinus Rhythm Database. These datasets include people with arrhythmia’s and irregular heartbeats in addition to healthy individuals with a variety of cardiac diseases. On the following datasets, the suggested CNN method produced remarkable accuracy rates: 81.33% for MITDB, 96.95% for FANTASIA, 94.73% for NSRDB, and 92.85% for the QT data system.

articleTitle: Scripting the Skies : Beyond the Horizon with Machine Learning in Drone Shaped Bird Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Support Vector Machine (SVM) is a Machine learning approaches has been used for bird species identification. Feature extraction from bird photos is used to train the SVM classifier. These features include morphological traits, color histograms, and texture descriptors. The experimental findings show that the SVM model works well for identifying bird species from photos. To begin, SVM's classification performance is very sensitive to the hyperparameters—the kind of kernel and regularization parameter—selected with great care. Also, support vector machines (SVMs) often have trouble handling noisy data or feature spaces with a lot of dimensions since they are so sensitive to the features that are input.When contrasted with probabilistic classification model like logistic regression or Gaussian Naive Bayes, SVM's lack of intrinsic probabilistic outputs makes it less interpretable. Finally, SVM could have scalability problems with big datasets since training duration and storage needs go up with features and samples. Notwithstanding these caveats, support vector machines (SVMs) continue to be a hot commodity when it comes to machine learning classification algorithms, and bird species detection is no exception. To overcome SVM's limitations in bird recognition applications, future studies can investigate hybrid techniques or other algorithms.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stock Price Forecasting Accuracy with Hybrid Machine Learning Models and Interactive Visualization: A Dash-Based Approach Integrating Time Series Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Predicting the future of stock market is essential for financial professionals and investors. This paper proposes a reliable method for better accuracy in stock price prediction by using the combination of interactive visualization tools and machine learning algorithms. The proposed framework majorly depends on Time Series analysis, which is used to identify previous trends and patterns in stock prices. Random Forest are suitable for financial data, which frequently displays nonlinear correlations, because to its capacity to handle high attribute data and it is very efficient in determining the best possible decision boundary. Random Forest will provide accurate predictions

articleTitle: Hybrid Cipher:AES-RC4 Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents the novel hybrid encryption algorithm based on the combination of strength of Advanced Encryption Standard and Rivest Cipher 4. The substitution- permutation network of AES provides a strong basis for secure encryption and decryption, while the key schedule of RC4 adds simplicity and efficiency to exchange keys. As a result, the hybrid method provides compromise between computational costs and encryption strength. The solution is equipped with design rationale and implementation details, while the security-wise description contains its resistance to known attacks. The performance analysis reveals multiple benefits of the proposed solution, in terms of computational overhead and throughput when compared to other hybrid algorithms. It is a universal solution for secure communication and data protection. This approach is highly innovative and can open further ways for cryptographic techniques, including enhancements to the existing approach.

articleTitle: Dynamic and Transparent Seat Allocation for Indian Railways
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This This paper addresses the issue in booking seats with IRCTC and the TTE abusing their powers illegally. The major problem with the TTE is that he abuses his power by selling the unoccupied seats illegally. This is due to the charts being prepared before the train departs through which the TTEs are aware of the unoccupied seats. This can be overcome by changing the charting system into dynamic. So that the TTE can only see the passenger list of the current station. The TTE application only retrieves the passenger list whose PIN CODE for the station matches with the TTEs PIN CODE through which he will be unaware of the unoccupied. Another problem with the existing system is that the passengers are unable to choose their desired seats in the trains. To overcome this, a layout can be provided to passengers through which they can choose their desired seats. Finally, we propose a system where passengers, after booking a ticket, can transfer it to a relative or friend in the event they are unable to travel due to personal reasons, without the need for cancellation. This approach aims to enhance flexibility and convenience in air travel arrangements, addressing a common issue faced by travelers.

articleTitle: Smart Healthcare Assistant with Epidemiological Modelling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The perpetual threat posed by infectious disease outbreaks necessitates continuous advancements in epidemic modeling and public health interventions. Traditional approaches, while valuable, often face challenges in accurately predicting disease transmission dynamics and informing timely containment strategies.
