In response, this paper proposes a novel hybrid system that integrates established epidemiological models with cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques, including ensemble methods and Generative Al for Natural Language Processing (NLP). This extends beyond epidemic modeling to address healthcare accessibility disparities through the development of a chatbot powered by Language Model (LLM) technology. The chatbot, capable of conversing in native languages, offers medical assistance and addresses health-related queries effectively, thereby bridging gaps in healthcare access. Additionally, sophisticated disease dynamic models and endemic simulators are employed to forecast disease spread accurately, ensuring the availability of healthcare information even in remote areas.

articleTitle: Autonomous coconut tree climber
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Harvesting coconuts is a physically demanding task, particularly when it involves climbing tall areca nut or coconut trees. Along coastal regions where these trees are abundant, the shortage of skilled climbers who can ascend the trees to harvest coconuts has been a significant challenge for coconut planters. Traditionally, experienced climbers have been hired to manually climb the trees and collect the fruit using their hands and legs, a labor-intensive and often risky process. This research project aims to create an innovative solution for harvesting coconut, tailored to the farmers. Climbing coconut trees presents unique challenges due to their tall, solitary trunks, cylindrical shapes, and lack of supporting branches. To address these challenges, this project introduces a robotic coconut tree climber and harvester system. The proposed system consists of a ring-shaped frame with a cutter, designed to securely attach to the coconut tree. This frame also houses a robotic arm (RA) that can be maneuvered to the desired position near the coconut bunches. Once the system is in place, the climber harvests coconuts by slicing through the branch of the coconut that connects the bunches to the tree. This novel approach aims to improve the efficiency and safety of coconut harvesting while reducing reliance on human climbers, thereby addressing both labour shortages and safety concerns in the coconut industry.

articleTitle: MAC AI - Multilingual & Automatic Conversational AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: MAC AI (Multilingual & Automatic Conversational Artificial Intelligence) is a cutting-edge chatbot engineered to transform global communication. Combining real-time language translation with speech-to-text capabilities, MAC AI excels in breaking down linguistic barriers using advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Its integration of speech recognition allows for seamless processing and translation of spoken language into various target languages. Furthermore, MAC AI’s sophisticated NLP algorithms enable contextually accurate interactions, making it an essential tool in international customer service, commerce, and cross-cultural communication. By leveraging the latest AI technologies, MAC AI represents a significant advancement in making technology more accessible and efficient for diverse linguistic needs, redefining the landscape of AI-driven communication.

articleTitle: Parallel Array of Supercapacitors for Storing and Releasing Energy From Regenerative Braking in Electric and Hybrid Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach utilizing a parallel connection Supercapacitor array to optimize energy storage and release during regenerative braking in electric and hybrid vehicles. Traditional energy storage systems often rely on batteries, which have limitations in terms of cycle life, heating issues and efficiency, especially in high-power, short-duration applications like regenerative braking. Supercapacitors can act as an alternative solution for storing power generated from regenerative braking operations due to their long life cycle and rapid charge/discharge capabilities. The Supercapacitors when connected in Parallel connection form the total capacitance is the sum of capacitance of each Super-capacitor connected in parallel with it, This can increase the overall capacitance and keeps the voltage level constant. The circuit analysis for this Research is simulated using Proteus Software proving insights for the feasibility for potential increase in higher capacitance rating by connecting them in parallel to improve the vehicles performance characteristics and offering a extended battery life by reducing the load on it by the use of Supercapacitors and to implement this concept in Hybrid and Electric Vehicles.

articleTitle: Machine Intelligence and IOMT Based Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: cardiac failure (HF) is a severe condition that can result from a number of different cardiac conditions. Patients with HF have wildly varying mortality rates, anywhere from 5% to 75%, depending on their prognosis. Assessing the overall mortality rate of HF patients is a crucial strategy for reducing premature deaths and improving health outcomes. The healthcare business and the early prediction of disease diagnosis have benefited greatly from IoMT and ML in present. Heart disease has always been leading killers. In light of this, this work proposes a multi-stage technique employing IoMT and ML for cardiac illness identification using both visual and numerical cues. In the first stage, features are extracted using transfer learning trained on a CNN. The best features are chosen in the second stage by employing one of three techniques: distributed-stochastic neighbour embedding (t-SNE), F-score/correlation-based feature-selection (CFS). The final step in cardiac patient diagnosis involves averaging the results from three different classifiers: the Gaussian-Bayes (GB), support-vector-machine (SVM), and random-forest (RF). The outcomes were tested using the aforementioned UCI datasets. Performance is shown to have increased in comparison to other approaches.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture-Based Virtual Mouse with Advanced Controls Using OpenCV and Mediapipe
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Hand Gesture presents a gesture-controlled virtual mouse system that uses computer vision and hand-tracking techniques to provide advanced user interactions with a computer. This is done by tracking the user’s hand movements in real-time, using OpenCV and Mediapipe, interpreting certain gestures as moving the cursor, scrolling, left-clicking, or right-clicking on the mouse. This application captures the hand movements by using system webcam. It involves recognizing finger positions in a pose and hand landmarks so as to execute relevant mouse commands. It is an approach that makes it possible for one to use their personal computer without touching it. This will enhance both accessibility and user experience. The application is wide-ranging such as touchless interfaces, interactivity tools for people with disabilities and inventive human-computer.

articleTitle: Smart Light Illumination
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Street light ensures nocturnal safety for drivers, pedestrians, and cyclists. It plays a pivotal role in fostering a secure and comfortable environment. The malfunctioning of these lights poses a significant risk of road accidents. In response to this, Smart Light Illumination System is proposed, representing a technologically advanced framework for automatic control mechanisms and to implement fault detection protocols for street lamps. Leveraging Light-Dependent Resistor(LDR) sensor, the smart street light system monitors ambient lighting conditions, dynamically regulating street lamps’ ON/OFF status based on real-time weather assessments. In residential areas, a motion sensor is employed to continuously monitor the surroundings for motion and activates street lights when motion is detected, optimizing energy efficiency. On highways, Infrared (IR) sensors detect vehicle presence through infrared radiation monitoring. The sensors interface with the Pico W to dynamically adjust street light brightness and activate lights based on real-time movement detection. The system optimizes energy efficiency by dimming lights during periods of inactivity. A pivotal feature is advanced fault detection capabilities. In the event of a malfunction, the system identifies the fault and generates a notification message. Users will get access to a dedicated website to monitor real-time functionalities and identify any malfunctions promptly.

articleTitle: BCI based Ambient Assisted Living (AAL) of Lock-in-Syndrome (LIS)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Prevalence of disability among people is rising globally as a result of ageing, drug overdoses, and other calamities. Communicating with people happens to be necessary and indispensable where people affected by Locked in Syndrome (LIS) is deprived of. LIS prevails to be erratic neurological syndrome where the lower brain and its brain stem is heavily damaged due to any accidents or even over dosage of drug intake. LIS is classified into three based on their effects. They are classic LIS, incomplete LIS, total or complete LIS. In which the lower portion of the brain and brainstem is damaged. The person with locked in syndrome is completely aware of the surroundings and remains conscious. The proposed system uses electroencephalogram (EEG) signals to enable Brain Computer Interface (BCI). The EEG signal is extracted from the brain using OpenBCI EEG acquisition equipment. The Steady State Visual Evoked Potential (SSVEP) and an Event Related Potential (ERP) component, P300 are extracted from the digital EEG signal and classified using software. These patterns are used to pass commands to the software model. This enables communication between affected individuals and fellow human beings. In this paper a promising methodology for a BCI based communication system enabling the locked-in syndrome affected people to communicate with others effectively by using the EEG signal is developed.

articleTitle: Autonomous Solid Waste Collector
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: We proposed an autonomous solid waste collection system which functions with the aid of hydropower and is possible to gather solid trash in water terrains. High efficiency in collecting rubbish since the boat is turned on and off using a wireless controller and conveyer belt. Every nation works to preserve the environment and guarantee that everyone lives in a clean and healthy environment. Managing the trash that is produced and accumulates in land and water bodies, which constitute a serious threat to the environment, is one of the key elements that can assist this effort. One major benefit of using autonomous robots for repetitive jobs is their high efficiency. Numerous robots have recently been created to gather rubbish independently in both land and aquatic environments. The objective of our research is to develop an autonomous waste collection robot for water terrain that can effectively gather rubbish. This design is inexpensive, lightweight, and self-governing. By doing this, productivity will rise and the cost of building two separate robots will be reduced to one. The project fulfills the following four Sustainable Development Goals: sustainable cities and communities, climate action, life on land, and life below water.

articleTitle: Detecting Plant Leaf Diseases with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Deployment via Hugging Face
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Ensuring food security relies heavily on agriculture, and any threat to crop health can significantly impact local economies and populations. Detecting and addressing plant diseases early poses a challenge for farmers. This study presents a novel approach for identifying leaf diseases in plants, focusing specifically on tomato and potato leaves. A deep learning model using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) was developed with 91% accuracy to recognize up to 13 different diseases affecting these plants. The dataset used includes high-resolution images of both healthy and diseased leaves, enabling precise classification. The model is deployed on Hugging Face, making it accessible and scalable for real-time applications in assisting farmers and agricultural specialists with disease detection and prevention. This solution enhances crop health monitoring, leading to improved agricultural productivity and reduced pesticide usage, contributing to precision agriculture and sustainable farming practices.

articleTitle: Smart Accident Prevention at Hairpin Bends Using Sensor-Based System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Accidents are repeated in many countries and people suffer. Mountain roads and the curved ones are among those that have accidents frequently. In these conditions there are roads which have sharp turns and as a result the driver has no visibility of the vehicles in the opposite lane. These are the places where everyone needs to be careful and intelligent enough. This problem is to inform the driver about the problem causing the object in the opposite direction. This can be achieved by installing an ultrasonic sensor on one side of the road before the curve, and positioning an LED light and buzzer on the opposite side after the curve. When a vehicle is detected by the sensor, the LED light and buzzer will be activated on the other side of the road.

articleTitle: "Autohaul-Automated Mine Haulage System And Its Process"
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Auto-Dumper Retrofit System presents an advanced technological solution aimed at automating essential vehicle functions in mining haulage operations. This system utilises IoT-enabled actuators to control steering, acceleration, and braking, directed by a network of strategically positioned poles serving as communication nodes. These poles, equipped with LoRa transmitters, broadcast identification signals to vehicles, whose LoRa receivers then retrieve real-time operational commands from a centralised database. The integration of LIDAR for high-precision obstacle detection, Neo 6M GPS for accurate positioning, and ADXL 335 accelerometers for dynamic behaviour monitoring ensures comprehensive navigation and stability control. The use of LoRaWAN technology facilitates robust, long-range communication, enabling continuous data flow and operational command execution. This system effectively addresses operational disruptions and workforce limitations, ensuring uninterrupted, efficient, and safe haulage operations. Through the amalgamation of advanced automation and reliable communication technologies, the Auto-Dumper Retrofit System enhances productivity, safety, and operational stability in the mining sector.

articleTitle: Sustainable Innovation at the Intersection of Nanotechnology and Biological Science: Thiophene-Functionalized Nanomaterials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rapid advancement of nanotechnology and its integration with biological sciences has opened new avenues for sustainable innovation. Thiophene-functionalized nanomaterials, characterized by their unique electronic properties and environmental stability, have emerged as promising candidates in this multidisciplinary field. These materials offer significant potential in various applications, including biosensing, drug delivery, and environmental remediation, due to their ability to interact at the molecular level with biological systems. This paper explores thiophene-based nanomaterials' synthesis, functionalization, and potential applications, emphasizing their role in promoting sustainability. By leveraging the unique characteristics of thiophene moieties, these nanomaterials present a pathway to address current challenges in environmental and biomedical fields. Integrating nanotechnology with biological science through thiophene-functionalization enhances nanomaterials' performance and aligns with the principles of green chemistry, offering a sustainable approach to Innovation.

articleTitle: Study of Deep Learning Algorithm for Uncovering Deep Fakes in Online Networking Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The vital domain of using sophisticated deep learning approaches to counter deep fakes in online networking platforms is explored in this paper. The project seeks to construct a robust deep fake detection model by using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to mimic deep fake production and by employing the feature extraction capabilities of Inception ResNetV2. To combat adversarial strategies used in complex deep fake creation, the suggested model is fine-tuned after extensive training and assessment. The research provides a solid method for differentiating between real and fake material, which enhances the security of online networking sites. In addition, the advice for deployment and insights into adversarial methods provide a complete strategy to tackle the growing danger of deep fakes online.

articleTitle: Development of the Future Wireless Network Using Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: CRN (cognitive radio network) system works based on the wireless network system. The various kinds of properties of CRN has been highlighted in the study. The process of the implication of the study and the crash of the WSN (wireless network system) is also discussed in the study. The pros and the cons of using the wireless network to use the cognitive radio are also highlighted. Moreover, the problem and the problems of the use of wireless networks in the CRN (cognitive radio network) are also highlighted in the given study.

articleTitle: Stats Analysis Using Cricalyst
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Cricket is a widely celebrated and inherently unpredictable sport, influenced by numerous variables such as player performance, team strategies, weather conditions, and pitch characteristics. To enhance decision-making processes, both teams and fans are increasingly turning to predictive analysis models to anticipate match outcomes, player performances, and key game events. This research project aims to develop a ML model capable of accurately predicting various aspects of cricket matches using historical data. The goal is to establish a unified platform for comprehensive statistical analysis related to cricket. This platform will not only assist teams in refining their strategies across all formats of the game but also aid in forming competitive teams for fantasy cricket.

articleTitle: Dynamic Wireless Electric Vehicle Charging System With Integration of Square Coils and Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research focuses on developing a dynamic wireless charging system for electric vehicles (EVs) that enables in-motion charging via multiple copper coils embedded in roadways. Utilizing magnetic resonance-based wireless power transfer (WPT), the system achieves high efficiency in both stationary and dynamic scenarios, eliminating the need for conventional charging stations. Key innovations include the integration of square coils, which enhance energy transfer by improving flux linkage, alignment tolerance, and magnetic field uniformity. This design reduces magnetic field leakage, enhancing safety and minimizing electromagnetic interference. Additionally, the system integrates solar panels to generate renewable energy, supporting sustainable transportation by reducing reliance on fossil fuels. The proposed infrastructure is designed for easy integration with existing road systems, offering a practical solution to extend EV range and alleviate range anxiety. By enabling seamless, on-the-go charging, this project aims to revolutionize EV charging infrastructure, promoting broader adoption of electric vehicles and contributing to a more sustainable future.

articleTitle: Integrating Wind Energy Systems In Fishing Boats
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The integration of innovative turbine technologies into electric boats significantly enhances sustainability and energy efficiency. This study presents a dual-turbine approach employing a vertical axis turbine and a Savonius turbine to harness wind and propeller-induced turbulent energy, respectively. The vertical axis turbine, combining Darrieus and Savonius blades, is strategically mounted to capture wind energy from all directions, even at low speeds. Concurrently, a Savonius turbine positioned behind the boat’s propeller converts the propeller’s rotational energy into additional mechanical energy. Both turbines generate electrical energy stored in the boat’s battery system, supplementing the primary power supply and reducing reliance on traditional diesel engines. This dual-turbine system maximizes energy recovery, providing a renewable and sustainable energy source that enhances the vessel’s overall operational efficiency. The proposed system underscores significant advancements in green marine technology, contributing to the broader goals of environmental sustainability and energy efficiency in maritime operations

articleTitle: MedNexus- Automated medication aid for elderly and visually impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today’s world, providing medication and healthcare to elderly and visually impaired people (VIP) presents significant challenges due to their need for independence and the management of chronic health conditions. Regular visits to healthcare centers can be very challenging for elderly individuals and specially abled patients residing in rural areas due to disabilities and long travel distances. This project is an innovative mobile application combined with IoT technology designed to address these challenges. MedNexus offers a comprehensive health monitoring and reminder system, providing timely medication alerts through an IoT-based system. The application includes a feature for emergency alerts, which notifies caretakers in case of any health abnormalities detected by connected smartwatches. These smartwatches continuously monitor the user’s health parameters, and any deviation from normal values triggers an alert. It also incorporates Quick Response (QR) code technology to improve the accessibility and organization of medical data. Patients can store their medical records and can generate a smart card, featuring a QR code, which can be conveniently accessed through asmartphone. This feature allows secure sharing and access to health information and reports by healthcare providers, ensuring that patient data is readily available during emergencies or routine check-ups. MedNexus aims to reduce the load on elderly and rural patients by offering a reliable, easy-to-use solution for health monitoring and management. By integrating advanced IoT technology and QR code functionality. MedNexus provides a seamless and effective healthcare experience, encouraging better health results and elevating the overall standard of life for elderly and visually impaired individuals.

articleTitle: MDR: Smart Medicine Dispensing Rover
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rapid advancement in healthcare and medical practices presents a challenging landscape for technology to keep pace with. Innovations, such as the Medicine Dispensing Rover, embody a response to this challenge, offering a technologically advanced solution to support and enhance the evolving demands of the healthcare industry. The document discusses the development of a Smart Medicine Dispensing Rover, which is an advanced medication management system integrating robotics, RFID technology, and IoT capabilities. The system aims to enhance the accuracy, security, and efficiency of medication dispensing in healthcare settings. This research work utilizes a mobile rover controlled through a Blynk app, facilitating seamless and controlled access to patient-specific medications. The system incorporates RFID tags, LEDs, and a buzzer to accurately identify patients, provide visual indications of accessible compartments, and raise alerts in case of unauthorized access, thus minimizing potential medication errors.

articleTitle: Fog Penetration Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Natural phenomena such as fog, snow, haze, and sun glare can be dangerous for drivers with mobile systems. The use of traditional surveillance systems like cameras and Li-DARs is ineffective in these conditions as these systems cannot penetrate deep through the fog. It is observed that the millimeter wave radar technology has the ability to work at night and penetrate through fog, smoke, and dust. This study focuses on integrating radar with certain peripherals to identify the obstacles in poor weather conditions through enhanced visibility and serve as an intelligent accident prevention system. The radio waves (range 94GHz) obtained from the radar are used to determine the movement and distance of objects under the condition of heavy fog. This data information is transmitted to the drivers through LoRaWan which transmits data even in the absence of network connectivity. This technology supports increasing visibility and ensures safety driving in adverse weather conditions.

articleTitle: Hybrid Sustainable Green Energy for Domestic Applications Solar Powered Active Noise Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Our project introduces an Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) system tailored for confined spaces, addressing the adverse effects of noise pollution on comfort and well-being. Unlike passive methods, ANC actively counters ambient noise in real-time using strategically placed microphones and compact circuitry to generate anti-noise signals. These signals, synchronized and delivered via speakers, effectively cancel out the original noise, significantly reducing perceived noise levels. Harnessing solar energy for power, the system promotes environmental sustainability and reduces dependence on conventional energy sources. By integrating principles like destructive interference and phase inversion, our ANC system offers a quiet and comfortable acoustic environment conducive to improved communication and overall well-being. This innovative approach meets the demand for efficient noise cancellation while prioritizing sustainable practices in technology development.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Smart Metering System with Smart 2560
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The main goal of this paper is to create a smart energy meter system by utilizing Internet of Things (IoT) and the Arduino Mega microcontroller. The goal is to develop a practical and effective real-time energy management and monitoring system. The Arduino Mega serves as the project's core processing unit for data collecting and communication, and sensors are used to measure electricity usage. Real-time monitoring of electricity consumption is made possible by the technology, giving consumers precise insights into their usage patterns. Enhancing the energy meter's overall performance by processing and controlling data efficiently with the help of the robust Arduino Mega microcontroller. By improving accessibility and convenience, integration with IoT enables users to remotely access and operate the energy meter via a web or mobile interface. Through the identification and highlighting of high-energy consumption regions, the system encourages energy conservation by empowering users to make decisions that will lessen their influence on the environment. Enabling consumers to establish preferences or receive notifications based on their energy usage, as well as showing pertinent data, is all made possible via an intuitive interface.

articleTitle: Malignant Melanoma Holmes Spot Derma System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The skin is the largest organ in the human body and has numerous potential abnormalities. Malignant melanoma is a deadly form of skin cancer that requires early detection and accurate classification for successful treatment. Exposure to ultraviolet light leads to the development of melanoma is intensively acute and complex. Umbilical cord blood can also be used to fight against cancer cells. It utilizes machine learning techniques for diagnosing melanomas, by identifying skin patterns like radial, vertical, color variations etc from the obtained images. This technique includes deep learning algorithms to achieve a great number of accuracy to recognize patterns.

articleTitle: Pipe Inspection and Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Automating the movement of waste from collection locations to central processing facilities is possible through the use of sophisticated pneumatic waste conveying systems (PWCS). By doing away with the requirement for conventional waste collection trucks, this technology reduces its negative effects on the environment and boosts productivity. Smart Sensors and Monitoring: Adding smart sensors to PWC's network and at waste collection locations. By giving real-time fill level data, these sensors enable preventative maintenance and optimised waste transportation routes. Automated Sorting and Recycling: Modern technology is installed in central waste processing facilities to enable automated sorting and recycling. By doing this, trash sent to landfills is reduced and recycling rates are maximised by effectively separating recyclables and non-recyclables.

articleTitle: Iot Based Monitoring of Air and Water Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The main cause of our environment's degradation is and continues to be industrial pollution, which has an impact on the water we drink, air breathed or soil that we inhabit. However, water pollution is perhaps the greatest threat to mankind's present welfare. In the world of social welfare economics, environment pollution is an external factor. An externality exists when reali, i.e. nonmonetary, variables are included in the utility and production relationships of individual. An externality can either be harmful or beneficial. Some of the negative externalities that can affect the utility functions of people living in a neighborhood include the noise pollution from aircrafts at airports. Also, the pollution of a river can affect the water supply operations of agricultural and industrial areas. This study is focused on the collision of water pollution in the Noyyal River basin, in the places Karur, Erode, and Coimbatore districts. The health status of villagers, agriculture and livestock populations is at the centre of this study. To this end, 31 villages and 600 households were chosen to the subject of a primary survey. Three major health camps have been organized in order to understand the extent of collision of water pollution on the health status of the villagers. The study showed that almost all of the 31 sampled villages had been impacted by industrial wastes. A common verification by the medical team was health problems such as skin allergy, respiratory infection, general allergy and ulcers. In the areas of health, agriculture, livestock and drinking water, the impact of the water pollution has a significant affect on the rural community.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Enabled Graph Database for Complex Queries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The ability to comprehend and react to intricate logical questions is essential for the development of artificial intelligence. With the aid of an advanced query engine, graph store, and embedded store, this paper presents a novel method for answering complex logical queries by fusing deep learning techniques with intricate query processing and graph traversal patterns. The fundamental aspect of our methodology involves the smooth incorporation of graph traversal algorithms and deep learning models into a resilient query engine. In order to model the relationships and dependencies within the data and capture both the local and the global structures from the knowledge graph, we utilize a neural graph network architecture that combines Graph Neural Networks and Recurrent Neural Network. In order to extract semantic features and break down the query into its fundamental parts, the system encrypts the input first using a transformer-based model. A high-performance graph store knowledge graph is mapped onto these elements. In order to create logical paths required for query resolution, a graph traversal algorithm that has been refined through reinforcement learning investigates pertinent nodes and edges. Utilizing attention mechanisms to prioritize important nodes and edges during traversal, our approach includes a novel query processing pattern that uses attention mechanisms to prioritize important nodes and edges during traversal.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technique for Medicinal Plant Leaf Identification: Using Fine-Tuning of Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Ayurvedic medicines are used to treat various acute and chronic conditions with minimal side effects. They have played a significant role in global health systems. Numerous health issues, including pneumonia, cancer, diabetes mellitus, heart disease, asthma, hypertension, and others, can be naturally treated using plants. Because of their diverse pharmacological characteristics, plants rich in bioactive phytomedicine components, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and polyphenols, are widely used to treat disorders. India is renowned for its rich medicinal plants repository, with ayurvedic medicinal practices considered a “living tradition.” Their identification is a manual and time-consuming process, often requiring extensive knowledge of Ayurvedic and botanical classification. Thus,aiming to automate the identification of medicinal plants, our system utilizes a ResNet-18 model to extract key features from plant images, achieving high accuracy in identifying plant species. This method simplifies identification and also broadens the reach of traditional medicine knowledge.

articleTitle: Advancement in Optical Communication: Performance Comparision between Laser and LED Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Visible Light Communication [VLC] has been a prominent area of research for years now. While LEDs have traditionally been employed for both illumination and communication, the following research focuses on the potential advantages of lasers in terms of signal strength, data transmission rates, and overall success in underwater environments. The analysis investigates the use of laser technology in optical underwater communication systems, presenting a comparative study against conventional LED-based Li-Fi systems. The study involves the design and testing of small-scale prototypes, alongside detailed simulations, to evaluate the performance of both light sources under varying aquatic conditions. The results are analyzed to determine the feasibility of large-scale implementation. The findings of this study propose an innovative approach to underwater communication, advancing the understanding mechanism of laser technology which can enhance Li-Fi systems for broader applications

articleTitle: Design of Dual band slot loaded Microstrip Patch Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This work shows a dual band rectangular patch antenna with micro strip line. The suggested antenna has a dimension of size 33 x 27 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and is constructed on a FR4 substrate. A dual band printed antenna is created by introducing wing shape slots and rectangular slots in the radiating element of the patch .The antenna is designed to operate at dual band of frequencies at 1.6/2.2 GHz bands for C band and Wi-Fi/WiMax applications. The results obtained for return loss is –11.88dB at 1.6 GHz with 3.5% bandwidth and - 13.12 dB at 2.2 GHz with 3.6% bandwidth. The suggested antenna also exhibits strong radiation properties and steady gains across the entire operating band spectrum.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Automated Attendance System Using Contactless Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's digital age, facial recognition technology holds significant importance across various industries. While it may not boast the same level of accuracy as iris or fingerprint recognition, its widespread adoption is largely due to its non-intrusive and contactless nature. Moreover, facial recognition systems offer a promising solution for streamlining attendance procedures in educational institutions, offices, and other settings. By automating the attendance process, these systems alleviate the time-consuming and burdensome nature of manual tracking while also mitigating the risk of proxy attendance. Essentially, the objective of such a system is to leverage facial detection and recognition algorithms to identify students as they enter the classroom, thereby seamlessly marking their attendance. Libraries such as OpenCV and face_recognition were utilized. The system integrates ESP32 and ESP32-CAM hardware components to capture facial images in real- time, ensuring a seamless and efficient attendance-taking process. Using the Python OpenCV library, an accurate and reliable facial recognition algorithm has been developed, enabling the system to accurately identify and authenticate students. Attendance data is securely stored and managed in a cloud-based database, facilitating real-time access for teachers and students to monitor attendance records. A user-friendly application is designed to provide teachers with attendance management capabilities and students with the ability to track their attendance history, enhancing transparency and engagement in the educational process. The objectives were to enhance recognition accuracy, securely store student data, and ensure system compatibility. The outcomes include improved accuracy, contactless attendance logging, secure data storage, scalability, efficiency gains, and comprehensive documentation.

articleTitle: Optimizing Solar Energy Forecasting: A Comparative Study of ARIMA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study focuses on improving the accuracy of forecasts for daily, weekly, and monthly average solar energy generation through a detailed comparative analysis across multiple states, including Tamil Nadu, Delhi, Rajasthan and Assam using the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model. Solar power predictions that are on point are important for smart grid management and green energy plans as the demand for renewable energy sources rises. For the study, a sizable dataset containing historical information on daily solar energy generation is gathered. First, the classic ARIMA model is applied to the dataset in order to identify temporal trends and patterns.The study's ultimate objective is to shed light on the advantages and disadvantages of various forecasting techniques, enabling lawmakers and energy planners to make well-informed choices about the integration of solar energy into the electrical grid.The findings are expected to improve solar energy projections, allowing for a smoother transition to a more robust and sustainable energy environment.

articleTitle: Design of Pipeline Crack Detection Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Pipe networks face leakages that can lead to injuries, financial loss, and sometimes real disasters. In case of a water pipeline leakage or any gas leakage, may lead to a drain of valuable resources. The nearly used methodology to survey pipelines internally is PIG (Pipeline Inspection Gadget) which executes tasks such as pipeline geometry inspection, leak detection, or any obstacle detection. Thus, they require large amounts of energy to move and may struggle to form a stable platform for the necessary sensors for inspection, so a non-destructive pipe leakage detecting robot is designed to detect the leaks with the help of ultrasonic sensors. Its six-wheel design ensures optimal movement within gas pipelines while integrating a LoRa module enables seamless control for forward and backward movements. This innovative approach enhances leak detection accuracy and reduces product loss due to cracks and leakages, significantly improving pipeline safety and maintenance protocols.

articleTitle: Autonomous Fire Fighting Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: An autonomous firefighting robot is a hardware model used to extinguish the fire automatically during fire accidents. The robot is developed with the lot of feature under which it can move towards the direction of fire with the high intensity against it. The heat varies the temperature-sensing capability of the robot. Where there is no access for humans to go far to rescue people in case of an accident due to fires, these robots also play the role of substituting humans by rescuing people. Still, the most important advantage of this robot is that, via flame (or fire) sensors placed around the robot, it can turn on automatically, detecting the fire around its surroundings, and would try to quench the fire moving in the direction of the fire which is detected by the sensors. Autonomous, firefighting robots are a huge development in fire safety technology. Through the integration of cutting-edge sensors and smart algorithms, besides autonomous functionality, the robots can take firefighting operations to a new level and save human lives in emergencies.

articleTitle: Levenberg-Marquardt NN-Based Machine Learning Algorithm for DC Drive Control in Agricultural Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The adoption of DC drives in agricultural applications addresses the need for efficient, precise, and reliable control of machinery, contributing to the advancement of modern farming techniques and sustainable agricultural practices. To meet these needs, the proposed system utilizes a solar-powered Cuk converter driving a DC motor. This system is designed to achieve the desired speed in the DC motor using the Levenberg-Marquardt Neural Network-Based Machine Learning Algorithm. By employing this algorithm, time-domain parameters such as rise time, peak time, and settling time for achieving the desired speed are reduced compared to those obtained using traditional Proportional-Integral (PI) controllers.

articleTitle: The Development of a Unified, Intelligent and Secure ATM Card to Manage Multiple Bank Accounts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The idea behind creating a single ATM card for several bank accounts is to provide customers with multiple bank accounts with greater convenience when banking. Unlike the conventional method of carrying numerous ATM cards, this solution aims to remove the requirement for users to carry several cards and memorize distinct PINs. By combining several account details onto a single card, the suggested design enables users to access their money from any of their connected bank accounts with a single ATM card. The paper specifies the creation of a safe, dependable, and user-friendly system capable of handling various bank account details and transactions. This paper describes the design and implementation of the suggested solution, including the advantages of a single ATM card system. The Arduino Uno microcontroller is utilized for implementation. Once the ATM card is inserted, the machine will demand for a fingerprint. If the fingerprint matches, the display will reveal all linked bank accounts. After selecting a bank, the user’s mobile number will be sent an OTP. The user can specify the desired amount to be collected.

articleTitle: AI Based on Inception v3 Architecture for Fault Diagnosis in paddy crop using image recognition and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Plant diseases is a serious effect that greatly affects crop yield due to these diseases. The optimal diagnosis of this plant disease will prevent us from the loss in crop yield. In analyzing automatic diagnosis of the plant, disease by implementing a smartphone application established. Artificial intelligence is used is machine learning framework to detect the plant disease in time. The basic preventive measure taken using machine learning algorithms that works on an example model in which the module integrated to predict the plant diseases. The proposed structure uses a tuned Inception v3 architecture, which is a typical deep convolutional neural network with multiple convolution layers, consisting of nearly 6 convolution layers. This architecture, which use for classifying the plant disease, supports nearly 12 layers whose performance is an outstanding one for image network. The result shows that this model built using this Framework works very well in timely diagnosis of the plant diseases. Places like the learning rate position f- measure recall and disease recognition with accuracy performances investigated. Total accuracy attained using the built model is 76.56 % with maximum area of the curve.

articleTitle: Deepfake Circumvention Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Deepfake is an AI-based technology that creates videos which are quite genuine but fake, and propagates massive threats to media credibility and public trust. This paper presents a new deepfake detection system that employs the Vision Transformer (ViT) model that can be easily accessed through web interface built with Streamlit. The strategy is aimed at differentiating fake and original video content with a high degree of efficiency, thus offering the efficient tool for real-time content verification. The addition of confidence scores improves interpretability of the system and as such ideal for application in media authenticity and countering fake news. The platform is easy to use with further plans to enhance the features of the platform such as; ability to notify authorities automatically, real-time video processing, ability to work with multiple languages and ways to share the content through Social media, to add to its uses in protecting the content.

articleTitle: Feast (Food Emergency Acquired Service Tracker)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The main idea of this project is to create a win-win situation i.e. reducing food waste while helping individuals or organizations access fresh and nutritious food. The motivation for doing it is because of the economic Savings. Reducing food waste can lead to cost savings for both businesses and individuals. This innovative project aims to create a user-friendly website that addresses the critical issue of food waste by connecting surplus food providers, such as restaurants, grocery stores, and event venues, with individuals and organizations in need of food assistance .The concept behind food waste reduction systems, such as apps and platforms, is to tackle the problem of food waste by connecting surplus food providers with individuals or organizations who can use that excess food. This project is a proactive response to the pressing issue of food waste in our community.

articleTitle: Ethereum Smart Contract in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: “Ethereum Smart Contracts: Transparency and Efficiency Revolution in Supply Chain Management”. The revolutionary effect of incorporating Ethereum Smart Contracts into supply chain management procedures is examined in this abstract. Ethereum smart contracts improve supply chain transparency, traceability, and trust by utilizing blockchain technology. These smart contracts optimize overall efficiency by reducing the risk of fraud and errors through the automation and execution of specific contractual agreements. Because Ethereum is decentralized, information may move freely throughout the supply chain network and is protected from tampering. This abstract explores the advantages of reduced costs, more stakeholder engagement, and real-time visibility. The paper also highlights the paradigm change that Ethereum smart contracts bring to conventional supply chain approaches, discussing potential obstacles and suggesting solutions.

articleTitle: Advanced Gas Accident Prevention System with an In-Built Fire Extinguisher
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The necessity of managing the dangers of chemical exposure, fire, and explosion has increased as a result of industrial accidents. In the chemical industry, process flaws or human error often result in accidents despite the precautions taken to prevent them. No research has modelled the dangers posed by dangerous material leaks in gas pressure reduction stations, despite the fact that numerous studies have been done on mishaps in the process industry. An investigation was conducted into the aftermath of the gas leak and fire at the gas station and industries. The purpose of this study is to ascertain the station's safe operating range and to monitor the safety precautions needed for gas stations located all throughout the nation. The main cause of the numerous incidents that are happening in residential areas is LPG leaks. For a variety of reasons, accidents frequently happen when a resident is not in the kitchen. To prevent such mishaps, an effective method is needed. This study provides an answer to it. Before inflicting harm to the residences, it is imperative to adequately control the risk when leaking occurs. The gas cylinder valve in this suggested system automatically shuts off when a leak is detected, notifying the user right away. If a fire breaks out, a fire extinguisher is activated automatically as well. Such a system's primary goals are to protect the house from intruders and fire as well as to stop significant gas accidents from happening in gas stations and companies. Wireless sensors are becoming more and more integrated into smart home security systems for this reason. This study presents the design of a unique gas-fire security system intended for residential use.

articleTitle: Efficient MPPT-integrated high-frequency inverter for sustainable wireless EV charging systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Traditional internal combustion (IC) vehicles are being replaced by modern electric vehicles (EVs) to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. However, EV charging is still heavily dependent on the utility grid, which, in developing countries like India, largely relies on coal-fired power generation, indirectly contributing to GHG emissions. To achieve a truly sustainable and green energy solution, it is essential to adopt alternative energy sources for EV charging. While most studies have focused on integrating photovoltaic (PV) systems with the grid or using energy storage elements alongside the grid for EV charging, this article presents a different approach. It introduces a grid-independent, solar-based wireless EV charging system that utilizes an efficient MPPT-integrated high-frequency inverter. The system integrates solar MPPT with a T-type inverter designed for wireless charging, operating at a resonant frequency of 85 kHz with a power output of 3.3 kW. The proposed MPPT-integrated T-type inverter for wireless EV charging has been thoroughly simulated in MATLAB/Simulink, and a 3.7 kW hardware prototype has been developed to validate the system's performance in real-time. This innovative approach offers a sustainable and efficient solution for wireless EV charging, independent of traditional grid power sources.

articleTitle: Harnessing the potential of conversational AI: A Roadmap for Academic Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Academic institutions rely on classroom timetables for smooth functioning of classes. Creating timetables, manually, is a time-intensive process. An attempt is made to automate, or semi-automate the process of timetable preparation in the proposed work using conversational AI tool prompts. The prompts can be adjusted to best fit the needs of timetable generation. Another use case discussed in the work is related to summarization of large reports using conversational AI tools. ChatGPT and Claude AI have been utilized to test the said use cases. GPT 4 1106 preview version was used for timetable generation while Claude AI 2.1 was used for report summarization in the work. Results indicate good accuracy and relevancy in the AI-generated outputs, suggesting that conversational AI could alleviate academicians' daily workload to certain extent.

articleTitle: E-Smart Health Card System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The growth of emerging markets depends on the healthcare industry. The level of service and simplicity of maintenance determine the effectiveness and dependability of the medical sector. Health records offer a thorough history of the patient, but the data they are related with are unstable and difficult to generate. For this reason, a full stack electronic health record (EHR) application is proposed that enables us to maintain patient health records using a digital card that is only used by the patient, the doctor, the front desk agent, and the authorised authorities. The card has a QR code that may be scanned by patients to read their medical records. With the use of a paperless system and cloud storage, this automates the upkeep of medical records. The card includes a general description of the patient's condition as well as his physical characteristics. The patient may easily carry the card everywhere they go because it is pocket-sized.

articleTitle: Smart Steps : Enhancing Dance Through AI Driven Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The field of dance training and evaluation is vital for dancers to enhance their skills and artistic expression. However, current evaluation methods often rely on subjective assessments, leading to inconsistent and biased evaluations, thereby hindering dancers' ability to assess progress and identify areas for improvement. Furthermore, the lack of objective evaluation methods poses challenges in setting realistic goals and monitoring progress over time. In response to these challenges, this paper proposes an automated system designed to provide accurate and objective evaluations of dancers' performances.Our proposed system utilizes advanced techniques in computer vision and pose extraction to analyse videos of both a dance trainer and a dancer attempting to replicate the trainer’s moves. Key body landmarks are extracted from both videos to represent poses, enabling a detailed comparison between them. The system employs a method of comparing poses by analysing the direction of each limb and computing a percentage match between the poses. The results provide dancers with quantitative feedback on their performance, allowing them to accurately track progress and identify areas for improvement. By providing objective evaluations, our system ensures fair assessments across different dancers, fostering continuous improvement in their skills and artistic expression.

articleTitle: Distribution System Planning through Integrated Distributed Generation using the Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research presents a new & integrated method to tackle the difficulties in distribution planning (DSP). It does this including distributed generation(DG), which promise in areas controlled by distribution utilities. The framework blends advanced optimization techniques with expert knowledge to find the best sizing placement of DG resources. The main goal is to both investment & operational linked to DG deployment. This includes covering system losses while also considering different scenarios. The model is designed to meet rising load demands. Interestingly, the optimized model uses the Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm, which helps achieve accurate & reliable planning results. Through a thorough present worth analysis of various scenarios, this study examines how viable it is to integrate DG as a key strategy for solving DSP issues. Overall, this integrated model contributes significantly to improving distribution system planning and offers a strategic way that merges distributed generation with strict optimization techniques, such as using the Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm effectively.

articleTitle: Advanced Toxic Gas Monitoring and Health Protection System for Sewage Tanks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project Mainly focuses on the design of a toxic gas detection and monitoring system to be implemented for improving safety conditions for sewage workers. The workers in sewage systems are exposed to very dangerous gases like carbon monoxide, hydrogen sulfide, and methane gas in the air, which creates serious health risks that might lead to illness or even death. In this proposed solution, MQ-2, MQ-5, and MQ-7 gas sensors shall be used to detect the concentration of these gases. An analogue signal will be generated by the gas sensor, which is then calibrated and further scaled in parts per million with their characteristic curves provided by the makers of these respective sensors. This data shall be then processed by an Arduino microcontroller and displayed continuously for the levels of the aforementioned gases. If the concentration of excess gas for any gas exceeds the threshold value, the system triggers an alarm to alert the observers to the danger. After processing, the ESP32 wirelessly sends the data to a cloud server, and the data may be monitored from anywhere in the world; necessary actions are taken on time in case hazardous conditions occur. The portable, low-cost, real-time monitoring system shall be integrated into this project so that workers working inside the sewage tanks may be warned in time against hazardous levels of gases in order to avert accidents or health problems.

articleTitle: Employing Seasonal Decomposition for Dynamic Stock Price Predication within the realm of web based application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research endeavor constitutes an intricate fusion of advanced quantitative methodologies within a cutting-edge web-based predictive analytics framework tailored for stock market forecasting. The amalgamation of fundamental analysis metrics encompasses a meticulous examination of financial ratios, earnings reports, and economic indicators, affording a nuanced comprehension of underlying asset valuations. Concurrently, the incorporation of elaborate technical indicators scrutinizes intricate market trends, oscillators, and moving averages, offering a granular perspective on potential entry and exit points for investors. Augmenting this analytical prowess is the integration of sentiment analysis, where OpenAI's state-of-the-art language models decode market sentiment from an expansive corpus of real-time stock news. This linguistic analysis discerns subtle nuances, capturing market sentiment dynamics and providing an additional layer of insight for predictive modelling . Furthermore, the research introduces a pioneering approach to time series analysis, leveraging sophisticated algorithms to dissect historical stock data. This entails the identification of latent patterns, trends, and seasonality, significantly enhancing the temporal dimension of predictive modelling . The holistic synergy of these diverse quantitative models unfolds within a unified web application, constituting a transformative paradigm in algorithmic trading and investment strategies. In conclusion, empirical analyses validate the efficacy of this integrative approach, substantiating its potential to redefine the landscape of predictive analytics within the dynamic and complex milieu of stock market prognostication. This comprehensive platform not only enhances the precision of market predictions but also provides investors and traders with a sophisticated toolkit for navigating the intricacies of modern financial markets with informed and strategic decision-making.

articleTitle: Efficient Boost Integrated High Frequency Inverter based WPT EV Charging system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Conventional IC-based transportation is replaced by modern electric vehicle EVs to limit Greenhouse gas emissions (GHG). However, EV charging is completely dependent on the utility grid. In developing countries like India, major power generation is by burning coal, which is indirectly contributing to GHG. To have completely clean green energy, it is essential to utilize alternate energy resources for charging EV batteries. The articles so far reported are integrating PV and grid or Energy-storing elements with the grid for charging EVs. Here this article proposes a grid-independent solar-based Wireless EV charging system utilizing an integrated boost MPPT controller and T-type inverter. The proposed WPT-based EV charging system integrates the MPPT of solar PV with a high-frequency T-type inverter for wireless charging. The proposed EV charging system is designed for 3.3kW resonating at the frequency of 85 kHz. The designed proposed MPPT integrated T-type inverter for Wireless EV charging system is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink model. A hardware prototype model of the proposed WPT-based EV charging is developed for 3.7kW for real-time validation of the proposed solar MPPT Boost integrated EV charging.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Solar-Powered Bi-Directional Wireless Charging System for Electric Bicycle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Transport is a fundamental requirement of modern life. Petrol or diesel vehicles are highly polluting and are being quickly replaced by fully electric vehicles (EV). However, grid supply is utilized to charge the EV, which indirectly lagging in the mitigation of harmful gas emission. Which is overcome by employing renewable energy sources such as photovoltaic power generation system, wind energy conversion system, etc., to charge Electric Vehicles (EV). Charging EV with solar provides a sustainable future for transportation. Instead of plugin charging method, wireless charging methods were employed due to its convenience and durability. Main drawback in wireless charging system is reduction of transfer efficiency due to misalignment. In this article LLC compensated resonant wireless power transfer is employed for charging EV and achieved 92.1% of power transfer efficiency with bidirectional power flow for grid integration. The performance of this wireless charging system is simulated using MATLAB Simulink platform, an operation is verified in both forward and reverse power flow. The simulation results were validated with the 500 W hardware prototype wireless charging system for electric bicycle with 24V, 10 Ah li-ion battery.

articleTitle: Seamless Integration of Legacy Industrial Systems with OPC UA for Enhanced Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The integration of legacy systems with modern control technologies is a significant challenge in the digital transformation of industrial environments. Many facilities still rely on outdated equipment that lacks compatibility with contemporary communication standards like OPC UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture). This paper proposes a comprehensive solution to bridge this gap by developing OPC UA wrappers and adapters that facilitate communication between legacy systems and modern control infrastructures. The approach involves translating data from various legacy protocols into the OPC UA format, enabling seamless data exchange and interoperability. A central OPC UA server is implemented to aggregate and normalize data, providing a unified and secure platform for real-time monitoring and control. The proposed solution was evaluated in a simulated industrial environment, demonstrating effective data integration, enhanced performance, robust security, and high operator satisfaction. The results validate the feasibility of using OPC UA to integrate legacy systems, supporting digital transformation and fostering a more connected industrial ecosystem.

articleTitle: IOT Based Smart Lighting and Room Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This aim is to provide automatic, efficient and precise lighting and appliance automation with the help of detection through sensors and app controls using IOT. It makes the operation of light easier and reduces maintenance on electrical like switches. The basic model of this IOT lighting is achieved by using ESP-8266 board and PIR Sensor Module. After the connection and the circuit design, when an object or obstacle is placed in front of the IR sensor, the LED starts glowing. In a confined space or room, this is helpful when the light automatically turns on when person enters the room. Later, the redundant or backup mechanism of Arduino IOT app control is added in the interface. This avoids the risks faced when the sensors doesn’t work under some situations. Also, security protocols are added so that the IoT devices are not misused. The smart lighting is done through machine learning algorithms uploaded on NODEMCU that optimize and reduce the power consumption.

articleTitle: Sinh Cosh optimizer based virtual inertia control of micro grid for frequency regulation improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Frequency regulation of Micro Grid with inclusion of Renewable Energy Sources is a difficult problem due to the low inertia of Micro Grid. Virtual Inertia Control is the idea of escalating MG inertia by Energy Storage Systems. In the existing work a Sine Cosine Hyperbolic Algorithm based controller is proposed for VIC of low inertia MG with RES. Conventional I/PI/PID controllers is used and the controller gains are tuned using SCHA method. The plots with I, PI and PID are compared for different scenarios for frequency regulation. It is demonstrated that, the percentage decline in J value with PID controller related to PI and I controller are 83.17 percent and 90.15 percent respectively under constant load, wind and solar powers. The efficacy of the I, PI and PID controller is also investigated under variable load, solar and wind powers

articleTitle: Boothless Toll Collection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As a developing country, it is critical that we prioritize the construction and improvement of our road infrastructure in order to stimulate economic growth and promote easier logistics operations. However, the current toll collection system is hampered by difficulties such as overcharging and traffic congestion, reducing its effectiveness. To solve these issues, we propose implementing an advanced toll collection system that includes GPS technology, an ANPR camera, and a variety of machine learning algorithms. This new method will transform toll collecting by properly calculating toll charges based on the actual distance traveled by vehicles on the highway, removing the need for drivers to stop at toll booths. The system uses GPS technology to precisely compute the distance traveled by each car, while ANPR cameras guarantee the journey’s validity. As a result, vehicles will only be paid for what distance they have traveled, reducing overcharging concerns and congestion at toll gates. Our major goal is to create a smooth and efficient tolling mechanism that overcomes the limitations of traditional tollgate systems. We hope to improve the toll collection process, shorten wait times, and reduce the consumption of fuel associated with long lines at toll booths by utilizing cutting-edge technologies. By applying this innovative strategy, we hope to improve not only toll collecting efficiency but also commuters' overall driving experience.

articleTitle: Crowd Management using AI & ML
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: India’s urban environments are characterized by large crowds, cultural diversity, and complex work settings, presenting unique challenges in crowd management, crime prevention, and workplace supervision. This research proposes a tailored framework leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies to address these challenges in real-time. In crowded public spaces, where chaotic dynamics and culturally specific activities can create risks, our framework utilizes advanced computer vision to monitor and analyze crowd behavior. This enables authorities to detect anomalies swiftly, ensuring public safety. Predictive analytics, driven by machine learning, anticipate potential issues by analyzing historical data and real-time trends, allowing for culturally sensitive preventive measures. For crime prevention, the framework uses AI algorithms to scrutinize crowd patterns, identifying individuals with known criminal backgrounds. This approach, attuned to India’s cultural nuances, enables preemptive action by law enforcement, enhancing security in public spaces and events. In industrial settings, the framework applies AI-powered surveillance and data analytics to monitor employee activities, ensuring adherence to safety protocols and optimizing workflow efficiency. By integrating these technologies, the framework provides a comprehensive solution for enhancing safety and operational efficiency in India’s diverse urban contexts, fostering a secure and culturally responsive environment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Solar Power Generation Forecasting Using Advanced Machine Learning and Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study aims to enhance the accuracy of solar power generation forecasts by applying advanced machine learning and ensemble methods. The research involves preprocessing historical solar power data, which includes handling missing values, normalizing data, and creating temporal features. Models such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Weighted Ensemble Methods were evaluated based on Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score. The results demonstrated that the Weighted Ensemble method outperformed individual models, achieving an MAE of 0.4472 and RMSE of 0.5227. These findings highlight the potential of ensemble learning techniques to improve the reliability and precision of solar power predictions, which is critical for optimizing grid stability and energy trading in renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Mitigating Environmental Impacts on Optical Fiber Fault Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Fiber optic networks are integral to modern communication systems, offering high-speed data transmission over long distances. However, the performance of these networks can be significantly affected by environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, pressure, and mechanical stress. These factors can alter the physical properties of optical fibers, leading to signal degradation and potentially causing errors in fault detection. This paper investigates the impact of environmental factors on fiber fault detection systems, particularly those utilizing machine learning algorithms. We propose methods to mitigate these effects and enhance detection accuracy. The research is validated through simulations and case studies, providing practical guidelines for deploying fiber fault detection systems in various environmental conditions.

articleTitle: IOT-Based ECG Monitoring System for Remote Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In response to the growing concern over heart health, especially in remote and underserved areas, this work summarizes the IoT-based Electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring system using the ThingSpeak IoT Cloud. The system is designed to facilitate real-time health monitoring, enabling patients in remote villages to access essential heart care without the need of immediate physical access to medical facilities. By leveraging the capabilities of IoT, ECG data is continuously collected from patients, sent to the cloud and can be accessed and analyzed by healthcare professionals in urban centers. This remote monitoring system allows for timely detection and analysis of cardiac conditions, ensuring that patients receive prompt and accurate medical attention. The proposed solution demonstrates the potential of IoT in bridging the healthcare gap between rural and urban areas, offering a scalable and cost-effective approach to managing heart health in resource-limited settings.

articleTitle: Optimizing Renewable Energy Integration through Demand Response Management: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The conventional power system is undergoing substantial changes as a result of incorporating advanced technologies and renewable energy (RE) and energy storage solution. This review explores the Demand Response Management (DRM) approach for enhancing the utilization of RES. DRM techniques, such as dynamic pricing, loads shifting, and demand-side flexibility, are critical for addressing the challenges of integrating RES into the energy grid. By examining a series of case studies, this review evaluates how various DRM strategies have been applied to optimize RES use, focusing on their impact on grid stability, supply-demand balancing, and overall system efficiency. The analysis highlights successful implementations and identifies common challenges, such as managing energy demand fluctuations and coordinating with grid operators. The paper also discusses how DRM can improve the reliability of RES integration by incentivizing user behavior adjustments and leveraging advanced technologies. The results highlight the need for customized DRM solutions to develop a more adaptable and sustainable energy system. These insights offer crucial guidance for policymakers, industry experts, and researchers focused on improving DRM strategies and enhancing the deployment of RES. Overall, this review offers a comprehensive understanding of how DRM techniques can facilitate the transition to a renewable energy future, underscoring their role in building resilient and efficient energy systems.

articleTitle: Towards Resilient Crops: Disease Detection and Pest Control Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A new strategy for resilient crop management that incorporates state-of-the-art technology to combat the ongoing problem of insect infestations in agricultural crops. The suggested system seeks to identify and remove pests and illnesses from fields by using image processing, Internet of Things (IoT), and Deep Learning (DL). Use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) on photos taken by Internet of Things (IoT) devices such as DHT11 sensors and Arduino boards allows the system to quickly and accurately detect and localize impacted regions in real-time. Optimal crop health is achieved via accurate irrigation management made possible by the use of moisture sensors in the soil as well as water motor control. Additionally, farmers are alerted promptly upon pest discovery by rapid notifications enabled by a GSM module and a buzzer, allowing fast response.
