In spite of obstacles like dataset variability and modelling compactness, the MATLAB-implemented system shows potential for strengthening pest management techniques and encouraging resilient crops in agriculture, leading to better yields and more sustainable farming methods.

articleTitle: IoT Based Accident Response System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Our primary objective of accident warning is to ensure the safety of people in system crashes. Vehicle activity and past vehicle movements can be observed and found by the owner through this device. GPS devices are particularly useful nowadays. The risk of human life has increased due to the linear improvement in automobile use over the past decade. The reason why this is happening is because the emergency services are not sufficient. The crash system's emergency system is strengthened through the use of an alert system in this place. The purpose of this system is to notify the medical center nearby of the accident and supply immediate medical aid. Tilt of the vehicle is sensed by the attached accelerometer in the vehicle, and abnormalities are sensed by the heartbeat sensors on the user's body. Arduino works as the central hub of the set-up and facilitates the transfer of messages to various devices within it. Finding the accident scene will be made easier with the help of the GPS system. The geographical coordinates of the area can be covered by sending the location through a tracking system.

articleTitle: Automated Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The proposed Automated Attendance System introduces a comprehensive solution to modernize attendance management processes in educational institutions by leveraging facial recognition technology. The primary objective is to automate the attendance tracking process through precise facial identification, providing a seamless and efficient alternative to conventional manual methods. This system aims to address the inherent challenges associated with traditional attendance-taking procedures, including inaccuracies, time consumption, and susceptibility to fraudulent activities. By harnessing the capabilities of facial recognition technology, students and faculty can benefit from a streamlined and secure attendance recording mechanism. Key features of the proposed system include real-time attendance tracking, enhanced security measures through biometric authentication, seamless integration with existing institutional infrastructure, and customizable settings to accommodate varying organizational requirements. Furthermore, the system prioritizes data privacy imperatives by implementing robust encryption measures and adhering to regulatory standards to safeguard sensitive information.

articleTitle: Real-Time Fault Detection in Electrical Systems Using Machine Learning and Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research explores the application of machine learning and big data analytics for real-time fault detection in electrical systems across multiple industries, including finance, healthcare, and retail. The study evaluates several models, including Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), to detect electrical faults based on parameters such as voltage, current, and power. Descriptive and inferential statistical methods were applied to understand the data distribution and identify key fault indicators. The CNN model demonstrated superior performance with an accuracy of 95%, surpassing other models in detecting non-linear patterns and anomalies in electrical data. Key evaluation metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, confusion matrix, and ROC-AUC, confirmed the robustness of the model. This study illustrates the significant potential of leveraging machine learning for enhancing system reliability, and suggests further research into integrating these models with emerging sensor technologies for improved real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: Enhancing Generator Efficiency: IoT-Based Distilled Water Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In present day instances, electronic devices have emerge as vital in ordinary life [1]. With family appliances and electronic gadgets running constantly, uninterrupted power supply is important. Any strength loss at some stage in tool operation can reason harm. To mitigate such risks, batteries function a backup electricity deliver. This paper proposes a way to control battery voltage the use of Internet of Things (IoT) generation, augmented with MQTT (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport) for more suitable communique performance. The gadget targets to be price-effective, reduce human resource necessities, and enhance time efficiency. It utilizes a voltmeter for tracking battery voltage, Raspberry Pi for information monitoring and updates, Arduino for facts transmission, cloud services for records transmission and garage, and a cellular utility for remote monitoring of battery status. By integrating MQTT generation, this paper discusses the implementation and advantages of the IoT-based battery voltage manipulate system, highlighting the stepped forward communique efficiency and actual-time data shipping. Additionally, the mixing of a mobile software complements person accessibility and comfort, further improving the device’s functionality and relevance in cutting-edge contexts.

articleTitle: A custom PCB integrated safety device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel Arduino-based women’s safety system, enhanced with a custom-designed Printed Circuit Board (PCB) to improve emergency response and location tracking capabilities. When activated, the system swiftly sends an emergency alert, including a "Need Help" message via GSM to designated contacts, along with precise GPS coordinates. The bespoke PCB ensures superior performance, facilitating smooth communication and interaction among all system components, thereby enhancing reliability and reducing response time. The combination of Arduino’s flexibility, GSM’s robust communication, GPS’s precision, and the efficiency of the custom PCB results in a powerful, integrated solution to support women in emergencies. This innovation promises to significantly enhance personal safety, representing a substantial advancement in the technology addressing women’s security concerns.

articleTitle: Smart Park – An Intelligent Parking Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents a smart parking system to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas. It provides real-time information about parking space availability in accordance with various vehicles and their sizes. Using Artificial Intelligence and Machine learning, the system facilitates streamlined vehicular flow and manages parking allotments in commercial spaces. Vehicle detection models deployed across parking facilities provide occupancy data and are used for creating a dynamic feedback loop. This helps in reducing search time and lowering congestion in parking spaces. This provides scalable solutions regarding parking spaces in commercial areas. As a supplementary service, the system would suggest nearby parking spaces in case of unavailability.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Dual Active Bridge DC-DC Converter For Renewable Energy Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this research, Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology works for DC microgrids using a Dual-Active-Bridge (DAB) DC-DC converter. A detailed examination of the converter’s behavior is necessary to enable soft-switching across the whole working range, independent of the battery condition of the electric car, and to assure the stability of the Microgrid voltage port independent of load or generation conditions. Because of this, a battery charger for electric vehicles must be bidirectional and able to source and sink real and reactive power. The most advanced battery charging converter available today is unidirectional and contains several power conversion stages. Functionality of the BDC with filter Comparisons are made between the results of using cascaded filters and filters that are discussed.

articleTitle: Optimizing Vehicle Communication- Alternatives to Horn Use and Signal Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper investigates the antenna type for the usage of 'Signal Horns' as an alternative to 'Sound Horns', that involves V2V communication. The system mainly incorporates an alert system for overtaking that involves lane detection and machine learning techniques to detect the nearest plying vehicle and then with that frequency locking is done, After that, by modifying the Electronic Control Unit (ECU), these horns are designed to receive and send signals among the vehicles using a Microstrip Patch Antenna of the specified. For this proposed system, the Microstrip Patch Antenna fixed in the ECU send and receives signals from one vehicle to another. The design and analysis of two different designs of microstrip patch antenna that is used to send and receive signal horns. Two antenna types were taken, such as E-shaped and circular type, whose results have been analyzed and according to the requirement of the system, with their results being compared, the more advantageous one is designed. aiming to reduce the mentioned risks by adopting proper technologies. In such a way, the E-shaped microstrip patch antenna was designed using MATLAB SIMULINK and their results were interpreted. The gain was found to be and VSWR was obtained to be 1.

articleTitle: Interpretation of Nanostructured Material in Pursuance of solar panel for Improving Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Solar panels show great potential as a long-term solution to the world’s energy problems. Much work has been done recently to enhance solar panels' performance and in a variety of ways, all in an effort to increase their efficiency and enable them to compete with more traditional energy sources. The technology’s main objectives are to lower expenses and boost power conversion efficiency. The emerging field of nanotechnology holds significant promise for enhancing solar panel reliability, longevity, and efficiency. In a variety of ways, nanomaterials can improve solar panel performance in the design phase. Advances in solar panels with nanomaterials have the potential to lower costs and improve power conversion efficiency while increasing the stability of large-scale power generation. The research on solar panels is summed up in this overview, which also covers the several ways that improved nanomaterials have progressed the subject and also describes the impact of such nano materials for harnessing solar energy through the sustainable environment along with its environmental toxicity encompassing the remediation strategies.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency in EV Charging Networks Through Smart Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper explores how electric vehicle (EV) charging tactics are changing and emphasizes the move toward more technologically sophisticated and environmentally friendly approaches, especially those that use solar energy. The advent of solar panels that convert parking spaces into energy sources is a significant step toward making EV charging infrastructure more environmentally friendly. The idea of wireless power transmission, credited to Nikola Tesla and gaining traction in the EV industry, is central to this breakthrough. This study examines several charging methods, emphasizing the efficiency and sustainability of solar, conductive, inductive, and battery-swapping charging, in particular. It also looks at how important data interchange is to these operations, including data on battery condition, outside temperature, cost of power, and position. The introduction of an Internet of Things (IoT)-based collecting system that makes use of RFID technology to facilitate easy payment of charging fees is evidence that modern technologies are being integrated into electric vehicle infrastructure. This system verifies the user's balance, handles payments, and automatically changes account information—all without the need for human interaction.The study emphasizes that the best charging approach depends on several variables, such as the kind of EV, usage habits, and charging environment. A future where charging is easier to reach and more integrated into daily life is presented, along with the possibilities of wireless charging technology in common applications. The research concluded that solar-powered solutions stand out for their sustainability and are positioned to play a crucial role in the future of EV charging, even though the choice of charging approaches may vary.

articleTitle: Optimizing Performance in Automatic Powder Filling Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: There have been crucial changes in the packaging industry recently, especially with regard to Form Fill and Seal (FFS) machines. These machines can be found in different sizes making them available for use by small businesses that want to lower their plant costs using inexpensive automated packaging solutions. This paper describes a low-cost weighing and pouring mechanism for improving accuracy of pouch filling machine. The process flow is carefully designed so as to achieve optimum production rates. Manipulators under the control of our mechatronics system are regulated through feedback from sensors managed by microcontroller.

articleTitle: Slotted Microstrip MIMO Antenna for 5g Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A dual-band two port Multiple-Input Multiple Output (MIMO) for the approaching 5G wireless applications is configured. The MIMO antenna takes rectangular slotted patches withI-shaped slots at the lower border of the mobile substrate The antenna works in a 5G - FR1 frequency. A defected ground construction (DGS) to raise the isolation among the two ports and magnify the antenna radiation is introduced. The MIMO antenna is planned and optimized through an CSTs simulator as well as by measurement.

articleTitle: Prediction and Classification of Handwritten Digits using DRNN-WOA model with Radiomics Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Words in handwriting are notoriously difficult to identify and distinguish because of their complex and irregular shapes. Word retrieval is a challenging and time-consuming process in low-resource scripts. To get the most out of deep learning and neural network models, it is necessary to employ large amount trained datasets and present randomness into the existing structure. Existing HDR methods rely primarily on hand-coded key points data. The wide variety of writing styles, as well as size fluctuations in the input sample, make accurate recognition and categorization of numerals to be a difficult task. To overcome these constraints, this research work introduces a Deep-Recurrent (DRNN) Neural Network model and provides an effective and efficient HDR system. Before considering pre-processing to enhance prediction and classification accuracy, HDR is applied to the MNIST and DIDA datasets. Both the Convolution algorithms and the Gaussian filters are used to refine the digits. The DRNN model receives the extracted features called Radiomics as input. Since the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) is used to fine-tune the DRNN's parameters, the suggested type is called DRNN-WOA. Accuracy, recall, F1- score, specificity, AUC, precision, and false positive rate are some metrics used to compare the proposed DRNN-WOA model.

articleTitle: Sustainable Mechanistic Insights into the Anticancer and Antimicrobial Activities of Ruthenium and Palladium Compounds
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The development of sustainable and effective therapeutic agents is pivotal in addressing global health challenges. This study explores the anticancer and antimicrobial potential of ruthenium and palladium compounds, with a focus on their mechanistic pathways and environmental impact. By examining a range of ruthenium and palladium complexes, we investigate their interactions with biological targets and their efficacy in combating cancerous cells and microbial pathogens. Our research delves into the structural characteristics and electronic qualities of these metal-based compounds, elucidating how they contribute to their biological activities. We also assess the sustainability of these compounds, considering factors such as resource availability, toxicity, and biodegradability. The study reveals that certain ruthenium and palladium compounds exhibit significant anticancer and antimicrobial activities while maintaining a lower environmental footprint compared to traditional therapies. Through detailed mechanistic studies, we identify key factors influencing their biological effects and potential for further development. This work not only advances our understanding of the therapeutic potentials of these metals but also supports the integration of green chemistry principles into drug design and development. Our findings underscore the promise of ruthenium and palladium compounds in sustainable medicinal applications, contributing to more effective and environmentally friendly therapeutic strategies.

articleTitle: Induction Motor Protection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This work focuses on shielding three-phase induction motors from single phasing and overheating provided for various conditions. This protection system helps in minimizing motor damage and hence increasing its lifetime. It is crucial for three phase induction motor to run on its three phases, also the temperature during its running time is to be within the tolerable limits which in turn increases the lifespan of the motor. Due to the extreme temperatures of the motor, it may experience melts in winding insulation, Fire and short circuit within the motor. The motor may experience a deterioration in its performance and its lifespan may drop. With microcontroller and thermistor as the major component the protection of the motor is achieved.

articleTitle: Enhancing Electric Vehicle Resilience with Adaptive Battery Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Some electric vehicles catch fire due to battery heat and heavy use. To avoid this, we are aiming to put into practice a more effective idea that will improve battery performance. Two batteries are being installed one after the other, and the Arduino Uno is keeping track of them using the temperature sensor and a battery percentage indication for each one that is displayed to the user on an LED screen. The power supply supplied from the first battery is then shifted to the second battery using a Power Failure Automatic Battery Shifting Module (YX850) if the temperature of the first battery exceeds the fixed temperature or its percentage drops below the fixed level. For the most effective usage of the battery, this operation is reversed.

Author Keywords: Power Failure Automatic Battery Shifting Module

articleTitle: Tracking and monitoring the safety of the child in the stroller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The safety of the child in the stroller is at risk when there is a deviation in the parent’s focus. The automatic movement in the baby strollers have led to many accidents and have been fatal to the baby. To overcome this, a stroller integrated with the touch sensor in the handle and movement sensor in wheels using IoT is planned in the project. The touchsensor is implemented using Capacitive or resistive sensing technology and works when an individual gets in physical contact with it. If a wheel movement is detected without touch in the handle, the customized voice alarm present in the stroller will go off to alert the parent. In addition to this, to locate the stroller through a device like mobile or tablet, a Global Positioning System (GPS) tracker will be placed in the stroller. When the stroller is left for about certain meters from the connected device, the parent will be notified through the connected device and can monitor the location of stroller in the device all the time using Blynk application.

articleTitle: Zooviz – Unveiling Anatomy Virtually
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Zooviz is at the forefront of a transformative shift in biology education, harnessing the power of Mixed Reality (MR) technology to redefine how students explore and understand the natural world. By merging MR with a specially developed application, this initiative offers a revolutionary approach to traditional dissection practices in educational settings. The need for this project arises from the growing ethical concerns and environmental impact associated with conventional dissections, as well as the limitations they impose on the accessibility and inclusivity of biology education. Zooviz addresses these challenges by providing a humane, sustainable, and universally accessible alternative. With a strong focus on ethical, environmental, and pedagogical values, Zooviz replaces the need for live specimens, instead offering students an immersive, hands-on experience that mirrors the intricacies of biological dissections. This cutting-edge tool not only enhances the educational experience but also aligns with modern ethical standards, providing a sustainable and humane alternative to conventional methods. Consolidate an enormous amount of information from various sources to produce general data, and afterward utilize diverse AI calculations to create models and give continuous outcomes [9]. Zooviz empowers students to delve deeply into the study of flora and fauna, ensuring a rich, interactive learning journey that respects both life and the environment.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Electrolyte Bottle for Healthcare Sectors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: IoT powered electrolyte bottle uses various sensors and microcontroller to continuously monitor the patients while receiving electrolyte supplementation and also to alert the caretakers while administrating the process. The proposed system prevents the backflow of blood into the electrolyte bottle by clamping the tube with the help of servomotor. This Quick intervention, backup of the data of patients in cloud database and alerting at the time of emergency is ensured in this system.

articleTitle: Development of an Intelligent Fuzzy Logic Control Based on a Differential Drive Wheeled Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The design and improvement of a fuzzy logic controller (FLC) for a wheeled mobile robot (WMR) with differential drive is addresses in this research. This investigate work is aimed to increase the robot’s navigational capabilities in complicated surroundings using fuzzy logic techniques that appropriately deal with ambiguity and imprecision. The FLC allows the robot to navigate around obstacles, follow paths, and reach its destinations by changing its speed and direction in response to sensor inputs. Initially, a basic fuzzy logic controller is built with standard fuzzy inference rules obtained from expert knowledge. The performance of this basic controller is tested in a variety of simulated settings. To improve the controller’s performance, membership function optimization, adaptive mechanism integration, and rule set refinement is modified. A comparison with conventional control systems indicates significant gains in overall robustness, obstacle avoidance, and navigation accuracy. The proposed technique effectiveness is further supported by experimental simulation findings from real-world testing, highlighting its potential for use in autonomous navigation systems.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Portable Manually Operated Desalination Plant for Military Use
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a portable, manually operated desalination plant tailored for military patrol units in remote island territories. Addressing the critical need for reliable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions to produce potable water from seawater, the proposed system integrates reverse osmosis technology adapted for manual operation. The plant’s key features include a modular design, low power consumption, and enhanced durability under harsh conditions. Field trials validated the system’s performance, demonstrating an efficiency rate of over 85% in producing potable water. The system’s minimal environmental impact and ease of use underscore its potential to significantly improve operational efficiency and sustainability in military operations. Future work will focus on refining the design and exploring additional applications in civilian and disaster relief scenarios.

articleTitle: Robot-Based Healthcare Monitoring Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Caring for elderly people has become a significant concern for families who experience the responsibility and enormous work involved in providing adequate care. This responsibility often leads to a care crisis, which can be overwhelming. To address this issue, we introduce MediBot, a revolutionary machine designed to act as a trusted support system for elderly individuals. MediBot not only alleviates the burden on families but also contributes to the overall development of the nation’s healthcare system. [2] MediBot is equipped with advanced monitoring capabilities, allowing it to continuously track the health and well-being of elderly individuals. It provides real-time support in various circumstances, ensuring that the elderly receive timely assistance and care. The machine’s sophisticated technology includes features such as vital signs monitoring, medication reminders, and emergency alert systems, all of which are crucial for maintaining the health and safety of elderly people.

articleTitle: Supply of Uninterrupted Electrical Power Using Hybrid Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This project suggests a number of converters that are incorporated into the utility grid from renewable sources, along with suggested control mechanisms. Through the BOOST converter, the solar panel supplies voltage to the inverter. With the help of a battery system and a bidirectional battery converter, the suggested system achieves energy management. When there isn't any sunshine, the AC mains are used as a backup source to keep the power supply going. The AC supply also powers the inverter, and any extra energy is stored in the battery. By using this strategy, we can guarantee that power will always be available, even in the event of a power outage or lack of sunlight. The battery's energy storage will supply the inverter with the necessary current.

articleTitle: Remote Vehicle Disable using RF-FMR
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: To prevent vehicle theft, remote control of a vehicle's engine is enabled through SMS, using a GSM module. Motivated by the theft of a two-wheeler from an acquaintance's home, this system provide owners the ability to lock or unlock their vehicles remotely, ensuring enhanced security. This targets low-range vehicles, offering them an effective anti-theft solution. Beyond civilian use, the system can assist law enforcement in stopping stolen vehicles during dangerous pursuits, potentially reducing crime rates and conserving resources. Overall, it aspires to contribute significantly to public safety by curbing vehicle theft and associated crimes.

articleTitle: Personalized Mobile App for Engineering Career Path Recommendation using Fuzzy Inference System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Most students today struggle to choose a career path as a result of poor choice of their undergraduate course due to lack of knowledge and misinformation. This research system is designed to suggest the most suitable undergraduate engineering course to be pursued by high schoolers. The system implements fuzzy algorithm, which requires Academic Performance, Personality type and Interests, while taking Job Opportunities that the course may provide in the future as inputs. The system is to be implemented as a mobile application which considers the mentioned factors and derives an individual suitability factor for engineering domains. The results derived from the inference system appear to provide more information about individual likeness and strengthens individual decision-making ability with regards to choosing an undergraduate course.

articleTitle: Smart Systems for Sustainable Aquaculture: A Focus on Water Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The sustainability of aquaculture is increasingly dependent on advancements in technology to ensure optimal water quality. This paper explores the integration of smart systems in aquaculture, emphasizing their role in monitoring and managing water quality parameters. Smart systems, leveraging sensors, real-time data analytics, and automated control mechanisms, offer innovative solutions for maintaining ideal aquatic environments. By providing continuous and precise measurements of critical water quality indicators such as pH, temperature, dissolved oxygen, and salinity. These systems enable timely interventions and reduce the reliance on manual monitoring. The implementation of such technologies enhances productivity, minimizes environmental impact, and supports the long-term viability of aquaculture operations. This research highlights key developments, evaluates current methodologies, and discusses future directions for the incorporation of smart systems in sustainable aquaculture practices.

articleTitle: DMS - Driver Monitoring System for License Test Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Driver monitoring system is a technology that is often implemented in the driving license process to assess and monitor the behaviour and skills of individuals learning to drive. This system is typically used during driving tests to provide objective data and ensure that the applicant meets the required standards for obtaining a driver's license The system typically utilizes sensors placed inside the vehicle to record the actions and behaviours of the driver during the driving test. The recorded data is analysed using machine learning algorithms to predict the behaviour of drivers and provide feedback based on their performance during the license test. The system can identify and evaluate specific driving behaviours, such as proper handling of steering, speed control, break control and eye movement.

articleTitle: Understanding The Scope Of Artificial Intelligence In HR Technology E-Recruitment – A Theoretical Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The expansion of information technology has had a major effect on HR strategies and procedures. The successful transfer of human knowledge into organizational knowledge is crucial while moving toward organizations modeled like edifices, and Artificial Intelligence plays a crucial role in this. This is a crucial stage in the process. Artificial intelligence is a growing area of HR technology that has the potential to either completely replace or vastly improve upon the effectiveness of conventional approaches to personnel administration. Companies can benefit from the use of AI in a number of ways, including applicant screening, employee engagement, retention, and advancement opportunities. It can be used to improve the effectiveness of human resource management by being applied to HR policies, methods, and perspectives. The student will examine the rise of AI in the HRM process and its possible benefits using secondary sources of information. This research provides fresh insights into how technological innovation has helped HRM progress from efficient to long-term viable.

articleTitle: Enhancing Waste Management Through Smart Bins
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Food waste (FW) generation is a major global issue and a top political priority. Lack of precise information regarding the volume, timing, and causes of waste creation is one of the primary causes of it. This article addresses the architecture, implementation, and exploration of an Internet of Things (IoT)-driven food waste (FW) monitoring system that gathers waste data in real-time during manufacturing and disseminates it to all parties involved in the food supply chain (FSC). A case study of a ready-meal factory includes the hardware and software design and architecture for tracking food waste (FW), how it is implemented in the plant, and the successful outcomes derived from data analysis. The case study highlights the advantages of using a digital FW tracking system, such as FW reduction.

articleTitle: Cloud Service Authentication Using Attribute-Based Pseudonymity For Ensure Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In order to protect privacy, this paper proposes utilizing attribute-based pseudonymity for cloud service authentication. To enable attribute verification, the proposed phenomenal context incorporates a secret sharing method within the signature construction. The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) 256, the verifier, and the users form the basis of this technique. The AES 256 is used to generate verification keys and public values, as well as to take away the rights of those who violate privacy. On the side of the service provider, the verifier is an Authentication Server (AS) that is in charge of confirming user-sent signatures in accordance with a predetermined access tree structure. The AES 256, along with a few embedded properties and self-generated pseudonyms, is provided by the user as a legitimate credential. The verifier, which attempts to locate and identify users in the cloud, is regarded as trustworthy. As a result, customers are spared the necessity to register their passwords with the supplier. It allows verifiable attribute delegation and offers fine-grained access control. Additionally, the recommended plan authenticates users who keep data on cloud servers. Java is used in the implementation of this study.

articleTitle: Localized Detection, Control and Combating of Greenhouse Gas Emissions using IoT and Data Science
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research presents a pioneering dual-strategy framework.Sophisticated mathematical modeling, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) techniques are leveraged in order to address critical urban environmental challenges. The system functions in real-time, computing the Air Quality Index (AQI) by assimilating data from diverse sources. In parallel, an AI-driven model employs a comprehensive dataset to recommend tailored strategies for optimal green cover expansion, accounting for variables such as plant species selection, soil attributes, and carbon sequestration rates. The initiative is aligned with established environmental policies and facilitates community engagement through a robust feedback loop. Expert collaboration guides this dynamic project, promising a paradigm shift in urban sustainability practices. Rigorous evaluation and refinement mechanisms guarantee the adaptability and effectiveness of the framework. This research not only advances the field of environmental engineering but also provides actionable insights for policymakers and urban planners seeking for greener, healthier urban environments.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Satellite Crop Zone Canvas Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Satellite Crop Zone Canvas Analysis refers to the utilization of deep learning techniques, a subset of artificial intelligence, for analyzing satellite imagery to study crop zones or agricultural regions. Satellite Crop Zone Canvas Analysis is method to classify the satellite images. Domain knowledge has been required for feature extraction and various sets of parameters has been obtained from satellites images for pre-processing. Image Processing techniques like histogram equalization and Median Filter used for enhance the image contrast. In Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), most famous network ResNet50 help for train the model and also helpful for predict the images. CZCA method helps to analysing satellite imaginary. CZCA Applications like yield prediction, land use mapping, and crop health monitoring rely on accurate delineation of agricultural zones.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Proportional-Integral and Levenberg-Marquardt Machine Learning Algorithm Based Controllers For Battery Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Efficient and effective battery charging systems are essential to the success and growth of electric mobility. Moreover, safe charging is required for optimal battery performance, reliability, and longevity. This research work provides a comparative study of charging a battery using Proportional-Integral (PI) and Levenberg-Marquardt Machine Learning Algorithm (LMMLA)-based Constant Current (CC) - Constant Voltage (CV) control techniques. The charging current is managed during the CC phase to provide a controlled and uniform flow of electrons into the battery. The battery voltage remains constant during the CV phase, while the current drops as the battery nears full charge. Traditional control systems may have difficulty adapting to varying charging circumstances and user needs. Using LMMLA, the charging system can learn and adapt to numerous factors such as battery chemistry, temperature, and State of Charge (SoC), resulting in improved charging outcomes. To ensure a seamless transition from one mode to another, PI and LMMLA controllers can be utilized to monitor the battery's response and adjust the current/voltage regulation. These adaptive techniques prevent overcharging, reduce heat generation, and increase battery life. This improves efficiency, safety, and overall battery health.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning model based Smart Monitoring System for Covid-19 Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The COVID-19-patient health tracking system is a risk factormajor public health challenge for COVID-19 patients, and it has inherited an ample supply of mindfuless recently from the medical community because of the ageing population and an increase in chronic illnesses. It is challenging for traditional wireless communication technology to fully meet the real-time requirements for wearable medical devices. Current monitoring framework cannot handle the massive amount of synchronous cardiovascular data due to the lack of effective streaming data processing mechanisms. The suggested paper uses Internet of Things (IoT) technology to obtain patient medical data both locally and remotely. The patient's temperature sensor and pulse sensor send data to a cloud server, which analyses it with the unification of Hybrid deep-learning model combining a convolutional neural network (CNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) is utilized and manages it for later analysis. According to the experimental findings, the accuracy of our proposed system was 99.4, sensitivity 99.3%, specificity 99.2% and F1-score is 98.9% respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Artificial General Intelligence for Power System Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Power systems are vulnerable to faults that can lead to severe damage to critical components such as motors, generators, and transformers, as well as cause dangerous over-voltages, high currents, outages, and safety hazards. To address these challenges, an effective power protection system is essential for detecting, classifying, and locating faults to mitigate their impact. This project presents the development of an Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) system designed to control and optimize the algorithms of machine learning for fault classification and predicitons in power systems. Utilizing the IEEE 14 Bus Test Network, the AGI system integrates Random Forest Classifier and Support Vector Classifier (SVC) to enhance fault detection accuracy and system performance. AGI system processes real-time data to dynamically manage fault detection and classification tasks, ensuring timely identification and response. Through comprehensive testing and evaluation, the system demonstrates improved reliability and safety by providing precise fault predictions and minimizing operational disruptions. This approach offers a robust solution for managing power system faults, contributing to more reliable and efficient power infrastructure management [1].

articleTitle: AI based Mental Health Assisted Chatbot System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rise of mental health issues globally has necessitated innovative solutions to enhance access to support and resources. In response, this study presents a Mental Health Assisted Chatbot System powered by machine learning algorithms. Leveraging natural language processing (NLP) techniques and sentiment analysis, the chatbot engages users in empathetic conversations, offering personalized support, psycho education, and therapeutic interventions. Through continuous monitoring and analysis of user inputs, the system detects patterns, tracks mood fluctuations, and provides proactive interventions when necessary. While promising, the deployment of such systems raises important considerations regarding privacy, data security, and ethical guidelines. By addressing these challenges, mental health assistant chatbots have the potential to significantly augment mental health care delivery and empower individuals to manage their well-being effectively.

articleTitle: Flexible Strategy in Distributed Generation with Demand Side Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The previous two decades have been seen the interest has risen considerably for developing solution to improve the performance of power system in optimal energy consumption and energy management. The behaviour of the consumer conception is entirely based on the strategies of DRP-Demand response programs . In this research work, Hybrid Demand Response Program (DRP) is developed by utilising Time of use (ToU) and incentive based programs to reduce peak over load and cost of energy. To overcome the demand in the load, A hybrid renewable energy system using solar photo voltaic system and energy storage system has been proposed withoptimal sizing of Distributed Generation (DG). Based on our findings, we concluded that a hybrid demand response program integrated with HRES reduced peak demand by 5% to 8%, leading to an overall reduction in energy costs through the use of heuristic optimization techniques.

articleTitle: IMMULINK-Blockchain assurance in vaccine cold chain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The pharmaceutical industry’s supply chain management faces critical challenges, including tampering of vaccine details and a lack of transparency from regulatory authorities to end customers. These issues compromise the safety, traceability, and dependability of vaccine distribution. To address these challenges, we propose a comprehensive framework leveraging blockchain technology, smart contracts, and IoT sensors [12]. This solution integrates IoT sensors with smart contracts to monitor the cold chain process, ensuring vaccines are stored at proper temperatures and conditions. This integration with the Ethereum blockchain, utilizing the Solidity programming language, creates an immutable, transparent, and secure supply chain. We deployed our framework on Remix IDE, demonstrating its functionality with multiple nodes. The proposed system not only enhances the supply chain’s dependability and traceability but also includes a feedback mechanism from customers, further improving the process’s overall efficiency.Initial testing and deployment have shown promising results in improving the overall performance, security, and efficiency of the supply chain. This framework offers a robust solution for maintaining vaccine integrity and building trust among stakeholders in the pharmaceutical supply chain.

articleTitle: Societal implications of AI in Finance, Healthcare and in various industries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The social impacts are addressed in this study of AI in the healthcare, finance, and manufacturing sectors. The study highlights the potential benefits of AI, including improved diagnostics and treatment in healthcare, enhanced decision-making in finance, and increased efficiency in manufacturing processes. In the meantime, it covers the challenges caused by AI, like problems with confidentiality, economic displacement, and ethical issues. The analysis underlines the importance of implementing AI in a balanced way to ensure that its use supports balanced and steady growth while limiting the risk associated.

articleTitle: AR GuideX: Indoor Wayfinder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Indoor navigation systems using augmented reality (AR) aim to help users navigate through indoor spaces such as buildings, airports, malls, and exhibition centers. These systems can use various technologies, including GPS, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi, to determine the user's location and provide them with visual and auditory directions to their destination. AR-based indoor navigation systems can also be tailored to the needs of specific users or environments. One of the main benefits of AR-based indoor navigation systems is that they can provide users with a more intuitive and immersive experience compared to traditional methods such as paper maps or visual displays. By overlaying digital information onto the user's physical environment, AR systems can make it easier for users to understand their surroundings and find their way around. Overall, AR-based indoor navigation systems have the potential to improve the user experience and efficiency of navigating indoor spaces and may have a variety of applications in different settings.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Distributed Generation and Demand Response Programs in Modern Power Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Distributed generation (DG) pertains to the generation of electricity from decentralized power plants, a vital consideration in the planning of contemporary power grid networks. This involves a careful assessment of both initial capital investments and associated carbon emissions. The primary advantages associated with the integration of these units encompass the augmentation of power availability and the improvement of overall grid reliability. This paper aims to review and assess demand response management (DRM), enhance the reliability and efficiency in wind power integration in the electricity grid, this study integrates (BESS) battery energy storage systems with renewable distributed generators. Additionally, it provides valuable references for future researchers aiming to improve the integration of wind power.. This review paper also offers a thorough analysis of earlier studies that sought to overcome the inherent variability of wind energy production and offer a means of storing and using surplus wind energy. The ultimate goal of this research is to develop energy systems that are more reliable, efficient, and sustainable that can accommodate an increasing proportion of renewable energy sources like wind power. A thorough examination of diverse methodologies, operational tactics, and model categorization is provided, wherein the categorization is contingent upon their respective advantages and disadvantages

articleTitle: AI Art Generators: Human Creativity Vs Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: AI Art Generators have recently developed in such a way that they have become accessible to everyone who has access to the internet. This paper looks into how the modern AI art generators work and identifies the various issues with AI art on technical, moral and legal grounds. Furthermore it aims to understands how the increased accessibility to AI art generators affects humans.Modern AI art generators use artificial intelligence, machine learning algorithms and deep neural network algorithms to study a large amount of pre-existing artworks in portfolio and produce new art based on the prompts provided by the user. They use software such as CNN, GAN, NST.The biggest argument against AI art is that it needs the human creativity and imagination. But it has been argued that the human creativity is included in the text prompts provided by the artist. AI art generators have also been accused of stealing art works without permission of the artists which has been leading to some copyright issues. Furthermore AI art generators have been stealing artists’ commissions and work. AI art generators are not perfect yet and have several errors such as errors in the art generated such as anatomy errors(example: hands with six fingers instead of five etc). Artists have protested against the use of AI art generators. One such protest is the "No to AI generated images" movement wherein they flooded the portfolio in an AI art generator called "ArtStation" with images tagged as "trending in ArtStation in order to render all the generated images useless.

articleTitle: Smart City Parking Optimization:Integrating Edge Computing and IoT Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today’s increasingly digitalized world with a growing trend of digitalization of almost all services, efficient urban parking management becomes a necessity. Traditional urban parking systems are usually infrastructure-heavily born relying on manual reporting and process that is ineffective and driver-offending. In this line, we suggest a smart parking system based on edge computing. Briefly, our smart parking system aims to innovate urban parking management, providing real-time parking availability to drivers, optimizing parking capacity to space ration and traffic congestion. Powered by edge computing, our system demonstrates a fast response time and potential scalability. Swipe motions and contextual data are collected in real-time through IoT devices, allowing for enhanced decision-making and seamless user experience [11]. This paper reviews the design and operation our smart parking system, highlighting the improvements in urban parking management and driver experience.

articleTitle: Connecting Care: An IoT-Based T-Health Monitoring System for Rural India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The automated T-Health monitoring system is designed to enhance healthcare delivery in rural India, where access to medical services is often limited due to a shortage of healthcare professionals at public health centres (PHCs). By leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) technology, the system monitors essential physiological parameters such as pulse rate, blood pressure, and glucose levels, facilitating remote communication between patients and healthcare providers. Collected health data is transmitted to a cloud database, enabling timely medical interventions. In emergency situations, the system automatically notifies a tele-ambulance service equipped with necessary medical resources for immediate care. This innovative approach addresses the challenges posed by inadequate healthcare infrastructure and aims to improve health outcomes and access to medical services, ultimately transforming the landscape of healthcare in rural areas of India.

articleTitle: Detection of Plant Diseases and Recommendation of Plant Cycle using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Plant diseases create significant challenges to productivity in agriculture, food security, and ecological stability. Pathogens and environmental variables interact to cause plant diseases. Pathogens include various microorganisms like bacteria, fungi, and viruses, each with unique modes of spread. Environmental conditions such as temperature, humidity, and soil quality impact disease development and severity. The impacts of plant diseases are far-reaching. It affects crop yields and quality. Outbreaks of plant diseases can lead to economic losses, and food shortages which ultimately lead to hunger and poverty. Effective management of plant diseases requires an integrated approach that combines detection, preventive measures, cultural practices, and chemical interventions. The solution has two modules. The first module focuses on detection of plant diseases and its management. The second module focuses on recommendations of the plant cycle. Our proposed system utilizes CNN algorithms trained on a large amount of datasets. Using image analysis the features are extracted and patterns are recognized. Therefore, the system can quickly identify the disorders.. The system also includes suggestions for preventive measures. The system integrates modules for recommending optimal plant cycles to the farmers and gardeners. It generates personalized recommendations for planting schedules and crop varieties. This system increases crop yields and decreases the risk of disease outbreaks. Our solution offers a holistic approach to plant health monitoring and management.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Consumption and Theft Detection Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In our daily lives, we cannot function without electricity. Global energy consumption increased by 5% in 2021 following a 4.5% decrease in 2020. Most nations had increases in energy consumption: +5.2% in China, +4.5% in India, and +4.7% in the European Union. Energy monitoring is a crucial task that can easily spiral out of control. The meter reading must be known by the consumer because it will be used to decide how much will be charged for the withdrawal. This solution automates the framework by analyzing the readings from the meters followed by and transferring the observation to the customer via online. Trackers were used in this project system to gather and secure energy consumption data. Additionally, a microcontroller featuring an energy meter.The energy meters in every appliance in the house are secured by the tracker. The client can examine the energy usage by using the internet portal to view the consumed units and amount charges that are communicated by data using the GSM module. This allows customers to keep a close eye on their daily energy usage.

articleTitle: Smart Assistive E-Vehicle for Enhanced Mobility of Physically Challenged Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Mobility is essential to freedom and a high quality of life in the fast-paced world of today, especially for those with physical disabilities. Even while they work well, traditional cars frequently fall short of meeting the unique requirements of this population, which makes navigation and autonomy challenging. In order to tackle this issue, we suggest creating a Smart Assistive E-Vehicle that is intended to improve mobility for those with physical disabilities. This cutting-edge car is an electric four-wheel drive vehicle with cutting-edge technology that offers convenient, safe, and effective transportation. The YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm, a cutting-edge deep learning model that enables real-time traffic light monitoring, is the brains behind this system. Because of the great efficiency of the YOLO algorithm, the car can recognize traffic lights and signals with great speed and accuracy, which is essential for safe urban navigation. Because of the great efficiency of the YOLO algorithm, the car can recognize traffic lights and signals with great speed and accuracy, which is essential for safe urban navigation.

articleTitle: Fault Detection of Internal Wiring Using Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: To design a project that can harness wiring faults in the small components and PCB of our daily usage components such as mobiles, laptops and other small devices. It implements the usage of Augmented Reality which is an emerging technology in the current research trend. AR technology superimposes digital information onto the physical world, providing real-time, interactive visualization. By integrating AR with advanced diagnostic algorithms, technicians can quickly and accurately identify wiring faults such as short circuits, open circuits, and insulation failures. The AR system uses a combination of cameras and sensors to capture the wiring layout and diagnose issues, overlaying visual indicators of faults directly onto the live feed of the wiring.Key features of the proposed system include real-time fault localization, guided troubleshooting procedures, and the ability to visualize complex wiring schematics overlaid on physical components. The use of AR minimizes the need for extensive training, reduces inspection times, and enhances the accuracy of fault detection. Additionally, the system can log detected faults and repair actions, providing valuable data for predictive maintenance and system optimization.

articleTitle: Fake User Identification and Duplication Detection Using MERN Stack
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the digital era, the rise of fraudulent users during exams and online courses presents a significant challenge to the integrity of educational assessments. However, with advancements in technology, there exists a promising solution" Fake User Identification and Duplication Detection using MERN stack ". This innovative system integrates a variety of cutting-edge algorithms, including node.js for backend processing, React.js for frontend interface development, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for sophisticated image analysis. By combining these powerful tools, our method aims to establish a robust user-controlling system capable of thwarting fraudulent activity during exams and classroom interactions. By implementing Fake User Identification and Duplication Detection, educational institutions can uphold the integrity of their digital ecosystems while preserving the authenticity of assessments. This technique not only deters fraudulent behavior but also fosters a culture of academic honesty and accountability in online learning environments. As technology continues to advance, our ongoing commitment to innovation ensures that our system remains at the forefront of defending against fraudulent users, safeguarding the future of online education.

articleTitle: Analyzing bolted connection morphology to evaluate structural integrity in rail systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Using sensor-based monitoring to analyze the morphology of bolted connections, as opposed to finite element analysis (FEA), this research aims to assess the structural integrity of train systems. Detecting loosening or anomalies is a focus of the study, which examines how operational stressors and environmental conditions impact bolt performance. To detect any variations from expected performance, the system uses sophisticated sensors to continuously monitor the status of bolts. To facilitate prompt response, the system immediately notifies responsible individuals and places a call when it detects an anomaly. Through prompt maintenance and repair of weak bolted connections, this proactive strategy aims to lower the number of train accidents caused by derailment. With the integration of automatic alerts and real-time monitoring, the findings seek to improve rail safety and reliability.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Monitoring and Control System with Wireless Drip Rate Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Infusion therapy plays a crucial role in delivering medications and fluids to patients, but it often requires close monitoring and manual intervention by healthcare providers. The InfuCare system addresses these challenges by integrating IoT-enabled devices and advanced analytics to enable remote monitoring, control, and optimization of infusion processes. At its core, the InfuCare system consists of IoT-enabled infusion pumps equipped with sensors to monitor parameters such as flow rate, pressure, and volume infused. These pumps communicate with a central monitoring platform via IoT connectivity modules, transmitting real-time data on infusion progress and patient status. A drip rate monitoring device can be used to measure the rate of intravenous infusion. There is now a wireless drip rate monitoring gadget available. In order to detect the drops, this gadget uses Ultrasonic TX (UTX) and Ultrasonic RX (URX). The sensor was installed to the drip chamber using a mountable clasp mechanism. The device determines the drip rate using a microprocessor, and when the drip rate goes outside of the predetermined range, the Wi-Fi connection module wirelessly alerts the central monitoring station. The technology guarantees real-time tracking of drip infusion parameters in this virtual environment, including accurate fluid level readings and physiological response monitoring. The smooth communication in the simulated environment made possible by the integration with Node MCU illustrates the design’s potential for developing an intelligent and networked healthcare infrastructure. IR sensor, DHT11, and HBR/SPO2 are used for remotely tracking human health care.

articleTitle: Smart Model for Recognizing Hydroponic Lettuce Shortages Utilizing Higher Level Efficient Algorithms and Consensus Multi-Dilated Adaptive Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The evolution that never stops, especially in smart agriculture, especially hydroponic farming has bought a great change for efficiencies and productivities. Nevertheless, identification and categorization of nutrient deficiencies in hydroponic lettuce are still challenging, specifically, when training deep learning models for low power ‘Edge’ IoT devices such as smart mobile phones and Raspberry Pi. Current methods are challenging due to high computational complexity, high power consumption, and inadequate utilization of resources, which hinders real-life implementation in embedded systems. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents an intelligent, highly efficient approach for the identification of nutrient deficiencies in hydroponic lettuce using advanced algorithms and a Consensus Multi-Dilated Adaptive Network (CMDA-Net). The proposed model harnesses or combines many of the current best-known or best performing approaches to yield a proper feature extraction and classification. This approach takes advantage of deep neural networks including VGG-16, Residual Attention Network (RAN) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with a multi-dilated convolutional network to improve spatial feature learning while at the same time reducing computational cost. These features are then passed through LSTM network that help capture temporal information control and ensure that lettuce deficiencies are correctly classified. The entire system structure is enhanced through the new Improvised Honey Badger Algorithm (I-HBA), which adjusts specific networks’ parameters for maximum effectiveness with minimal resource consumption. Many experiments were carried out on Lettuce NPK dataset which contains test images of Fully Nutritional, Nitrogen Deficient, Phosphorus Deficient and Potassium Deficient lettuce. It respectively assessed the accuracy, specificity rate, precision, NPV, FPR, and MCC of the model. We also gained compelling improvements in terms of both computational time and model accuracy with exactly terminal prediction accuracy 96% and specificity 95%.

articleTitle: Econometrics Analysis for Technology Start Up Performance with Reference to India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Recent years have seen a surge in interest in India's startup ecosystem as a whole due to the country's promising future as an innovation and economic development engine. The purpose of this research is to provide a thorough evaluation of the startup scene in India's Eastern Zone. This study delves into the difficulties faced by start-ups in this area, the variables that contribute to their growth and development, and the policy and investment implications that follow. Entrepreneurs, investors, and lawmakers were surveyed and interviewed as part of a mixed-methods approach to data collection. In spite of infrastructural gaps and regulatory complexity, the results show an entrepreneurially dynamic and rapidly expanding ecosystem. This research highlights the need of focused policy interventions and improved infrastructure investments in creating an environment that is conducive to start-ups in the East Zone. This study adds to the existing body of knowledge by providing a regionally specific context, which helps stakeholders and policymakers understand the possibilities and obstacles of fostering a thriving start-up ecosystem in India's East Zone.

articleTitle: Stress Relief And Anxiety Therapy Using AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Access to mental health facilities is challenging especially for teenagers as they are not very much comfortable in sharing how they really feel and due to peer pressure. Serenity aims to bridge the gap between the accessing of mental health among teenagers and Gen Alpha in general. Our prime focus is to create a safe environment among them and bring the best out of them. Stress is caused in various ways. Primary reasons include peers and family, the exact place where they should have gone when they get problems. Serenity uses advanced technology like CNN and ANN to provide timely help for them. The software uses NN's to identify the mood of the person accurately, and henceforth choosing a timely remedy and enforcing it immediately. The Cloud integrated database ensures remedy and help anytime anywhere. A user-friendly GUI simplifies all the interactions allowing the input of user data and delivering rapid and accurate results.

articleTitle: Road Traffic Forecasting Using Air Pollution and Atmospheric Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Urban traffic congestion continues to be a serious problem that compromises environmental sustainability, economic productivity, and public health. Accurately predicting patterns of congestion and implementing appropriate actions are essential for managing traffic flow. However, the influence of environmental elements such as weather and air pollution on traffic patterns is largely overlooked by standard traffic prediction algorithms.Predictive models that may better comprehend the intricate relationships between traffic patterns and environmental factors are developed by compiling historical data on air pollution levels and atmospheric conditions. Our trials show that this methodology outperforms previous methods in terms of traffic forecast accuracy. This study adds to our understanding of how traffic flow is influenced by environmental factors and provides useful information for improving urban transportation management techniques.

articleTitle: Automation of Vegetable Cutting Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Nowadays, machines playing a major role everywhere in our lives, which makes the work smooth and simple. This machine helps to shorten times and works based on automation. One of the most challenging tasks is cutting vegetables, especially in hotels or any catering work. The chefs will do variety of recipes for a lot of people, so they need to cut a vegetable, which may take more time if using hands. This paper develops a machine to reduces human work and time spend on chopping the vegetable, consist of a heavy motor that is used to rotate the blades faster, which helps to cut large quantities of vegetables. An automation plays a major role in nowadays, it will simplify the work. The overall process of this machine is to cut all types of vegetables into desired shapes by changing blades. It is less in weight, portable, low cost and not require any skilled workers.

articleTitle: Analysis and segregation of Corn seed using machine vision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In India, about 60% of the of the population depends upon the agriculture field. Quality control is very important in agriculture production because the crop yield mainly depends on the quality of the seed. In order to increase the productivity, in this research work the quality of the seed is analysed using Deep Convolutional Neural Network. Thus the human errors is avoided in the selecting quality seed, reduce the human effort and time spent on segregation. This research proposed hardware solution for seed classification using the CNN model.High quality seeds are selected and segregated by image processing technique and CNN. The seeds are fed in to a designed conveyor and the seed image is taken by the camera. Raspberry-pi controller is used to process the seed images and classify the seeds based on the quality parameters such as colour, size and shape. The attained the accuracy of 95% using our hardware setup.

articleTitle: CRYPTOGUARD – IoT Biometric Home Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Home security is a necessity in the current scenario as the possibilities of intrusion are increasing daily. Numerous security companies provide various solutions to protect property from getting vandalized. The entrance security system paper aims to revolutionize traditional lock and key systems by introducing an advanced, biometrically-driven access control solution. Leveraging IoT, biometric authentication, and mobile technology, the system offers a robust and user-friendly security solution for residential, commercial, and institutional sectors. The paper's high-level design encompasses interconnected components facilitating biometric verification, mobile app connectivity, fail-safe mechanisms, and real-time alerts. Methodologies include IoT integration, the development of biometric authentication algorithms, mobile app design, and fail-safe protocols. Implementation involves hardware selection, software development, and integration procedures ensuring compatibility with existing door systems. Security measures encompass stringent data encryption, privacy considerations, and compliance with industry standards. The user-centric focus emphasizes an intuitive mobile app interface, seamless access control, and user convenience. Future enhancements may include facial recognition, voice authentication, and predictive analysis. The paper's success hinges on comprehensive development, meticulous testing, and adherence to security protocols, aiming to redefine security standards and ensure unparalleled peace of mind for users.

articleTitle: Precision Mapping of Subsurface Water Resources with Octocopters and GER Water Detectors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Recent advancements in drone technology have enabled accurate measurement of groundwater levels, an important resource for water management and agricultural practices. This innovative approach uses high-resolution sensors and high-quality images to search for underground water and map it like never. The addition of AI and machine learning makes data capture even better, providing faster analytics and future insights [1]. These new technologies not only contribute to water management but also help to protect nature through the efficient use of groundwater. The paper discusses how this new drone tech was developed, how it can be used and where it can be useful in different environments. It shows how the way we manage water is changing. Water is essential for life, agriculture and industry, but groundwater management remains challenging. Older methods of measuring groundwater tend to destroy the site, take longer and do not cover much. But new drone tech offers a game-changing fix. Called the "GER Water Detector," the new technique uses sophisticated automated technology with sharper sensors and better imaging to measure and map groundwater [2].

articleTitle: Smart Thermowing Explorer using Drone System and IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Smart Thermowing Explorer project uses drone technology and IoT to improve infrastructure inspections. The drone inspects windmills, solar panels, and electrical towers efficiently, using twin cameras for video and thermal imaging to detect concerns such as overheating. Compared to manual approaches, this strategy decreases inspection time, increases safety, and lowers costs. Pre-flight tests, data collecting, and emergency protocols guarantee that operations go smoothly, while Arduino boards analyse heat data to identify problems quickly. The system's proactive maintenance minimizes hazards and downtime. Drones can improve real-time data-driven decision-making in precision agriculture, environmental monitoring, and disaster response, leading to better infrastructure management across industries.

articleTitle: Smart LPG Leak Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) is a common cooking fuel in developing regions, yet it presents challenges including fluctuating levels and safety concerns related to gas leaks. This paper presents a novel monitoring and alert system for home LPG cylinders designed to address these issues. The proposed system integrates a load sensor to continuously measure gas levels and estimate the remaining usage time. To further enhance safety, an MQ-2 sensor is included to detect gas leaks. The system uses an ESP8266 microcontroller to transmit data to a mobile application, allowing users to monitor LPG levels and leak status in real time. This approach aims to significantly improve user convenience and safety compared to existing solutions.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Epileptic Seizure Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: An instrument used in computer science and biomedicine to detect brain activity is the electroencephalogram (EEG). The impulses produced by the brain determine a person's neurological capabilities, limitations, and thought processes. As a result, a person's behavior in response to certain occurrences is greatly influenced by the processing and classification of these signals. It would take a lot of time and effort to manually analyze these data, hence an automated scientific technique is needed. Deep learning algorithms have advanced quickly in the last several years, and biomedical engineering is starting to use them extensively. In conclusion, this work highlights several important issues, including parameter selection, computational complexity, and the need for deep learning to be used in the future to EEG decoding.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Generalized Bandpass Filter using STM32 for Fabrication of Sensor to Detect Red Palm Weevil
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
