abstract: The STM32F103C6T6A, also called the "Blue Pill" is a low-cost machine with 32-bit ARM Cortex-M3 RISC core designed by STMicroelectronics for beginners to build and test prototypes [8]. It is intended to use this development board for the simulation of a Bandpass Filter. To simulate a filter, the internal timer [4] clock of the board has been utilised which helps in generating signals of any frequency by manipulating the values of the Auto-Reload Register (ARR) and the Prescaler (PSC) [4]. The principle behind this filter replication is based on the frequency ratio. When the timer generates an input signal of a particular frequency, the ratio of the frequency of the timer clock to the frequency of the generated signal is calculated. If the ratio comes under the permissible value, the signal is acquired. If not, the signal experiences attenuation. Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) is an application of timer [9] which generates a PWM signal whose duty cycle can be adjusted using the Compare-Capture Register (CCR).The results are observed by generating PWM signals of passband and stopband frequencies with a constant duty cycle of 50%. Suppose the input signal is in the range of passband frequency, it would be indicated by a green Light Emitting Diode (LED), after which the signal is allowed without attenuation. If not, a red LED glows indicating that the frequency belongs to Stopband frequency, and gets attenuated. The designed band pass filter is used for developing a sensor for pest management and detection using its frequency

articleTitle: Green Engineering Approaches to Activated Carbon: Chemical vs. Physical Activation of Corn Husk for Enhanced Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: A Sustainable and economical method of waste management and resources is to use solid waste from farming to create activated carbon - Corn husks. This work investigates the potential of activated carbon generated from horn huskies as adsorbent materials for use in Environmental applications, namely in removing pollutants and purification water, etc. A plentiful by-product, corn husk is frequently thrown away as waste materials. With a porosity surface area physical procedures or Chemical Approaches are usually used in the activation process, the latter requires the use of activated Zinc Chloride. The present investigation aimed to improve the Adsorption Capabilities of activated Carbon by optimizing its preparation parameters Such as activated temperature duration and chemical concentration, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), and Fourier -Transform Electron Spectroscopy to analyze the resultant product. The process involves Carbonization and activation, we can transform this biomass into activated carbon Which will Allow us to produce a high-value product.

articleTitle: Automated IoT Indoor Hydroponic Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The growing trend of indoor hydroponic farming, combined with advancements in IoT (Internet of Things) technology, offers a compelling solution for sustainable agriculture. This paper explores the development and potential impact of automated IoT-driven indoor hydroponic systems in tackling global food security challenges. These systems integrate IoT sensors, data analytics, and automation to precisely monitor and regulate key environmental conditions essential for plant growth. Real-time data on factors such as temperature, humidity, pH levels, nutrient concentrations, and light intensity enables optimized growing environments, boosting crop yields while reducing resource usage. Furthermore, the adaptability and scalability of IoT-based solutions make them suitable for a wide range of crops and farming operations. The proposed automated IoT indoor hydroponic farm system represents a transformative step toward more efficient and eco-friendly food production. This study delves into the design, implementation, and broader implications of these systems, highlighting their potential to revolutionize modern agriculture and promote sustainable food production practices.

articleTitle: Automated Mechanism for Image Capturing, Processing, and Evaluation for various programs using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents an exploration of object detection, a critical application in deep learning characterized by its robust feature learning and representation capabilities. It focuses on typical methodologies such as YOLO, detailing their underlying principles and evaluating their real-time performance and detection accuracy. The existing model, trained for human detection, requires manual data updates and lacks the ability to identify duplicate or inappropriate images. Our project addresses these challenges by developing an enhanced detection system capable of identifying image types, ensuring image clarity by filtering out blurred images and detecting duplicates ensuring, for example, that an image from Day 1 of a workplace is not reuploaded for subsequent days. Additionally, the system is designed to detect trained objects more accurately. This project proposes the development of software that, during image capture, integrates geotagging, pixel analysis for blur detection, duplicate identification, and image type classification to improve the overall efficiency and accuracy of object detection.

articleTitle: Crop and Fertilizer Recommendations with Agriculture Waste Business Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Modern agriculture faces issues like managing soil health, maximizing crop yields, and disposing of agricultural waste. Farmers lack accurate advice, and waste is underutilized, causing environmental threats and economic waste. In order to overcome these difficulties, this research uses soil sensor technology to deliver precise crop and fertilizer recommendations based on temperature, moisture, and soil data collected in real time. By doing this, farmers are guaranteed the ability to make well-informed decisions that result in increased productivity and sustainable agricultural methods. Additionally, the project incorporates advanced tools and technologies such as Machine Learning (ML), and Internet of Things (IoT) devices to enhance data analysis and decisionmaking processes. The project also provides a platform that links farmers with startups and production enterprises to turn agricultural waste into economic prospects. The software helps lessen the impact on the environment and generates new income streams for farmers by allowing the sale of agricultural waste, which promotes a more productive and profitable agricultural ecosystem.

articleTitle: Gastronomic Odyssesy With Home Flavour Aggregator Using IoT Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the busy lives of young professionals, finding wholesome, home-cooked meals is a constant struggle. Many people find it challenging to maintain a balanced diet because of their hectic work schedules and worries about the health effects of the food they eat at restaurants. Current food delivery services, such as Door Dash, Just Eat, Postmates, and Food Panda, mostly provide prepared meals from restaurants and don't provide enough customization choices to accommodate different dietary requirements and tastes. This restricted availability of wholesome, customized meals consequently aggravates health problems among the general public and also there is lot of problems in finding the location of the user who ordered the food . An innovative solution is being developed to address this issue: a home meal delivery app. This technology, which offers a wealth of customization and personalization options, attempts to empower housewives by providing an opportunity to make fresh meals on a cautious and daily basis and also incorporating geofencing to address the location in easy manner with a alarm system. [3] "USER PERSONA MAPPING" is a technique which is used to construct the user persona with frequent use by the customer.

articleTitle: Intelligent Waste Disposal: An Iot Enabled Automated System for Dumpster Monitoring and Medical Segregation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Waste, most notably medical waste, is a major problem to be dealt with within the cities due to the constant increase of complicated and big amounts of disposal. Poor disposal methods for medical waste are major safety concerns for both the environment and people. The IoT-based Smart Dumpster Monitoring & Medical Waste Segregation System and its introduction is the main part for the article. System which is stated is designed to supply information constantly on how much the containers are being filled and among other things the system will collect the medical waste and categorize it based on its nature such as cotton, glass, and plastics. IoT-equipped sensors will detect the material of the waste, distinguish, and place it in the correct bay. Besides that, the system is permanently monitoring the experience filling levels, and if the dumpsters are almost full, then it sends the message to the local waste management authorities who come and take the trash and recycle/dispose of it accordingly. Thus, minimal risks are related to medical waste. Apart from the addition of IoT technology, waste management activities are positively influenced, the number of workers in the process is decreased, and the compliance with health and safety standards is ensured. The technology empowers municipalities to rapidly detect issues and address them by removing/transporting waste to the right destination. It can also give drivers the chance to timely inform other municipalities

articleTitle: Kelp Curer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With the fast growing world there is vast changes in the environment. Global warming, increase in resource intake etc…are the main reasons that the earth is facing threats. Preserving and protecting Mother Nature with their organism is a timely need. Seaweeds which are termed has wonder plants are the marine species which are biologically important. Due to increase in population, there is more need of resources. Seaweeds are a solution for this great resource intake. They have their wings which are spread upon different fields and termed has a key element for many industries. In India the cultivation of seaweeds has increased across the coastal lines of the country. In India’s 2021-22 budget funds were allotted to establish seaweed farms along Tamil Nadu coastal lines with a measurement of 2.2 million sq.km. With this great demand there comes great importance to seaweed. But due to many factors they are considered has endangered species. With this demand there comes a need to preserve them. Our KELP CURER helps to provide a healthy environment for the growth of seaweeds. We help to locate the growth of kelp forests and classify them with our machine learning algorithms. With our sensors we help to provide a healthy environment. Thus, our system helps to provide a good cultivation and protects the environment.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Making In Molasses Extraction Through Neural Network Modeling and Fuzzy Logic Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the sugarcane industry, molasses extraction is a critical process, influenced by various factors such as temperature, pressure, and feedstock quality. Traditional control methods often struggle to adapt to the dynamic nature of this process, leading to inefficiencies and suboptimal outcomes. This paper proposes a novel approach leveraging neural network modeling and fuzzy logic control to enhance decision-making in molasses extraction. By integrating neural networks for predictive modeling and fuzzy logic for adaptive control, the system can effectively handle the nonlinear and uncertain dynamics inherent in the process. Better efficiency, lower energy consumption, and higher product quality of the proposed approach are shown through simulation studies and real-world experimentation when compared to traditional methods. This work offers a feasible approach to optimise molasses extraction and may be used for other related processes in the food and beverage sector. It also advances intelligent control systems in industrial processes.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an AUV with Vision-Aided Guidance and Magnetic Coupled Thrusters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) are commonly employed for exploration and excursions in the current subsea industry. Unfortunately, the mission's endurance is constrained by obstacles, battery limitations, and water leakage beyond certain depths (every 10 meters increases pressure by 1 bar). To enhance endurance, we have introduced a closed-type AUV and intelligent vision-aided approach for docking of docking station, utilizing locomotion’s for magnetic coupled thrusters. This paper presents a machine vision method based on the balancing point of motion and PID control with pixel coordinates, integrating the underwater vehicle's hydrodynamic performance and motion control planning. By using lightweight YOLOv5-based detection of the Docking station, we can get ROI (Region of Interest) coordinates to guide the AUV safely towards the docking station. Simulation tests confirm the viability of these vision-aided guidance, and hardware setups of AUVs with magnetically coupled thrusters are verified.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Strategy for Abnormal Object Detection by YOLOv8 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Machine learning is the ability for computers to learn on their own and improve with time without requiring manual programming. Its main goal is to develop algorithms that can process and analyze massive volumes of data, find patterns in the data, and use the data to make judgments or forecasts. Machine learning algorithms are essentially based on the construction of mathematical models from the input data. These models can recognize correlations between variables since they have been trained on historical data. The model constantly modifies its parameters as new data become available in order to increase prediction or classification efficiency and accuracy.Machine learning in surveillance is akin to equipping a security camera with the ability to think and adapt. It discusses the system to analyze human’s normal and abnormal activities recognition.The proposed research is about the camera system that can do more than just record video; it can also analyze its environment in real time, seeing trends and spotting odd behavior. It can even immediately alert security staff to unusual events, such an unexpected throng or an abandoned object. Machine learning can be used in more complex situations to recognize faces, identify known people from a database, or even forecast potential security events based on behavioral patterns.

articleTitle: Basic EEG Signal Processing and Movement Classification for Mind-Controlled Prosthetic Arm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study presents a preliminary investigation into the feasibility of controlling a prosthetic arm using electroencephalography (EEG) signals. EEG data was collected and pre-processed to isolate relevant brain activity associated with hand movements. Basic feature extraction techniques were applied to quantify these patterns, followed by a simple classification algorithm to distinguish between hand open and closed states. While demonstrating the potential of EEG-based control, this research highlights the need for advanced signal processing, robust feature engineering, and sophisticated machine learning models to achieve accurate and reliable prosthetic control.

articleTitle: Solar Energized Atmospheric Water Generator Using Peltier Device
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Millions of people globally struggling to obtain the water they require to survive. The study provides a creative answer to this important problem: air-to-water generators powered using the sun's energy. These gadgets provides a clean drinking water production method that is sustainable and renewable by drawing water vapor from the atmosphere. We support higher production, technological developments to improve efficiency, and cost-cutting measures to optimize their impact. The widespread use of this technology has the potential to transform water security, boost local economies, and enhance the state of the environment.

articleTitle: Hybridization of ML & DL for Detecting Depression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Persistent sorrow and loss of interest or enjoyment in once pleasurable activities are hallmarks of major depressive illness. It is estimated that 5% of individuals globally experience depression. We propose to create prediction models based on well-known deep architectures that have the potential to produce encouraging outcomes in the identification of facial depression. Our investigation revealed that certain current solutions are deficient in two areas: "1) a small quantity of annotated depression data for deep representation learning; and 2) a significant variance in facial expressions between individuals with identical depression scores and between individuals with varying degrees of depression. We offer a deep joint label distribution and metric learning (DJ-LDML) method and model the identification of face depression as an LDL problem to address these issues. On the other hand, DML seeks to train a deep ordinal embedding using a label-aware histogram loss that is purpose-built to retain semantic similarity across video sequences (as specified by ordinal labels) for the purpose of discriminative feature learning. Overall, we were able to obtain a result from the approach of almost 97% accuracy.

articleTitle: Advanced IoT-Driven Battery Management System for Electric Vehicles Integrated with Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is being utilized to evaluate the development of electric vehicle batteries. As electric vehicles are entirely dependent on battery power, any reduction in the energy supplied to the vehicle directly impacts its performance. However, a significant challenge in battery manufacturing is the consistent decrease in the proportion of energy provided, leading to a decline in battery quality. Because this study proposes using IoT technologies to observe vehicle vision, the verification must be conceivable. The suggested IoT battery check system includes an ESP 32 LCD and a voltage sensor. Electric cars (EVs) are becoming increasingly popular as fuel prices climb. Most electric vehicle batteries are fueled by lithium-particle cells. Because it is contrasted and harsh, it is gentler. It delivers a consistent force and has an energy lifespan that is six to several times longer than that of a corrosive lead-acid battery. Historically, the range of electric vehicles has been limited by battery capacity and body design. The safety of current battery technology remains a key concern, hindering the widespread adoption of electric vehicles. As a result, electric vehicles have generally had a limited range due to these factors. The safety of current battery technology is a primary argument for limiting the adoption of electric vehicles over time. According to the experimental outcomes, the system can identify and notify the user of battery decline.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Fast Fourier Transforms Using Binary Signed Digit Number System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: It is a very efficient way to implement the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and is in use for various applications, such as radar communication, biomedical signal processing, and multicarrier modulation systems. A butterfly step can be implemented as a repetitive multiplier followed by an adder of complex numbers. The current work has made an enormous effort to improve the speed and computational complexity of arithmetic operations occurring inside the butterfly unit by a detailed investigation of different adders and multipliers. A new method to design adder and multiplier for the computation of butterfly is proposed, in which the carry propagation is directed out effectively through a format Binary Signed Digit (BSD). When such two unit results were compared, it was found that the BSD based floating-point butterfly performs much better, giving considerable gains in processing speed and efficiency.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Worker's Safety: IoT-Enabled Smart Helmet for Real-Time Protection and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Worker’s safety is a top priority in today’s world, where they encounter numerous risks daily, especially women worker’s working in night shifts and in industrial sector. This implementation focuses on smart helmet for worker’s that ensures safety by providing real time communication and monitoring. Unlike existing device relies on unreliable Bluetooth, this device integrated with advanced sensors such as MQ3 for alcohol detection, Pulse for heart rate monitoring, and vibration sensors, all controlled by an ARDUINO UNO with AI and IOT technology. The helmet's active LCD display provides real-time feedback on critical metrics, while an integrated buzzer alarm swiftly alerts in case of accidents. A complementary mobile application enables remote monitoring of the wearer's well-being and precise location. This comprehensive approach not only addresses the urgent issue of worker's safety but also represents a significant advancement in leveraging technology for proactive prevention and rapid response for women.

articleTitle: Optimizing Reverse Osmosis Systems: A Novel Approach for Enhanced Water Recovery and Reduced Wastewater Production
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Reverse Osmosis (RO) systems are widely used for water purification, but they are known for producing significant amounts of wastewater, with typical systems discarding up to 70-85% of the input water. This inefficiency not only wastes precious water resources but also increases operational costs and environmental impact. This paper presents an innovative approach to reducing wastewater generated by RO systems without compromising the quality of the purified water. The proposed methodology includes a combination of advanced membrane technologies, optimized system design, and the integration of supplementary water recovery processes. Experimental results demonstrate a substantial reduction in wastewater production, achieving a recovery rate of up to 90%. Additionally, the study explores the energy implications of the modified system and offers a comparative analysis with conventional RO systems. The findings suggest that the proposed solution could lead to more sustainable and cost-effective water purification, making it a viable option for residential, industrial, and municipal applications. Future research directions are also discussed, with a focus on further improving system efficiency and scalability.

articleTitle: Optimizing Regenerative Braking Efficiency with Supercapacitor for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In electric vehicles (EVs), regenerative braking is a key mechanism for energy recovery, typically directing captured energy back into the battery. However, during instances of peak load, the energy generated can surpass the battery’s capacity to store it, resulting in potential energy loss. This project proposes an enhanced regenerative braking system utilizing a hybrid storage configuration composed of both batteries and supercapacitors. The system is designed to efficiently manage and store surplus energy during peak regenerative events. When the electric motor detects high energy levels during braking, an Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) switch activates to channel the excess energy through a bi-directional DC-DC converter into the supercapacitors. This setup allows for normal energy levels to recharge the battery, while only excess energy is diverted to the supercapacitors, optimizing the overall energy capture. The stored energy in the supercapacitors can be returned to the battery when needed, ensuring a consistent power supply and improving the vehicle’s performance. This approach not only minimizes energy loss but also enhances the lifespan of the battery by reducing the frequency of high current charges. The system’s effectiveness is validated through simulation studies, indicating a significant improvement in the regenerative efficiency and operational range of EVs.

articleTitle: Grow Light And Plant Monitoring System For Indoor Gardening
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Indoor gardening has faced problems such as keeping the right amount of water in the soil and sunlight for plants to perform photosynthesis. Plants can easily be seen struggling if they are not exposed to adequate sunlight. This greatly affects their growth and health. This could be surmounted, and hooking up IoT devices into indoor gardening is one very efficient idea. With an IoT system, a gardener can track the moisture level of the soil accurately and get temperature readings. It may also operate on a grow light system, replicating sunlight to provide the plants with the appropriate light spectrum needed for photosynthesis, even in the absence of natural sunlight. Technology like this empowers gardeners to create the most ideal conditions for the growth of their plants, whatever the external weather conditions. This can help plants stay healthy all year round and maintain growth continuously. It vastly improves indoor gardening by making the care of plants easier and helps one to conquer the obstacles that traditionally plagued gardeners.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Optical Sensing Techniques for Non-Invasive Kidney Function Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study introduces an optical sensing system powered by AI for the non-invasive assessment of kidney function. The approach evaluates renal health by employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) after accumulating a substantial quantity of spectral data from kidney tissues using near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy. Traditional diagnostics, such as blood tests and biopsies, are invasive and time-consuming. This method hopes to supplant them with real-time, precise diagnoses. A study with 200 participants, including healthy individuals and patients with varying degrees of renal impairment, demonstrated a 92% accuracy rate for the approach. The sensitivity (94%) and specificity (90%) for the detection of severe renal impairment are both substantial. The potential of an AI-powered optical sensing method to revolutionize kidney function monitoring is illustrated by these findings. Clinical outcomes could be considerably enhanced using rapid and precise assessments.

articleTitle: Smart Electric Billing Management with IoT: Revolutionizing Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: India is the world's third largest producer and third largest consumer of electricity. Traditional billing systems in India lack real-time monitoring, making it difficult to address peak demand efficiently. They often lead to inaccurate billing due to manual readings. These systems do not incentivize offpeak consumption, hindering efforts to optimize energy usage. Embracing modern approaches like IoT and Time-of-Use pricing can enhance accuracy, promote energy efficiency, and also optimize energy consumption based on the demand requirement. To address the increasing energy demands and environmental concerns, the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies, Time-of-Use (TOU) pricing strategies, and machine learning algorithms presents a transformative approach to revolutionize electric billing management. Developing a comprehensive system that combines real-time data acquisition through IoT devices with dynamic pricing based on TOU can optimize energy consumption patterns. Machine learning models are employed to analyze historical usage data, predict consumption patterns, and dynamically adjust pricing to incentivize efficient energy utilization. This aims to enhance user awareness, encourage responsible energy usage, and contribute to a sustainable and resilient energy ecosystem.

articleTitle: Guardian PI : Raspberry Based Night Survaillance Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Personal safety, especially for women during nighttime, remains a pressing concern. The "Guardian Pi" is an innovative solution that leveragesthe Raspberry Pi 4 Model B+ to provide real-time surveillance and emergency response. Equipped with a 360-degree HD camera and a high-frequency sound sensor, the system captures and analyzes environmental data, including audio and video, to detect potential threats. Upon identifying an emergency, the system instantly alerts pre-registered contacts and nearby police stations via email using Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP), providing continuous updates every second. The software, developed in Python, integrates key libraries such as GPIO for hardware interfacing, ensuring a reliable and user-friendly security solution. Guardian PiU aims to enhance nighttime safety by offering a proactive and efficient surveillance system for emergency situations

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Classification Using CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Brain tumors are abnormal cell growths in the brain that can have a major negative impact on one's health. For efficient treatment planning, brain tumor classification must be precise. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been an effective technique for the automated classification of brain tumors in recent years. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is the most popular neural network model for the image classification problem, which has attracted a lot of interest in recent years. In this paper, we suggest a CNN model for classifying brain tumors that performs quite well on a publicly accessible dataset. We contrast our model's performance with that of earlier research and talk about how our findings might have medical applications. Our findings demonstrate the need for more research in this field and show how well CNNs can classify brain tumors. The proposed CNN-based approach aims to accurately classify three major types of brain tumors, namely glioma, meningioma, and pituitary tumor. The results obtained from the experiments show promising results, with an accuracy of over 93%. The proposed CNN-based approach provides a reliable and efficient tool for the classification of brain tumors, which can aid in the accurate diagnosis and treatment planning of patients.

articleTitle: HNNLS: Robust Design to Identify Textile Fabric Defects Using Hybrid Neural Network Assisted Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rising cost of labor combined with increased automation in the textile sector has made studying methods for detecting flaws in fabrics an area of intense interest in recent years. In this study, we present a machine-learning technique for automatic fabric defect identification that employs deep neural network models that have already been pretrained. Pre-processing the fabric pictures using standard image processing techniques yields improved data that is then used to train the networks. In order to train and categorize many fabric flaws, the Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) is utilized. In the performed simulations, the existing textile dataset allows for a maximum categorization accuracy of 97.34%. This classifier model-based detection and categorization system may help humans locate manufacturing flaws in fabric with a high degree of accuracy.

articleTitle: IoTWP: Design and Development of Internet of Things Assisted Weather Prediction Scheme with Advanced Remote Tracking Norms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Technologies with artificial intelligence, such as the Internet of Things and Machine Learning, have recently come to the fore. Numerous Internet of Things hardware platforms are currently accessible. The ThingSpeak IoT platform enables an OLED screen to display the current weather conditions and connect with a microcontroller in both ways through Wi-Fi, making the information available from anywhere in the world. Satellite weather report systems do not provide an accurate depiction of the state of affairs at any given location. However, issues arise when relying on an up-to-date weather forecast. The ESP32 microcontroller is the server in the weather surveillance system, gathering data from the sensors and sending it to a ThingSpeak database, from which the information can be retrieved from any location around the world and shown on an OLED. The Smart weather surveillance system is more affordable and efficient than competing products on the market. The aviation and maritime sectors, as well as agriculture, might all benefit greatly from this effort.

articleTitle: A Novel System to Recognize Human Gaits by Using Intelligent Learning Assisted Feature Analysis Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the recent decade, human gait detection has evolved as a subfield of biometric authentication that uses a person’s motion, time, and clothes to determine who they are. It also works well as a video surveillance system. The fundamental problem with these methods is that conventional methods of extracting and categorizing features waste too much time and produce inaccurate results. Our proposed ensemble deep learning technique for human gait detection takes use of recent developments in deep learning for a wide range of applications, including video monitoring and biometrics. We build a model using the Inception framework and the LightGBM method. The CASIA B dataset is used to fine-tune and train Inception models utilizing transfer learning. The final optimal features are then categorized with a LightGBM classifier. Experiments were run, and the results showed that the suggested model had an average accuracy of 97.25 percent, making it more accurate than recently developed state-of-the-art procedures.

articleTitle: Augmentation of Emotional Intelligence - A Reservoir Computing Driven, EEG-Based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Emotion classification based on Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals hold significant potential for enhancing affective computing applications. This study aims to develop an effective emotion classification system utilizing EEG signals and our research addresses the need for robust methods capable of accurately capturing temporal aspects of EEG data to discern distinct emotional states. Leveraging the capabilities of GRU reservoir computing, we train and evaluate models to classify EEG signals into distinct emotional categories. After robust validation of the execution of the proposed methodology, we compare its performance with the baseline models through metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. In enhancing its classification accuracy, the program had a success rate of 97 percent according to our study which supports this theory. 344 with which it performs the misalignment in capturing the challenges primarily related to the temporal characteristics and non-stationarity of EEG data.

articleTitle: Design and Development of LiFi Assisted Intelligent Data Transmission Using Secured Wireless Communication Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With Li-Fi, data is sent by light, using LED bulbs that can change brightness at a rate quicker than the human eye can detect. Besides illuminating our world, the lights we use every day are also a means of conveying meaning. Radio frequency (RF) communication has problems with interference and significant delays. Additionally, RF communication calls for a unique system for sending and receiving RF waves. In spite of these drawbacks, Visible Light Communication (VLC) is quickly becoming the standard for digital data transmission because to its large bandwidth and resistance to electromagnetic interference. In the present article, we explore a cutting-edge technology called Li-Fi, which has seen rapid advancement in just a few years. One proposal uses the Li-Fi idea to enable communication between vehicles using light-emitting diode bulbs. Many lives can be spared thanks to the ability to prevent and respond to traffic accidents with the aid of this technology. Any kind of data, including music, video, and text, may be sent from one car to another using this Li-Fi technology. This idea has the potential to be executed at a cheap cost and with increased productivity.

articleTitle: Solar PV and Electric Vehicle Synergy: Demand Response Program Evaluation For EV Charging Stations Towards an Optimal Plan for The Region Using Various Split Source Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rising adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) necessitates the development of efficient and reliable charging infrastructure. As EV penetration grows, the associated energy demand poses significant challenges to the stability and efficiency of regional power grids. This study evaluates the implementation of various split source inverter (SSI)f or increasing power quality. The impedance source converters are used for gaining the voltage in single stage to boost the voltage in conversion stage by using various split source inverter. It shows the different types of inverter and various control techniques to help to improve the power conversion. Dc to AC conversion capabilities with single or multi stage with solar PV integration will lead to increase the storage capacity in EV. Moreover comparison of inverters with PV, successfully regulate the voltage and reduce the Total Harmonic Distortion (THD).Grid connected PV system with various topology of SSI needs for power transfer from low voltage to high voltage. The suggested methodology seeks to balance grid requirements, EV battery state of charge, and power balancing constraints with the goal of minimizing operating costs. To take advantage of possible incentives and optimize total system benefits, the optimization model takes into account dynamic pricing schemes and variable solar generation profiles. The incentive-based unit commitment technique can effectively improve the grid integration and economic feasibility of PV systems and EVs in demand response frameworks.

articleTitle: Siren Detector in Public Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The significant challenges posed by the increasing population and its impact on road safety, especially in India for its 17% share of the world's population, need innovative solutions. Our proposed system employs voice recognition technology within an Internet of Things (IoT) framework, utilizing Zigbee for inter-car communication. The integration of these technologies enables real-time communication between vehicles, enhancing traffic coordination and, subsequently, emergency vehicle response. The system's key component is voice recognition, which detects ambulance sirens, triggers alerts, facilitates inter-car coordination, and notifies drivers through an LCD. To tackle ambient noise challenges, a dedicated noise filtering technique is implemented. This multifaceted solution aims to improve emergency vehicle awareness significantly and response on Indian roads, contributing to enhanced road safety in the face of escalating vehicular density and accident rates.

articleTitle: NLP-Based SMS Spam Detection Using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's environment, spam text messages are a common issue and a source of frustration for users. This study suggests a novel method for identifying SMS spam that makes use of natural language processing (NLP), multiple model creation, and ensemble learning. The suggested approach entails pre-processing the data using natural language processing (NLP) techniques including lemmatizing, stemming, and stopword removal in order to extract pertinent features from the text data and convert it into numerical representations. The suggested approach's effectiveness was assessed using an actual dataset and contrasted with conventional machine learning algorithms like SVM and Naïve Bayes.The altered data is used to train the numerous classifiers, and an ensemble learning technique is then used to combine their predictions and produce a more accurate outcome. More precision was provided by the final model than by conventional models. In order to lessen the quantity of spam messages that users get, the research's conclusions may be helpful in the development of an efficient spam SMS detector. Furthermore, the model was hosted using the streamlit web app framework on the cloud-based platform Railway, making it instantly accessible to users without the need to install any software.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques For Wastewater And Water Purification Enhancing Efficiency And Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: With the increasing global demand for clean water and the growing concerns about water scarcity and pollution, there is a pressing need for innovative solutions in wastewater and water purification processes. Machine learning (ML) techniques have emerged as powerful tools for optimizing these processes, enhancing efficiency, and ensuring sustainability. This paper provides a comprehensive review of recent advancements in ML applications for wastewater and water purification, highlighting their potential to revolutionize the water treatment industry. We discuss various ML techniques, including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning, and their applications in different stages of water treatment, such as pretreatment, primary treatment, secondary treatment, and advanced treatment processes. Furthermore, we examine the challenges and opportunities associated with implementing ML in water purification systems, including data quality issues, model interpretability, scalability, and regulatory considerations. Finally, we identify future research directions and potential areas for innovation to further leverage ML for enhancing the efficiency and sustainability of wastewater and water purification processes.

articleTitle: Border Detection for Fishermen Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: At present, the marine security issue includes the protection of fishers and address the rescue in case of illegal border infiltration. To detect the border for fisherman, this study conducted a method of enhancement in border detection essentially utilising the Automatic Identification System (AIS) with the assistance of the Internet of Things (IoT). In the middle sea, to provide boat detection with high precision, the proposed model incorporates Very High Frequency (VHF) communication inspired by X-band radar. The system is able to detect and monitor the boats at sea. To provide the middle sea with a high level of detection and monitoring of boats, system architecture included VHF (Very High Frequency) communication, which was inspired by the X band radar system. The range of AIS was increased using VHF communication. The coastal monitoring stations receive the position and status data from fishing boats with the help of IoT devices. The new AIS technology includes IoT-enabled devices installed on fishing boats. The IoT devices situated on boats send information to coastal monitoring station after sending data. The advanced technology increases the software capabilities of AIS, which will be helpful in the situation where the only AIS information was not enough. The advanced software capabilities improved the range of AIS and the definition capability of the vessels which were identified in the ocean near borders. The Automatic Identification System (AIS) that is being used in the present day has been upgraded and the Internet of Things (IoT) has been introduced. As a result, the system is now capable of much more comprehensive and real-time tracking and monitoring, as well as communication for marine vessels. This combination of technologies strengthens the safety, efficiency, and management of maritime operations by giving ships the Opportunity to connect and exchange data with different sensors, devices, and networks, and thus offering a more detailed and dynamic understanding of vessel activities and environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Automated Anemia Detection Through Fingernail Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide, especially in low- and middle-income nations, suffer from anemia, a common health problem. The disease is characterized by a lack of hemoglobin or red blood cells, which can result in symptoms including weakness and exhaustion as well as serious consequences if ignored. Conventional techniques for identifying anemia usually entail intrusive blood tests, which can be expensive, time-consuming, and sometimes unavailable to a large number of people. In order to overcome these obstacles, this study uses MATLAB to provide an automated, non-invasive method for detecting anemia via fingernail image analysis. This project's main goal is to develop an effective and precise anemia screening tool by utilizing machine learning and image processing methods. The fingernail photos are taken by the system and pre-processed to improve quality and guarantee consistency. The technology uses sophisticated image processing techniques to extract pertinent elements from the fingernail photos, including texture and color characteristics that indicate hemoglobin levels. Machine learning algorithms use these traits to categorize the photos as either anemic or non-anemic. MATLAB is used because of its strong skills in machine learning and image processing. From picture capture and pre-processing to feature extraction and classification, the program streamlines the whole procedure. MATLAB's extensive toolkit makes it possible to manipulate photos effectively and has strong machine learning capabilities, which makes it the perfect platform for creating an automatic detection system. The system is guaranteed to be scalable, simple to install, and accurate through the use of MATLAB. Clinical data is used to thoroughly validate the system's functionality. The machine learning models are trained and tested using images from both non-anemic individuals and patients with clinically confirmed anemia. The system's sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy are assessed to guarantee its dependability.

articleTitle: Ambulance Tracking and Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The Ambulance Tracker application is an advanced, real-time GPS-based system designed to transform emergency medical services (EMS) by providing accurate and continuous tracking of ambulances. This system is built to address critical challenges in emergency response, including delays caused by traffic congestion, inefficient route planning, and lack of coordination among medical teams. The application leverages cutting-edge technology to optimize ambulance dispatch, ensuring that the nearest available vehicle is sent to the emergency location, significantly reducing response times. By integrating live traffic data, hospital resource availability, and patient health information, the system enhances decision-making processes for EMS personnel and hospital staff. Additionally, the application offers a user-friendly interface for patients or their caregivers, allowing them to monitor the ambulance’s progress in real-time. This feature not only provides peace of mind but also helps in preparing the receiving hospital for the patient’s arrival. In urban environments, where every second counts, the Ambulance Tracker application plays a crucial role in improving the efficiency and effectiveness of emergency medical interventions, ultimately saving lives and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Crash Detection and Real Time Location Tracking System for Radio Controlled Aircrafts and Drones
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This study proposes a real-time location finding and crash detection system designed for radio controlled aircraft and drones. The system detects crashes and provides precise location information by combining GPS, accelerometer, and GSM technologies. The system can be used in small radio controlled planes and drones because of its low-power requirements, lightweight, and compact design. In the case of a crash, the system provides precise location coordinates and expedites response by sending SMS alerts to the emergency services or pre-designated contacts. The system’s ability to accurately determine position and detect crashes are demonstrated by the experimental studies. This technology has the potential to significantly increase safe operations of radio controlled planes and drones as well as reduce the response time in a number of drone applications, such as package delivery, search and rescue, and surveillance.

articleTitle: DigiMedi System - A Conceptual Framework For A Web Based Healthcare Information Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: DigiMedi, is a proposed architecture for online health information management in the following generation that is based on existing patient systems and interoperability problems of healthcare providers. This paper focuses primarily on design and presents an approach to improve existing healthcare information systems. Whether it is patient records or identification, Healthcare linkers connect and centralize everything in an aligned fashion giving DigiMedi a one-window solution for a unique identity mechanism that would connect and link patients’ records with ease of availability and updated throughout the healthcare facility you walk into. Some of the key areas it emphasizes are granular permission management so that importantly patient data owned by patients, voice recognition technology for faster and more accurate data entry. It assumes a scenario in which two or more hospitals are working together to share data, simplifying the process and reducing friction. DigiMedi helps by providing an organized approach for addressing the problems that are already quite rampant and paving the way to a rather infallible management of healthcare information.

articleTitle: Smart Sewage Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Because industrial wastewater contains dangerous chemicals, disposing of it presents serious risks to the environment and public health. The goal of this project is to create an intelligent sewage management system that treats industrial wastewater automatically and guarantees that it is safe for reuse or disposal. The system uses an Arduino as its main control unit and a number of sensors (water level, pH, and gas) to monitor and regulate the wastewater treatment operations. Hazardous gases are detected by sensors as wastewater enters the treatment unit and are then safely expelled. Additionally, the system administers neutralizing chemicals as needed and measures the chemical content. Before being released, the treated water is made sure to be safe by frequent monitoring and efficient stirring. This creative solution improves industrial compliance with environmental requirements while also protecting the environment.

articleTitle: Utilizing Genomic Prediction Algorithms for Enhancing Resistance to Fungal Root Rot in Vertical Soilless Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The goal of this project is to improve the resistance of crops to fungal root rot diseases, including Fusarium, Rhizoctonia, and Pythium within vertical soilless farming systems using genomic prediction approaches. Beside merging of the phenotypic and genetic data the study aims at discovering relevant gene markers that are responsible for disease resistance. Molecular biology and bioinformatics approaches shall be used to design decision support systems that will predict the vulnerability of different cultivars to root rot infection given environmental and genetic factors. Vertical soilless farming imposes specific risks and opportunities for disease control and the management of crop disease requires accurate data input.This investigation will contribute to better understanding the genetic variability of resistance-related genes in the target pathogens, as well as help to identify proper, genetically adapted for the high-stress conditions. Lastly, the purpose of the findings is to enhance the stability and productivity of crop yield and food security under conditions of limited soil availability and other aspects of soilless systems. This work therefore provides a call for adopting the best breeding practices combined with modern genomic tools for developing stronger agricultural systems that will be able to withstand biotic stresses.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuning Private GPT For Better Performance And Data Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In recent years, the advancements in natural language processing (NLP) facilitated by large-scale pre-trained models like GPT series have significantly improved various applications. However, concerns regarding user privacy and data security have arisen due to the centralized nature of model training, which often involves vast amounts of sensitive data. To address these concerns, private GPT model development aimed at preserving user privacy while maintaining the efficiency of NLP tasks. methods for protecting privacy, such as multiparty computation, differential privacy, and federated learning to train GPT models without direct access to sensitive data. By incorporating these techniques, private GPT model achieves competitive performance while ensuring data confidentiality and privacy compliance. Furthermore, a comprehensive evaluation of the proposed approach on various NLP benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness in preserving privacy without sacrificing utility.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Model for Interpreting Car Following Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Interpreting car-following behavior is crucial for enhancing traffic behavior analysis and advancing Connected Automated Vehicle (CAV) technique. Traditional models often emphasize the replication of a host vehicle’s behavior based on data from its nearest preceding vehicle, overlooking the possible influence of multiple preceding vehicles. This paper presents an Autoencoder based Deep Learning (ADL) model designed to interpret car-following behaviors within CAV systems. By incorporating kinematic data from multiple preceding vehicles, the model offers a more comprehensive understanding of the factors influencing car-following dynamics. The proposed ADL framework integrates a bidirectional GRU neural network as the encoder with an attention-based GRU neural network as the decoder, enabling a robust end-to-end interpretation. The NGSIM dataset is used for training and validating the ADL model, which offers detailed car-following data involving multiple preceding vehicles. Experimental results reveal that the inclusion of data from multiple preceding vehicles enhances the model’s capability to interpret and predict heterogeneous driving behaviors accurately. Additionally, the ADL model outperforms traditional car-following models in predicting simulated speeds and positions.

articleTitle: Logical Evaluation of Student Performance Analysis with Marks and Behavior Using Modified Deep Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: It is essential that institutions use Educational Data Mining and Deep Learning to recognize academically poor students and assist them by establishing various recommendation systems to improve their effectiveness. By revealing valuable undetected trends in a student's data, these tools guide pupils in making decisions about their future. Ensemble Artificial Neural Networks and Light Gaussian Mixture Models are proposed for use in this study's prediction of students' academic achievement. The main aim of this research also set out to identify a common thread among the most popular ANN methods and techniques. Findings showed that ANN is always employed in tandem with data analysis and data mining approaches, permitting research to evaluate the efficacy of their findings in assessing its efficiency of evaluating academic success. When compared to existing machine-learning and deep-learning models, the suggested ensemble model performed better on a wide range of criteria. The suggested approach accomplished a remarkable precision that was higher than previously suggested models.. Additional research should look into a larger variety of student activities, a larger sample size of students, and a longer time span.

articleTitle: Cognitive Intrusion Detection System In Autonomous Vehicles Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The "Cognitive Intrusion Detection System In Autonomous Vehicles Using Machine Learning" project aims to enhance the security and safety of connected vehicles within the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) ecosystem. Ensuring the integrity and security of vehicle communication networks is crucial in the context of growing automation and connectedness in transportation as it guards against malicious assaults and unauthorized access. The "Cognitive Intrusion Detection System In Autonomous Vehicles Using Machine Learning" significantly enhances the safety and security of autonomous vehicles by swiftly identifying and mitigating potential cyber threats, thereby ensuring the integrity of vehicle operations and fostering trust in future transportation systems. Through real-time monitoring and proactive alerting, this system effectively protects against malicious assaults and unauthorized access, contributing to the advancement of secure and resilient Internet of Vehicles infrastructures.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Different Machine learning techniques for Solar Energy Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Solar panels are more efficient and economical. The use of solar energy not only reduces our reliance on non-renewable fossil fuels, but it also contributes to climate change mitigation by lowering carbon emissions. This paper presents a comprehensive and comparative study of solar energy production forecasting using machine learning (ML) algorithms: Support Vector Regression (SVR), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Generalised Additive Model (GAM), LSTM-RNN and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBOOST), all based on daily data from Solar Power Plants. The models underwent training, testing, and evaluation. This study used metrics to evaluate the model's performance: mean absolute error (MAE), and Accuracy. It can be seen that the LSTM-RNN model had a major edge in its capacity to learn and translate relationships, near or remote, in the time-series data.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Smart CubeSat for Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a smart CubeSat utilized for environmental monitoring, consisting of various types of atmospheric sensors integrated with Arduino IDE board. Due to the high sustainability, economic feasibility, and compact size, CubeSats have been deployed. In this paper, we aim to collaborate real time data monitoring with a stable ground station to acquire relevant data. This paper also highlights the payload weight of the structure obtained, empirical formulas for the calculations involved, material selection, and statistical data highlighting the expected results. The designed CubeSat offers a prototype version of the actual model. It addresses the challenges and solutions for environmental monitoring. The launch of CubeSat is planned using Helium Balloon launch.

articleTitle: Survey on Advanced Techniques for Cardiac Arrest Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Cardiac arrest has been a leading cause of mortality worldwide, with limited opportunities for intervention. This project introduces a novel machine-learning approach to predict and process cardiac arrest risk in high-risk patients. Our system integrates 1. Advanced signal processing techniques for ECG analysis 2. Deep learning algorithms for pattern recognition 3. Real-time monitoring and alert system. By analyzing ECG data, medical history, and vital signs, our system provides personalized risk scores, enabling early intervention and improving patient outcomes. Our approach has the potential to revolutionize cardiac arrest prediction, saving lives and reducing healthcare costs.

articleTitle: A Novel Internet of Things Assisted Accident Prevention System using Logical Sensors and Tracking Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The alarming rise in traffic problems and car collisions can be directly attributed to the rising global population. The number of people killed and injured on the world’s roads is rising at an alarming rate. However, the fundamental reason for the rise in deaths is the length of time it takes for emergency personnel to arrive at the scene. Rescue workers have the potential to save many lives if they are effective. Congestion on the roads or a breakdown in contact with the hospitals is to blame for the holdup. The proliferation of IoT devices offers a potential answer by decreasing the frequency with which accidents occur. In this study, we describe a smart system that can detect and prevent accidents, as well as inform drivers and passengers. The technology constantly checks the distance between the vehicle and any impediments in its path. The primary goal of this model is to reduce collisions during sharp turns like hairpins and U-turns. When a predetermined distance is reached, an alarm will be sent to the driver to regulate the speed, and the vehicle will automatically slow down. Also, a MQ3 Sensor is utilized to determine if the driver has been drinking. If he’s been drinking, the car won't start and an alarm will be sent to the proper authorities.

articleTitle: Deep Computational Based Blocking Effect Cancellation for Digital Image Compression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Large multimedia-based applications need that academics find a more effective approach to use images in their apps as image data continues to grow. Image quality evaluation is crucial in image processing systems, especially when images are compressed for transmission. Because of the blocking effect that co-efficient quantification causes during image compression, the decompressed image has poor quality. The coefficient quantification of blocking effect removes high frequency component in the image, consecutively results in discontinuous leaps and reduces the quality of the image. Generally, the objective function is used to perform optimization on complex image processing task. Compression artefacts, noise, and designed linear or non-linear degradations in compressed images. To recover linear and nonlinear distortion from distorted images, image de-blocking techniques are applied. Deblocking techniques accepted by police and vigilance division to improve valuable evidences via ruined pictures of observations. An ordinary encoding and decoding quality characteristic of most digital images is the neighboring pixels that are related and subsequently extracts the unwanted disturbances. Our primary goal is to identify the less correlated representation of the digital photos through our research. There are three steps in our proposed approach, step 1 is the statistical feature removal using curvelet transform, then step 2 is the down-sampling of the image with blocking effect artefacts, finally step 3 is the usage of Quality Defined Convolutional Neural Network (QD-CNN) for the removal of blocking effect artefacts then finally the performance validation is carried out using quality assessment.

articleTitle: Wireless Simulator: Empowering Remote Operations By Demystifying Modulation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs), which are extremely efficient and long-lasting, have been created as a result of technological developments in solid-state lighting. Along with becoming increasingly popular for use in traditional lighting, these LEDs are also being investigated for a cutting-edge use in Visible Light Communication (VLC). Utilising a VLC transmission system, VLC has the potential to be a practical access technique for vehicular networking. The GNU Radio framework, which was used to build Universal Software Radio Peripheral software-defined radios, serves as the system's foundation. With a photodiode serving as the receiver and a conventional automobile lamp acting as the sender. Applications for vehicle networking can greatly benefit from the many features that VLC offers. Our system also accommodates a number of modulation techniques, such as OOK (On-Off Keying), ASK (Amplitude Shift Keying), FSK (Frequency Shift Keying), and PSK (Phase Shift Keying). Modelling of the system's performance has shown outstanding distance dependability independent of the time of day in terms of Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Bit Error Rate (BER).

articleTitle: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Global Healthcare Sector Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to revolutionize many aspects of healthcare, including diagnosis, treatment planning, medicine discovery, and healthcare management. This research examines the current applications, benefits, and drawbacks of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare on a global scale. Artificial intelligence has considerably enhanced personalized treatment recommendations, hospital management, and diagnostic precision, particularly in the fields of radiology and pathology. Artificial intelligence (AI) is reducing the time and money required to bring new treatments to market by speeding up the search for innovative medicines and enhancing the accuracy of efficacy estimates. The use of AI in healthcare still faces challenges, despite these advancements. The integration of AI into current systems, the protection of user data, and the prevention of algorithmic bias are all significant concerns. Clinical decision-making with AI presents serious ethical concerns, particularly for patients' rights to make their own decisions and for the doctor-patient relationship as a whole. The disparities in AI adoption throughout the world highlight the need for developed and poor nations to work together to provide equitable access to AI. This study investigates the profound influence of artificial intelligence (AI) on the healthcare sector, emphasizing its market expansion, revenue growth, and applications across various medical disciplines. The AI healthcare market is expected to grow from $19.27 billion in 2023 to $613.81 billion by 2034, reflecting a significant annual increase driven by technological advancements and rising demand for high-quality care. The compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 40.2% projected from 2022 to 2029 illustrates the rapid adoption of AI technologies. Generative AI revenue in healthcare is projected to rise from $1.07 million in 2022 to $21.74 million by 2032, highlighting its expanding role in enhancing medical services. AI is notably prevalent in radiology, comprising 75.2% of its applications, but its impact extends to other fields such as cardiovascular care and neurology, where it enhances diagnostic precision and treatment effectiveness. The study also explores the growing use of AI-powered medical imaging, virtual assistants, and chatbots, marking a shift towards more accurate and efficient healthcare delivery. By examining these trends, the research aims to offer insights into how AI can address current healthcare challenges, optimize costs, and advance medical services, particularly in developing regions. This analysis underscores the need for continued investigation into AI’s potential to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: EmpowerED - Revolutionizing E-Learning for Diverse Abilities through AI/ML
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: To find ways to enhance the e-learning experiences for students with hearing impairments (HI) and visual impairments(VI), this paper investigates the integration of AI/ML technologies. With the objective to transform education, the study looks into integrating sign language, interactive communication technologies, text adaptation, user-friendly interfaces, and adaptable approaches to teaching. The proposed system incorporates advanced AI/ML techniques to enhance accessibility, including real-time transcription of spoken content using deep neural networks (DNN) for HI users. Additionally, a Speech-to-Hand Signs process is developed using Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to convert spoken language into sign language. For VI users, an advanced Text-to-Speech (TTS) module, powered by algorithms like RNN, is implemented to generate natural-sounding audio from written educational materials. The system further includes an adaptive teaching approach, dynamically adjusting to individual learning styles using NLP and RNN-based models to offer personalized learning pathways, adaptive assessments, and feedback. This AI/ML-driven platform aims to create an inclusive, adaptive, and efficient e-learning environment for students with hearing, visual, and mobility impairments.

articleTitle: Optimizing Forensic Analysis and Security in Cloud Environments Through Game Theory Optimized Recursive GRU Model and Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Strong protection against cyber threats is ensured by forensic analysis and cloud environment security being reinforced by the use of real-time threat detection and advanced encryption technologies.The existing approach struggles to keep up with changing cyber threats and lack the strategic thinking skills necessary to address new security issues. To overcome these drawbacks, this work presents a novel method that maximizes security and forensic analysis in cloud-based settings by fusing blockchain technology, the game theory, and recursive Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models. The behavioral analytic capabilities of the recursive GRU models are especially helpful for detecting patterns and anomalies in security-related cloud logs, as evidenced by the UNW-NB15 dataset. Its flexibility is essential for identifying changing cyber threats and identifying anomalous user behavior. Using blockchain technology to create a decentralized, immutable ledger helps to mitigate data integrity issues that may arise from forensic investigation in cloud environments. This ledger guarantees the accuracy of data for forensic examinations, and smart contracts which come with built-in security features automate access controls and security issue remedies. Because blockchain is decentralized, it reduces individual points of failure, which improves the security of cloud infrastructure as a whole. By synchronizing security occurrences in real-time with the blockchain, the proposed connection creates a reliable and unchangeable record. Programmed intelligent agreements respond quickly to security incidents by issuing alerts or executing specified actions, as detected by the recursive GRU model. Through the use of continuous learning techniques, the model continuously adjusts to new data, improving its comprehension of both common and uncommon tendencies based on security incidents recorded on the blockchain. In cloud environments, this approach seeks to improve safety, openness, and effectiveness in forensic investigation with a 95% detection accuracy compared to existing methods like CNN, LSTM and DNN. The implementation of forensic threat detection analysis is done by python tool and ganache for Block chain technology.

articleTitle: Atomic Changes: Enhancing Portfolio Management for Emerging Investors through Advanced Technology and Personalized User Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Effective portfolio management is essential for transforming investments into profitable ventures, particularly for new investors who often face challenges due to their limited knowledge and experience. While investing has become a popular means of generating passive income, the complexity of managing diversified portfolios can be overwhelming. This research aims to develop a unified platform that provides comprehensive statistical analysis and guidance for managing investment portfolios. Our objective is to help investors optimize returns, manage risks, preserve capital, and ensure liquidity, all while aligning with individual investor preferences. Emerging investors, eager to explore multiple asset classes, frequently encounter financial setbacks due to inadequate guidance and the complexities of portfolio management. Despite the availability of numerous educational resources, these investors struggle with effective decision-making and strategic diversification necessary to balance risk and return. The volatile and dynamic nature of financial markets further complicates this process, necessitating continuous monitoring and timely adjustments. This research underscores the importance of comprehensive strategies that empower investors to navigate the complexities of portfolio management. By addressing these challenges, we aim to facilitate better decision-making, enabling investors to achieve optimized portfolio performance through vigilant and adaptive management practices.

articleTitle: Financial Fraud detection using Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The detection of financial crime in transactions has emerged as a major challenge for organisations internationally, impacting significantly on both the financial and reputational preparedness of organizations. This study examined the outcomes of both supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques in the identification of potentially fraudulent transactions. The study employed Logistic regression, a widely-assimilated supervised learning method, to afford the ability to forecast the possibility of the contracts being fraudulent, based on the predictive analysis of transaction and demographic features. In addition, an unsupervised learning model, K-means clustering, was examined to investigate and congress organization of natural groupings in the data, enabling the provider of deeper insights in terms of transaction behaviours and highlighting clusters with potentially higher fraud exposure. The results afforded a robust analysis of fraudulent behaviours when the two types of analysis were then combined, whereby logistic regression facilitated prediction and clustering facilitated exploration of the data. The data ultimately indicates that logistic regression is a reasonable model for real-time fraud detection, whilst clustering allows the user to uncover hidden patterns of transactions that may be leveraged in fraudulent transactional strategy discussion, thought or consideration. The outcome could indicate interest in investment planning in machine learning models to be integrated in various financial systems to enable prevention through detection or mitigation of continued fraudulent seeking intentions by the perpetrator.
