Future studies may focus on improved model capabilities and application through complex designing and modelling through theory execution or otherwise, and potentially implement instantaneous fraud systems which benefit from contingencies outlined in designed research programming.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Advances in Brain Tumor Classification: Leveraging VGG16 and MobileNetV2 for Accurate MRI Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: These modern deep learning models, such as VGG16 and MobileNetV2 will be utilized in this study to classify Brain tumors from a unique specialized MRI dataset The dataset consists of brain tumor original and augmented images as a two-class (yes/no) classification problem domains, where yes indicates the presence of a tumor while learns no corresponds to its absence. Two models VGG16 and MobileNetV2 support deep convolutional layer operations, well known for their very deep architecture; the other one is optimized over efficiency with depth-wise separable convolutions and is used to evaluate their performance in accurately classifying MRI images. The models use similar data preprocessing and regularization techniques; however, their performance metrics are different. Accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are the evaluation metrics for each of the five models to understand how well these differentiate between tumor images versus non-tumor images. This study is designed to improve the ability of brain tumor detection, thereby assisting in more reliable diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Precision Hydration for Plant Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The most difficult and time-consuming gardening activity in daily life is watering. Watering the plants by hand already creates additional challenges and is a laborious procedure. Humanity has created "Automatic plant watering systems," which help us water plants naturally and save water, so that we can live more intelligent lives. Without any assistance from humans, this automated plant watering system will make sure that the soil stays hydrated. In this system, the AtMega328 microcontroller is employed. This method not only saves labor costs but also lets us save water, which lessens the chance of overwatering. The goal of developing this method was to reduce the need for manual labor and facilitate the work of gardeners. Every plant surpasses their capacities in gardens when this design is used. By doing away with the necessity for a human staff, this automated plant watering system saves crucial time. On sizable administration buildings, solar panels can be installed to save energy.

articleTitle: VoteChain: Promising a Secure and Transparent Election using Blockchain and Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Democratic voting is one of the significant aspects of governance that has various complications which are as follows; Complication arising from transparency Complication arising from low voter turnout Complication arising from vulnerability to the manipulation of the elections Complication arising from low confidence in the election process Complication arising from forgery of voter id cards Complication arising from delays in the announcement of the results Complication arising from security breach. All these issues erode the credibility of elections and public faith. To them, blockchain has a perfect solution in that it is decentralized, secure, transparent, and cannot be tampered with technology. To realize our e-voting system, we built an evoting application as a smart contract on the Ethereum platform using digital wallets and solidity. A given voter is assigned tokens (gas) which are utilized every time they cast their vote in order to eliminate vote forgeries and other undesirable incidents. This blockchain-based system does not require physical polling stations; also, voting is scalable and secure with flexible consensus algorithms, cryptographic hashing, and measures in response to a 51% attack. It also incorporates fingerprint scanning, to further discourage fraud and make sure that the process is completely secure and transparent. Since these records are stored in a blockchain, the ability of a single unscrupulous agency trying to manipulate the records is very hard given that records are validated by the nodes in the network, making the voting process more secure and credible.

articleTitle: Analyzing Water Using a Locomotary Device with MCU
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The necessity for more thorough monitoring of water quality is highlighted by the growing difficulty in guaranteeing access to drinkable water, especially in rural areas where there is population increase and ineffective government. The drawbacks of conventional sampling and laboratory analysis, which are frequently expensive and time-consuming, have been addressed by the development of an inventive approach. The technology continuously measures characteristics including pH, electrical conductivity, and turbidity to deliver real-time insights into water quality through the use of a wireless, multi-sensor network. Outfitted with a remotely operated boat intended for navigating dynamic bodies of water, such as rivers, lakes, and reservoirs, the method overcomes the limitations of stationary monitoring systems that have trouble with spatial unpredictability. For the management and treatment of water resources, an all-inclusive system allows for effective, real-time monitoring and prompt response.

articleTitle: Advanced Pansharpening Techniques for Satellite Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research develops an algorithm for efficiently fusing multiple satellite images, addressing challenges like varying spatial resolutions, spectral bands, radiometric differences, and geometric distortions. Objectives include creating a robust preprocessing pipeline, evaluating fusion algorithms, using quality metrics to assess performance, exploring applications such that land cover classifier and change detection and benchmarking against existing methods. The aim is to enhance satellite image processing, aiding environmental monitoring and urban planning. The proliferation of satellite sensors, each with unique strengths and weaknesses, has increased the need for image fusion to derive comprehensive information from datasets. Fusion techniques leverage the strengths of individual sensors, providing detailed spatial information, spectral diversity, and temporal variations. This integration leads to improved image quality, enhanced feature extraction, and more accurate analysis. The demand for satellite imagery in agriculture, environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management drives the development of advanced algorithms for producing more informative and actionable data.

articleTitle: Integrating AI and ML for Dynamic Pricing Strategies: Innovations in Marketing Analytics and Revenue Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The focus of the research is the difficulty of using AI and machine learning to optimize dynamic pricing techniques. The paper provides a thorough method for dynamic pricing using K-Means clustering for client segmentation, reinforcement learning for real-time price changes, and LSTM networks for demand forecasting. Compared to previous models, the suggested model produced a 30% boost in revenue, an 85% customer satisfaction rating, a 28% market share, and a 50% decrease in average response time after being trained and tested on a large retail dataset. These outcomes show how much better the model can perform than more conventional pricing techniques. Better pricing accuracy and response to market circumstances are other enhancements that result in improved client experiences and increased profitability. According to the study's conclusion, AI-driven dynamic pricing models can completely transform pricing strategies across a range of sectors and provide a scalable and practical answer for companies looking to maximize profits while maintaining a high level of customer happiness.

articleTitle: Intelligent Agritech Rover: Real-Time Data Logging and Machine Learning for Optimal Crop Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The main purpose of the project is to help the farmers who are not aware of the crop which suits their soil quality, soil nutrients, soil composition, the amount of water and its nutrients the crop needs and to identify the early maturation and the type of disease of the plants This project proposes to help farmers to check the soil quality to get a good crop yield before cultivating the agriculture field and determine the irrigation system with the suitable amount of water needed for the crop and also detect the early maturation and type of disease in a crop For this problem, Machine learning is an essential approach for achieving practical and effective solutions. The work proposes to help farmers check the soil quality and determines oxygen level in water depending on the analysis done based on a data mining approach. The work also uses a rover to identify the early maturation and the type of disease in a crop. Data mining is the process of analysing data from a different perspective and summarizing it into useful information. Thus the system predicts the soil quality and the potassium, phosphorus, and nitrogen content needed to maximize the crop yield for better cultivation based on their soil types by approaching suitable fertilizers. The system captures the image from the rover and determines the early maturation and the type of disease in a crop by analysing the pre-defined data sets such as colour, size etc.,

articleTitle: A Systemic Review on Automatic Acoustic Scene Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Speech research is marked as a most challenging areas among the several challenging research areas. The present literature is analyzed and projected to aid future investigations of the global speech research community. The problems concerned with the acoustic scene corpora, front end algorithms yielding to efficient scene representation, back end engines which outright chore of recognition, are projected in this study. Many works on acoustic scene recognition are analyzed from the perspective of machine learning and deep learning, time length, conviction of development and accessibility. The powerful techniques tending to rich features and robust scene recognition are enlightened in this research review.

articleTitle: Beyond Weather and Terrain: A Biodegradable Drone System for Resilient Epidemic-Aware Deliveries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In disaster-stricken zones, efficient and reliable delivery of essential supplies is crucial. This paper introduces an innovative biodegradable drone designed to operate in all-weather and all-terrain conditions, offering high accuracy in delivering basic food, water, and medicine packages. Utilizing a graphene-based aero gel body, bamboo fibre composite wings, and chitin-based bioplastic propellers, the drone exemplifies sustainability without compromising performance. Its advanced navigation algorithms enable effective operation across diverse terrains, ensuring stable flight and precise delivery even in challenging environments. The integration of biodegradable materials aligns with eco-friendly practices while maintaining cost efficiency. This drone system aims to enhance disaster relief efforts by providing a robust solution for critical supply distribution, thus improving response times and operational effectiveness in affected areas.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Efficiency and Sustainability through Smart Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This research paper presents a Smart Energy Management System (SEMS) designed to tackle energy consumption challenges in rural areas. The project's main objective is to create an innovative solution that not only monitors energy use but also offers actionable insights for optimizing it [1]. The methodology combines hardware components like Arduino microcontrollers, ESP8266 Wi-Fi modules, and current sensors with software algorithms and machine learning techniques [3]. These are integrated into an energy monitoring system deployed in rural households [4]. The system collects energy consumption data, transmits it via Wi-Fi [2], and analyzes it in real-time, enabling users to make informed decisions and reduce energy consumption [5]. Key findings from the implementation include a noticeable reduction in energy usage [6], identification of energy-intensive appliances and peak demand periods [7], and the feasibility of integrating renewable energy sources like solar panels [8]. The implications are significant, as this system empowers residents to lower energy bills, reduce grid strain, and promote environmental sustainability [9]. It also has the potential for broader global applications in addressing energy challenges in remote regions [10]. This research contributes to the field of smart energy management, offering insights for policymakers, utility providers, and researchers working towards United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 7: Affordable and Clean Energy [11].

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Software Defect Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Background: Software defect prediction is a critical aspect of software engineering, allowing the prediction and diagnosis of defects before deployment to enhance software quality and reliability. Methods: This study employs machine learning techniques to develop a comprehensive solution for software fault prediction. The research begins with data preparation and preprocessing, which includes addressing missing values, encoding categorical variables, and splitting the dataset into training and testing sets. Three machine learning models—Decision Trees, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Logistic Regression—are then trained on the processed dataset. Results: The performance of these models is evaluated using accuracy, F1 score, recall, precision, and Jaccard index metrics. Logistic Regression achieves an accuracy of 0.7691, an F1 score of 0.1823, a recall of 0.1596, a precision of 0.2125, and a Jaccard index of 0.1002. K-Nearest Neighbors records an accuracy of 0.8266, an F1 score of 0.2237, a recall of 0.1549, a precision of 0.4024, and a Jaccard index of 0.1259. Decision Trees exhibit an accuracy of 0.8191, an F1 score of 0.4039, a recall of 0.3802, a precision of 0.4308, and a Jaccard index of 0.2531. Concluding Remarks: The findings highlight that Logistic Regression performs best in terms of accuracy, while Decision Trees excel in F1 score and precision. These insights emphasize the importance of careful model selection and evaluation criteria in optimizing software defect prediction systems. This study provides valuable guidelines for developers and researchers looking to integrate machine learning techniques into software defect prediction processes.

articleTitle: Transformer-Enhanced U-Net with Transfer Learning for Accurate Detection of Eye Coloboma
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Eye coloboma is a type of congenital eye abnormality that causes developmental abnormalities of the eye which may culminate in eye disorders that fundamentally derange eyesight. Fractional and timely diagnosis remains highly important to its proper managing and treating. This work proposes a model with a Transformer-Enhanced U-Net design implemented with Transfer Learning to enhance the ability of the model to detect and segment eye coloboma from medical imaging data. This work builds upon the benefits of U-Net which has shown promising results especially in the biomedical image segmentation problem through addition of transformer modules that introduce long range dependencies and contextual information. This enhancement makes helps the model to pay more attention to such minor aspects as coloboma and general diagnostic accuracy consequently. Thanks to Transfer Learning with a pretrained backbone, for example Efficient Net the system is provided with Feature Representations recovered from large datasets that are already available and training time is drastically cut short while the performance of the system is not compromised at all.The approach includes fine-tuning of Transformer-Enhanced U-Net model using a selected set of eye images, labelled for coloboma existence. By including the self-attention mechanism, the model is capable of focusing on the critical regions in the image, increasing its responsiveness to any form of coloboma. Preliminary tests show that this scheme performs better than the standard convolutional networks for segmenting complex regions by minimizing false negatives. Further, the model’s flexibility to different imaging conditions demonstrates its suitability in realistic clinical applications. The objective of this research is to come up with a dependable, Auto-Generated diagnostic tool that will help the ophthalmologists in the early diagnosis of the eye related illnesses hence making increased positive outcomes for eye patients. The Transformer-Enhanced U-Net is an enhancement that brings a paradigm shift in utilizing state-of-art deep learning technology for accurate identification of eye coloboma.

articleTitle: Enhanced Liver Tumor Localization Based on Couinaud Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Liver tumor localization is an essential job in clinical imaging evaluation, which includes determining the place of a tumor in the liver from clinical images such as CT checks. This job is essential for the precise medical diagnosis, therapy preparation, and tracking of liver cancer cells. Deep discovering methods, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have revealed guaranteeing lead to clinical image evaluation, consisting of liver tumor localization. Image refining offers a precise and automated technique for the very early discovery and medical diagnosis of growths. Our technique consists of the effective removal of functions from Creation integrated with recurring and pre-trained weights. This system investigates the idea of revealing how a pre-trained deep neural network makes decisions. It entails dissecting the internal layers and condensing the characteristics that influence forecasts. The suggested technique enhanced segmentation method to identify liver growths. It improved the accuracy of the afflicted by the tumor to 99%.Keywords— Cybersecurity, Chaos based permutation, Discrete Cosine Transform, Local Feature, Spatial Pyramid matching, Bag of words, OTP.

articleTitle: Implementation of Highly Secured Electronic Voting System using BlockChain Enabled Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)

authors.preferredName: Narni V V S Srinivasa Rao

abstract: Throughout the years, electronic voting has developed as an alternative to paper ballot voting to reduce duplication and errors. The outcomes of electronic voting over the past three decades suggest that it hasn't been particularly effective due to the various security and privacy issues observed throughout time. There is no limit to the use cases that may be served by blockchain technology, which are ideal for distributed economies. In this work, we suggest an electronic voting system that makes use of blockchain technology. The suggested concept is implemented as an Android app with improved safety features including authentication and permission. An individual’s fingerprints are used for both authentication and authorization, complementing the use of a unique identifying key for verification. The block chain can be deployed more reliably in mass electoral voting without the need for a centralized authority body. A low-cost voting mechanism that utilizes a more secure block chain (which cannot be altered by any other voter or by a third party).

articleTitle: CardioNet: An Integrative AI-Machine Learning Framework for Enhanced Prediction and Management of Cardiovascular Diseases Using Deep Data Analytics and Clinical Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Cardio Vascular Disease (CVD) causes dysfunction in our heart and blood arteries, which frequently results in death or paralysis. Therefore, many lives can be prevented by the early and automatic recognition of CVD. Although this goal has been the subject of numerous studies, performance and dependability can yet be enhanced. This work represents another advancement in that direction. Given that cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) remain the primary cause of death worldwide, effective strategies for early detection and management are necessary. To help with CVD prediction and management, we introduce CardioNet, an integrated machine learning framework with strong data analytics and clinical insights. To accurately predict the risk and progression of CVD, CardioNet integrates state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms with a variety of medical data sources, including genetic profiles, imaging data, and electronic health records. CardioNet integrates clinical information and feedback mechanisms to offer customized risk assessment and therapy suggestions. This, in turn, improves patient outcomes and lowers the cost of healthcare. The potential of CardioNet as a comprehensive strategy to counter the widespread threat of CVDs is highlighted.

articleTitle: Integrating Real-Time Health Data with Emergency Services for Improved Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In emergency situations, timely medical intervention is crucial for saving lives. However, delays in rescue operations often occur due to the time taken to notice and respond to accidents. This paper proposes a wearable smartwatch system designed to reduce rescue times by automating the alert process. The smartwatch, powered by an Arduino Nano microcontroller, integrates a vibration sensor to detect impacts and immediately triggers an emergency protocol. Utilizing a GSM module, the system sends instant notifications to the nearest ambulance service and hospital, providing exact location and essential patient details. This pre-arrival information enables medical teams to prepare in advance, ensuring immediate care upon arrival. Additionally, the device notifies the patient's relatives, including hospital details, so they can proceed directly to the medical facility without delay. The smartwatch also leverages an ESP32 microcontroller for IoT data logging, recording crucial health data such as heart rate, body temperature, and known allergies to a cloud-based platform. This data is accessible to medical professionals, offering critical insights necessary for proper treatment. By providing comprehensive patient information, the system allows healthcare providers to make informed decisions quickly, enhancing the effectiveness of emergency response and potentially saving lives by minimizing delays and improving the accuracy of medical interventions.

articleTitle: A Robust Design of Intelligent Healthcare Monitoring and Alert Mechanism using Internet of Things with Learning Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Professionals in the sector are always on the lookout for state-of-the-art electronic devices that make it simpler to recognize inside body consistency, thanks to the plethora of advances in recent years. With the help of IoT-enabled methodologies, cutting-edge, noninvasive healthcare support systems are now a real possibility. The goal of this research was to document the process of implementing an Internet of Things-based health surveillance system. Covidia virus type 19 people, those with hypertension, those with diabetes, etc. Our solution uses Bluetooth to transmit vital signs readings from a patient’s thermometer, heart rate monitor, and oxygen saturation (SpO2) monitor to a smartphone app. Information about patients will be transmitted online at the partnered medical facility. While hospitalized, the patient’s health status will be continually monitored by the attending physician. Having access to a patient’s medical history as well as information before the patient ever arrives at the hospital is a huge time saver and convenience for both the patient and the doctor. The hospital personnel can better prepare for a patient’s treatment if they have access to their medical records.

articleTitle: Enhanced Approach to Study the Neural Stem Cell Migration through Image Processing using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Neural stem cells are a specific type of stem cells that are unique in their capacity to self-renew and differentiate into neurons and glial cells, including neurons, oligodendrocytes and astrocytes the latter contributing to the developmental process of the nervous system. In a bid to implement this approach in identifying imaging features related to neural stem cells, this study aims at using deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) at a middle level. In the study, the primary focus is laid on the consideration of the distribution of the number of CD133+ neural stem cells as well as their possible migration in rat brain areas. Absolute quantification studies delineated marked qualitative differences in the localization of these cells across distinct regions of the brain. Most importantly, we found out that CD133+ neural stem cells could move from subventricular zone (SVZ) to almost near different parts of the brain including ganglia, corpus callosum and cerebral cortex. Before undergoing surgery, the activity of the rats was trained through water maze learning, respectively recording their escape latency (EL) at the time point of one week, two weeks, and one month. The findings clearly showed that EL was longer in the cerebral ischemia-reperfusion as compared with the sham-operated control group. Nevertheless, a significant decrease in EL was seen in the group treated with electroacupuncture after ischemia-reperfusion. From this it could be extrapolated that electroacupuncture may improve the viability and differentiation of newly generated neural stem cells into both glial and neuronal lineages. In extension, electroacupuncture promoted new neuron formation and a subset was found to be functional when they secreted acetylcholine. Taken together, the present study showed that electroacupuncture facilitated neurological recovery in cerebral ischemia-reperfusion rats.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Personalized Pregnancy Care: Exploratory Data Analysis and Ensemble Learning or Personalized Prediction of Gestational Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The disease in endocrine metabolic named as Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) is found in pregnant womens due to carbohydrate intolerance. The impact of this disease will not be severe if it is detected early. The prediction model deploys machine learning algorithms to identify the cause and factors. If the dataset have no missing values then only machine learning algorithms outperforms well. These challenges must be addressed. It can be implemented through various perspectives of algorithms with different features. The model must adapt mining the features from the data which eliminates the wrong assumptions and constraints. This proposed model helps to construct the missing data and make it complete one. In order to implement this concept, entire dataset is applied as input and Support Vector Machineand K-Nearest Neighbour algorithms based solutions are provided. The dataset is trained mean-square loss function for seismicdata and adam technique to opmize. It also aims to train the dataset in reconstruting the missing values using feature maps and ensemble method using classifers. The performance analysis is made with various other methods for its efficiency. It also addresses the regularly missing data in additionof missing values in the dataset. Finally, the results show that K-Nearest Neighbour algorithm is the state-of-art algorithm in predicting the disease early and addressing missing values in the dataset than Support Vector Machine.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Accurate Potato Leaf Disease Detection: Integration of U-Net and EfficientNetB7
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Early detection and accurate classification of plant diseases are critical for enhancing crop yield and ensuring food security. Traditional methods, while effective, often require manual inspection and are not scalable. Recent advancements in deep learning (DL) have shown promise in automating this process. However, many models rely heavily on either transfer learning or single-technique approaches, which may not fully capture the complex patterns associated with plant diseases and require high completion time. To address this gap, we propose a hybrid model that combines the U-Net mask for precise leaf segmentation with custom EfficientNetB7 for robust feature extraction and classification for potato leaf disease. The U-Net model isolates disease-affected regions, enhancing the focus on critical areas, while EfficientNetB7 processes these regions to classify the diseases accurately. Our model achieved a state-of-the-art accuracy of 98.64%, outperforming existing models by up to 1.32%. Additionally, the model demonstrated exceptional precision (99.01%), recall (98.61%), and F1-score (98.81%), highlighting its reliability across different disease types. This research advances plant disease detection and provides a scalable solution that can be adapted to various crops, offering significant benefits to precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Skin Lesions for Early Melanoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Skin is the most common type of cancer, melanoma is one of the most dangerous and at the same time, it is among those types of cancer, the treatment of which depends on the early detection. This work proposes a solution based on the deep learning by employing the ResNet50 to employ the classification of skin lesion into melanoma, benign nevi and seborrheic keratosis. The model was trained using the dataset of ISIC which contains thousands of dermoscopic images. Some of the preprocessing steps as resizing, data augmentation methods and normalization procedures were performed. ResNet50 were further pre-trained on the ImageNet and the final layer was changed to a softmax for the three classes of lesion. The model used in the present study gave an accuracy of 92.3% overall and a sensitivity of 90.8%. Specificity was 94.6% and sensitivity. The AUC of 0.955 has a good accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in the differentiation of malignant and benign lesion. The overall accuracy confirmed in the confusion matrix was high; at the same time, some intersections between melanoma and benign nevi misclassifications were observed. As a consequence, these findings show that deep learning can be further explored to improve skin lesion classification in early melanoma diagnosis. More research will be directed towards enlarging the set of data for training and refining the application of the model in the clinical practice.

articleTitle: A Survey on Leveraging Technology for Domestic Violence Survivors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Domestic violence, a serious social issue, traps victims in a cycle of fear and control. It can be physical, sexual, emotional, economic, or psychological in nature, and it often escalates over time. It underscores the critical need for prevention efforts aimed at challenging societal norms and providing support services. By utilising technology, a promising avenue to combat domestic violence can be created. This survey mainly aims to analyse various technologies like AI, ML, NLP, DL which can be used to empower victims by providing access to information, resources, and support systems. Finally, this paper proposes a comprehensive solution aimed at tackling domestic violence which will ultimately break the cycle of abuse and fostering safety and independence for individuals affected by domestic violence.

articleTitle: Transforming Homes into Smart Havens: Advanced Control with NodeMCU and Android Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Creating groundbreaking solutions that benefit the populace is imperative in the modern era. The Internet of Things (IoT) serves as a trailblazing sector, fostering the development of contrivances automating an array of tasks. The IoT encompasses an interlinked network of cyber-connected contrivances executing functions with minimal human intervention. Capitalizing on IoT principles, this exploration endeavors to contrive a device aiding individuals grappling with mobility impediments. The envisioned gizmo consists of two primary sectors: a hardware module featuring a channel relay, Arduino, and an astute luminescent bulb, and a software element encompassing cloud and IoT platforms alongside a purpose-built app. The chief function of this contraption is to discern specific vocalizations in an individual’s utterances, effectuating or deactivating the astute contraption to institute an intelligent habitation. In the initial phase, a luminous bulb will serve as a demonstration, employing for app origination. The distinctive aspect of this program lies in its vocalization-receptive microphone, with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi chips augmenting transmission velocity between the luminescent bulb and the mobile device. Meticulous attention will be accorded to auditory sensitivity and expeditious data transmission, with potential integration of diverse contrivances like ventilators and temperature-regulating apparatus into the envisioned gizmo. Furthermore, contemplation extends to a fortified safety attribute ensuring singular response to a particular vocal identity.

articleTitle: DLIDAP: Experimental Evaluation of Drug Prediction System Using Modified Deep Learning Strategy with Intelligent Data Analyzer Principles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, or the act of deducing an individual's view on a topic from their written expression, is a rapidly developing field within the larger field of natural language processing. Medication sentiment analysis has gained traction in recent years as researchers have discovered that classifying medicines by their efficacy through the evaluation of user reviews can help potential future consumers learn more about and make better judgments about a drug. To improve the precision with which pharmaceuticals may be classified according to their efficacy, the suggested research seeks for the keywords by tokenization and lemmatization. Such labeling can be useful in the fight against disease and the promotion of health and happiness. A drug review dataset was constructed using information from the UCI machine learning repository, subsequently four machine learning methods were implemented for binary categorization and one was utilized for multiclass categorization. The effectiveness of these four classifier algorithms has been examined by analyzing the results they produce. Between each of these techniques (Naive Bayes classifier, Random Forest, and Support Vector Classifier), the multilayer perceptron had been shown to have the greatest effectiveness, with an accuracy of 98%.

articleTitle: Deepfake and Face Swapping Detection: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The rapid growth of deep learning techniques, especially Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) has paved way to the creation of deepfake and face swapped media, which is posing a scere threat to digital content authenticity .These technologies have advanced to the point that manipulated photos and videos are identical to the original material, which has caused worries in a number of industries, including public safety, journalism, and cybersecurity. This review paper highlights the latest developments in detection strategies and offers a thorough examination of the approaches used to identify face-swapped media and deepfakes .Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which are frequently used for identifying visual distortions including pixel inconsistencies and abnormal face features, are one of many methods that are explored in this research. This study highlights the ongoing issues in the field and identifies promising areas for future research by weighing the benefits and drawbacks of current datasets and detection systems. In order to preserve the integrity of digital media, the aim is to present a thorough framework of the present deepfake and face-swapping detection techniques, providing insights that can direct the creation of more robust and efficient detection systems in the future.

articleTitle: Enhanced Detection of Eye Coloboma through Global Attention U-Net (GA-UNet) for Accurate Ophthalmic Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Eye coloboma is classified as a congenital eye disease that results in developmental anomalies of the eye that may result in eye diseases that essentially alter visions. Fractional and timely diagnosis still matter significantly in its effective managing and treating. This work presents a solution with a Transformer-Enhanced U-Net model that was developed with Transfer Learning to help augment the market’s ability to identify and delineate eye coloboma from medical images. This work further extend the gains made in U-Net, that has achieved fairly well especially in the biomedical image segmentation problem, with the inclusion of transformer modules for the incorporation of the long range dependencies and contextual information. This enhancement help the model to attend more on such small features as coloboma and overall diagnostic accuracy in addition. By using Transfer Learning with a pretrained backbone such as Efficient Net, feature representations from large pre-existing datasets are fed to the system as a solution to the reduction of training time and while the performance of the system drops no further effect is experienced.The approach involves the use of fine-tuning with Transformer-Enhanced U-Net model utilizing a subset of the eye images, which are labelled according to the existence of coloboma. Next, by adopting the self-attention mechanism, the model becomes able to pay attention to the relevant areas in the image, and hence is sensitive to any form of coloboma. In initial experiments, this scheme outperforms the standard convolutional networks for segmenting complex regions with minimal false negative rates. Moreover, by comparing the features extracted at deep layers with ground truth, the effectiveness of the model to realistic clinical usage is established given that the model is robust to changes in imaging conditions. The purpose of this research therefore is to develop an Auto-Generated diagnostic tool that will be more reliable as it assists the ophthalmologists in identifying early symptoms of the illnesses relating to the eye thus promoting improved positive results for eye patients.

articleTitle: A Noval Real Time Sleep Apnea Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Sleep apnea is a prevalent sleep disorder characterized by repetitive interruptions in breathing during sleep. Timely detection and monitoring of sleep apnea are crucial for effective diagnosis and treatment. We propose a novel approach for sleep apnea detection using Ultra-Wideband (UWB) sensor technology. The UWB sensor system offers several advantages, including high precision, low power consumption, and the ability to penetrate through different materials. By leveraging these features, we aim to develop a non-intrusive and cost-effective method to detect sleep apnea events accurately. Our research focuses on designing a wearable UWB sensor device that can be comfortably placed near the user’s sleeping area. The sensor system utilizes UWB technology to measure and analyze subtle movements and physiological signals during sleep, such as oxygen and heart rate variability. To detect sleep apnea events, we employ advanced signal processing algorithm, By extracting specific features from the UWB sensor data, we can identify the characteristic patterns associated with sleep apnea episodes. The proposed system has the potential to provide an accessible and effective solution for early detection and continuous monitoring of sleep apnea, leading to improved diagnosis, treatment, and overall patient care. Further research on creating a website for hospitals to monitor the apnea patients.

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Transmission Line by Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The report focuses on underground cable fault detection using IoT and machine learning techniques. Underground cables play a critical role in electrical distribution systems, and timely fault detection is essential for uninterrupted power supply. The integration of IoT devices and machine learning algorithms enhances fault detection accuracy. IoT components such as sensors, communication networks, and near real-time data analytics platforms enable real-time monitoring of cable health parameters. Sensor data is analyzed by Machine learning algorithms analyze sensor data to identify patterns or anomalies indicative of cable faults. Supervised and unsupervised learning strategies, such as decision trees and support vector machines, also learning strategies, such as decision trees and support vector machines, learning strategies, such as decision trees and support vector machines, learning strategies, such as decision trees and support vector machines, clustering algorithms, are used for model training and classification of cable health states. The combined use of IoT and machine learning enables continuous monitoring, proactive fault detection, and predictive maintenance. Case studies and practical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in reducing downtime and optimizing maintenance efforts. Benefits include improved fault detection accuracy, proactive maintenance planning, and enhanced reliability of underground cable systems. The approach leads to reduced downtime, efficient resource allocation, and optimized performance of electrical distribution networks.

articleTitle: Object Sensing for Visually Impaired Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Ensuring accessibility for those with visual impairments is still a major concern in the technologically modern world of today. In order to provide visual impaired with improved navigation and individualized healthcare help, this research presents a novel application that makes use of YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once version 8), a potent real-time object detection model. Utilizing the smartphone's camera, the program records live video, which YOLOv8 then processes to locate and identify objects like vehicles, pedestrians, and obstacles. It also provides the distances from the camera to all the detected objects with speed of moving objects to alert the user in case of danger. Apart from object recognition, the program incorporates extensive healthcare accessibility functionalities designed for those with visual impairments. To help users maintain the best possible health care management, this tailored healthcare feature offers reminders for medications and doctor appointments. This project aims to empower users by bridging the gap in healthcare accessibility and promoting independence, thereby improving the overall quality of life for visually impaired individuals through innovative mobile technology solutions.

articleTitle: IoT-Driven Real-Time Water Quality Supervision
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Plastic waste accumulation in ponds poses a serious threat to aquatic ecosystems, leading to degraded water quality, harm to aquatic life, and a loss of biodiversity. Ponds, being crucial habitats, require immediate and effective intervention to prevent further damage. The application of advanced technologies, including satellite signals, IoT sensors, and AI/ML with deep learning algorithms, offers a promising solution to this problem. These technologies can facilitate the rapid detection and removal of plastic waste, ensuring timely intervention to mitigate the adverse effects on the environment. By integrating these tools, we can accelerate the restoration of pond ecosystems, safeguard the diverse species that rely on them, and maintain the sustainability of water resources. The importance of such interventions cannot be overstated, as they not only protect biodiversity but also contribute to the overall health of the environment. Moving forward, the continued development and implementation of these technologies will be essential in addressing the ongoing challenges posed by plastic waste in aquatic habitats, ensuring that ponds remain vibrant, healthy ecosystems for future generations.

articleTitle: An Extensive Analysis of Amphibious Drones for Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Amphibious drones are drones that could fly within the air and on water. Buoyancy to transport through water calls for balance and symmetry of the competition shape; higher conversation is needed, with signals that penetrate better and feature less attenuation. to triumph over this venture, radio alerts and acoustic communications are broadly utilized in amphibious drones. To efficiently manipulate the motion of the drone, a microcontroller is used because the flight controller to ship and store user statistics. Amphibious drones use aluminum alloy to prevent damage. Primarily based at the above necessities, we are developing an amphibious drone and testing its performance within the air and in water; After testing, the amphibious drone can be utilized in surveillance, research, marine surveys, and many others. The improvement of the amphibious drone is ongoing and will be tested within the future. The improvement of the amphibious drone is ongoing and will be tested within the future.

articleTitle: Intelligent Safety Systems for Women
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's society, ensuring women's safety in public spaces is a paramount concern. Incidents of physical harassment and attacks against women continue to persist, necessitating innovative solutions to address this challenge. This paper introduces a novel approach to enhancing women's safety through the integration of wearable technology with fashion accessories, specifically smart handbags. These smart handbags are equipped with sensors that continuously monitor the wearer's environment, enabling real-time threat detection. In the event of a potential danger, the system triggers alerts to both security forces and the wearer's contacts, ensuring a rapid and coordinated response. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of this smart handbag system, emphasizing its potential to empower women and create safer public spaces. Additionally, it discusses the scalability and future applications of this technology in the broader context of women's safety.

articleTitle: Ensuring purity, precision and consumption in every drop of water with IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In a world where access to clean and pure water is paramount, ensuring its quality and fair distribution is of utmost importance. Traditional water purification methods often fall short in providing real-time insights into water purity, leading to potential health risks. Moreover, the equitable distribution of water resources in shared residential spaces remains a challenge, often resulting in unfair billing practices. To address these issues, we present an innovative solution leveraging IoT technology. Our system comprises sensors measuring critical parameters such as pH, turbidity, ultrasonic, and dissolved oxygen, which are connected to an Arduino Mega board. This setup continuously monitors the quality of water stored in reservoirs managed by water cooperatives. Upon detecting any deviation from predefined purity standards, the system triggers alerts via SMS using a SIM 900 A module, ensuring prompt action by relevant authorities to maintain water quality. Furthermore, we propose the installation of individual water meters in each household within residential complexes. These meters accurately track daily water consumption, empowering residents to pay only for the water they use, eliminating unfair billing practices. Additionally, this initiative aims to raise awareness about water conservation by enabling users to visualize their consumption patterns and encouraging responsible usage. By implementing cost estimation algorithms based on water consumption data, our system facilitates transparent billing processes while enabling authorities to predict future water demands more accurately. Ultimately, this project not only ensures the purity and precision of every drop of water but also promotes equitable distribution and conservation of this precious resource, fostering a sustainable future for all.

articleTitle: KPI Metrics based Promotion Predictive Analysis (PPA) Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In today's competing business environment, the development and sustainability of an organization are meticulously tangled to the development and advancement of its employees. Career encroachment is not only a strategic persuader for employees but also an acute factor in improving organizational performance. Recognizing employees with high prospective and strategically investing in their development can build ways for improvement in productivity, innovation, and long-term success. In this paper, the prediction of employee promotion is handled by analyzing their performance based on various facts such as the number of trainings they attended, their KPI (Key Point Indicators) achievements, number of years they have served as the workforce and they training scores via our Promotion Predictive Analysis (PPA). These factors play a crucial role in determining the growth of an employee’s career and their worth as an asset to the organization. By understanding the fact that the growth of several individual employees directly comes together to influence the growth of a company, it is possible to see a direction for improvement. For this, it is imperative that the organization is able to use various techniques and tools to classify these individuals into different groups. This is done by examining the aforementioned factors and how they relate to each other, thus providing a way to strategize employee performance and career development by using a machine learning based model called SMOTEd-Boost which combined XGBoost with Synthetic Minority Oversampling technique (SMOTE) to deal with imbalanced data and classification of KPI indicators. Also our method is compared with the existing Naive Bayes and Support Vector Machines (SVM) algorithms for performance validation. Therefore, our PPA model helps others to understand the significance of the relation between an employee’s growth and an organization’s future and the need for a classification system to realize which employee’s serve the potential to be a crucial asset to the organization’s future and give them a suitable platform and also equip them with the abilities to maximize their capabilities. This would also prove to strengthen the bond between a company and their employees.

articleTitle: Deep learning-based platform for Prediction of Loss of Ambulation (LOA) in Parkinson disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Parkinson’s Disease or PD is associated with a disabling, progressively motor function loss control which leads to Loss of Ambulation (LOA), which marks a critical and devastating development as patients lose independent mobility. Early detection of LOA is important in ensuring patient care and intervention. The traditional ways are often slow and imprecise. We suggest a Parkinson’s disease patient LOA prediction platform that combines cutting-edge neural networks utilizing machine learning techniques. Some of these machine learning techniques are Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest. The platform combines multiple sources of data from clinical assessments, motor function test results and wearable sensors to identify the more nuanced patterns relating to changes in motor function. Trained on an expansive dataset comprising longitudinal clinical observations and sensor readings in real time, the platform turns out to be far more predictive than conventional methods. The platform innovates existing frameworks and previous work by combining these methods to improve diagnostic accuracy, while preserving interpretability for deployment in healthcare settings with compliance of ethical standards. These advancements may ultimately result in the identification and treatment of Loss of Ambulation (LOA) in Parkinson’s Disease at a far earlier stage than previously possible, hence improving patient outcomes along with overall life quality.

articleTitle: MR-PC-A Multi-Reality Personal Computer with Minimal I/O Hardware
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The limits of conventional computer input methods—most notably, physical keyboards—become evident as virtual reality (VR) advances, impeding the immersive potential of VR environments. In order to provide users with a more efficient and user-friendly method of text input and control in virtual environments, our project presents "Immersive Glove," an inventive VR glove solution meant to replace traditional keyboards. With its smooth keyboard, simple gesture detection, and accurate motion tracking, Immersive Glove seeks to revolutionize VR user interfaces. In order to precisely record hand movements and enable natural and immersive interaction between users and virtual objects, the glove incorporates cutting-edge sensor technology

articleTitle: AI Model Integrated Omani Currency Detector for the Visually Impaired-A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In this research work a mobile application is created specifically for the blind and individuals with visual impairmentsfor enabling them to recognize Omani currenciesin real time independently. Also,people those who have a significant reduction in their ability to see, and it impacts their daily life usesvoice commandto recognize the Omani cash currencies. The proposed currency detector works by taking a picture of Omani currency by voice command, then the cash identification is done by using a teachable machine and personal image classifier AI models, at lastthe phone tells the value of currency correctly as a voice massage to the user, whether it is one riyal or five riyals or ten riyals or twenty riyals. This application can be installed both in IOS and Android devices. The proposed system aims to accurately identify and classify different denominations of Omani Rial (OMR) notes in real-time, enabling visually impaired individuals to confidently handle monetary transactions without any assistance. The application consists of two screens. Screen 1 set for teachable machine classifier AI model and Screen 2 as personal image classifier AI model through which a picture of the Omani currency is taken, identify the currencies and the user knows the cash value independently without others help by sound. The proposed workis tested by the teachable machine AI model for ten times and identified the Omani currencies correctlyfor 7 times,also tested by personal image classifier AI model for ten times and got the correct cash result for 8 times. From the test results,it is found that the personal image classifier works more accurate and better than teachable machine AI model.

Author Keywords: MIT App inventor with Personal Image classifier Artificial intelligence (AI) model

articleTitle: Hybrid Intelligence for Sustainable Tourism: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The tourism sector plays a pivotal role in the livelihoods of a substantial portion of the population, serving as a crucial source of income and foreign exchange for both developed and emerging economies. Beyond economic benefits, tourism offers stress-relieving getaways that aid in rejuvenation by reducing stress levels. Consequently, effective management of tourists and tourism is imperative to fully capitalize on the advantages this sector offers to the global economy. With a plethora of holiday destinations available, selecting the ideal spot can be challenging, especially considering that some locales are best enjoyed during specific seasons. This paper addresses the complexity of destination selection by leveraging data from diverse sources to develop a cutting- edge recommendation system. This user-centric system harnesses advanced recommendation technologies to deliver tailored suggestions, employing a comparative methodology to evaluate various possible recommendation approaches. Notably, clustering techniques emerge as a promising avenue for enhancing tourism information services. By presenting a novel approach to personalized tourism recommendations, this study contributes to the ongoing discourse on leveraging technology to optimize travel experiences. To ensure academic integrity and avoid plagiarism, this paper meticulously rephrases existing literature while incorporating fresh terminology and innovative perspectives.

articleTitle: Churn Analysis For Restaurant
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Churn analysis entails examining historical customer data to forecast future customer actions. Churn metrics quantify the count of customers who have ceased using your product or service within a specific time frame. Our web-based platform offers churn analysis tailored for restaurants. Successful eateries typically engage in some form of customer analysis, which is essentially synonymous with demographics. It is crucial to understand the age, spending capacity, and dining preferences of the local population you intend to serve. Customer analysis revolves around your preferred customer base and plays a critical role in ascertaining whether you are offering the right cuisine at the appropriate price points. Churn analytics involves measuring the rate at which customers discontinue using a product, website, or service. Reducing churn rates leads to increased customer satisfaction, higher profit margins, and enhanced overall profitability. Therefore, we are developing a web application to address this scenario, another essential aspect is how the restaurant can meet and exceed customer expectations. We have found that predicting restaurant survival is a challenging task that cannot be solely resolved by considering customer ratings or sentiment metrics. In comparison to definitive and well-structured ratings, the diverse expressions used in reviews offer deeper insights into the restaurant and warrant thorough analysis. We employ multiple language models to comprehensively analyse the textual content. Extensive experiments have shown that review text holds the most significant predictive power. Additionally, we compare models across different cities and consistently find similar results. While our focus in this paper is on restaurants, this approach can be readily extended to other types of businesses.

articleTitle: NeuroAI: A Cascaded CNN Model for High-Accuracy Autism Detection Using Neuroimaging Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental condition that impacts social communication, behavior, and cognitive functions. Early detection of autism is crucial for timely intervention, which can significantly improve developmental outcomes for individuals. This paper presents a novel methodology for detecting Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) using a Cascaded Convolutional Neural Network (CCNN) model. The proposed CCNN model processes neuroimaging data to detect patterns indicative of autism. The dataset used comprises 6,214 samples from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE). Key preprocessing steps include resizing images to 224x224 pixels, noise reduction using a Median Filter, image cropping to focus on the region of interest (ROI), and contrast enhancement using histogram equalization. The CCNN architecture involves multiple convolutional layers, followed by max-pooling and fully connected layers, culminating in a Softmax layer for classification. The model is trained using the Adam optimizer with binary cross-entropy loss, achieving an accuracy of 93.19% on the test set, outperforming traditional models such as SVM, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression.

articleTitle: Subtitle Synchronization Using Whisper ASR Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach to subtitle synchronization using the Whisper ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) model from OpenAI. The primary aim of this research is to achieve accurate and robust synchronization of subtitles with audio content, even in the presence of uniform or non-uniform delays. The project leverages the capabilities of the Whisper ASR model, which is trained on diverse audio datasets and offers multitasking functionalities including multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification. Key features of the project include Whisper ASR integration, SRT modification, and accuracy enhancement. The system utilizes FFmpeg for audio extraction and preprocessing, followed by speech recognition using the Whisper ASR model. Preprocessing techniques are applied to enhance the precision of generated timestamps, ensuring precise synchronization. The methodology also involves timestamp adjustment based on text comparison between input and transcribed SRT files, resulting in accurately synchronized subtitles. The project offers a user-friendly interface for input acquisition and interaction, guiding users through the synchronization process. While promising, the system has limitations such as the lack of action detection, character name prediction, and challenges with repetitive word handling. Nonetheless, the Whisper ASR-based Subtitle Synchronization project presents a reliable solution for enhancing subtitle accuracy and accessibility in various video content scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Hybrid Learning Methodology to Predict Autism Spectrum Disorder with Clinical Data Manipulation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: As a developmental impairment, Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) can lead to substantial difficulties in social interaction, communication, and conduct. The intellectual ability of autistic children and the severity of their symptoms can both be enhanced with earlier intervention. Several clinical studies have found that children with ASD have different facial phenotypes than those with TD. In this study, we present a Convolutional Neural Network-based Hybrid Deep Learning model for screening potential solutions to a unique ASD dataset of clinically diagnosed children using face photos. Support Vector Machine will be used for the process of categorization. The F1-score and categorization accuracy of our model were both 0.96. The Kaggle ASD face Image Dataset was used for this analysis of face pictures for ASD detection. Our findings corroborate the clinical observation that children with ASD and TD have distinct facial characteristics. Due to the high F1-score, it is possible to apply deep learning models for ASD screening in young children. We came to the conclusion that the practicality and accuracy of deep-learning oriented ASD screening with face photos depend heavily on characteristics linked to race and ethnicity.

articleTitle: Development of Artificial Intelligence Assisted Hybrid Learning Scheme to Predict Parkinson Disease with Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease (PD) is often made after careful monitoring and assessment of clinical indicators, such as the description of various motor symptoms. However, standard diagnostic approaches may be flawed due to human subjectivity, since they rely on an assessment of motions that may be hard to identify due to their seeming subtlety. However, early non-motor symptoms of PD can be subtle and are often confused with other conditions. Because of this, early identification of PD is difficult because these symptoms are frequently disregarded. To get beyond these obstacles, we present a deep learning model that combines Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) in an effort to boost the quality of the various categorization parameters. Improved model accuracy of 98.36% was observed in the experiments, indicating that deep learning and machine learning were successfully combined. When compared to the most favorable results from other research, this one was shown to give both equivalent and greater information.

articleTitle: Transforming Diabetes Care with Predictive Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood sugar levels, affecting millions of individuals worldwide. Early detection and management of diabetes are crucial in preventing complications and improving patient outcomes. In recent years, machine learning techniques have shown promise in predicting diabetes risk based on various factors such as demographic information, medical history, and lifestyle habits. Verticaling through a not-too-well designed case study — This paper is an extensive examination and comparison of different ML techniques for diabetes prediction. It goes through the methodologies, datasets, features, performance metrics and challenges of current models that are based on machine learning. In addition, understand strengths and weaknesses of all the algorithms- SVM, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Logistic regression etc. Here the logistic regression algorithm is used to develop a predictive model for diabetes based on demographic and clinical features. After preprocessing the data, including handling missing values and scaling numerical features, trained a logistic regression model using a portion of the dataset. The model achieved a high accuracy of 90% on the testing set, indicating its effectiveness in distinguishing be- tween diabetic and non-diabetic individuals.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Management for Electric Vehicle Charging Stations with Renewable and Storage Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Electric vehicles, or EVs, have attracted much attention as eco-friendly, sustainable, and economically viable alternatives to the conventional internal combustion engine. They are central to addressing the increasing power demand challenges posed by the widespread adoption of EV charging stations. This paper explores an integrated photovoltaic (PV) systems and grid-powered charging stations for EVs. It introduces a novel control strategy designed for efficient energy management across various operating conditions. The strategy ensures coordinated operation to maximize energy efficiency, facilitating power sharing between Photovoltaic system and electricity grid. It allows for charging the electric vehicles directly through solar energy using MPPTs and falling back to grid power when PV energy is not available. Moreover, the system can supply excess PV power back to the grid during periods when it is not used for charging EVs. A feature that allows for reverse power flow facilitates the creation of an advanced smart-EV-grid concept, where electric vehicles can help reduce the load on the grid. This adaptive strategy can also be applied to traditional EV charging stations. Accommodation of various environmental conditions is done, and the design of power electronics converters used in the system is discussed with detailed modeling.

articleTitle: Phishing Attack Detector and Awareness Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: Better detection and prevention measures are urgently needed as a result of the increase in phishing attacks. This paper presents a comprehensive phishing attack detector and awareness generator system through a browser extension. The extension will detect potential phishing attempts in real-time, alert users, and provide educational resources to help them recognize and avoid such threats and plays an awareness video related to the type of attack. Our system uses machine learning techniques to analyze the features of the website and determine the likelihood that it is a phishing website. By combining advanced machine learning algorithms with a constantly updated database of known phishing sites, the extension will offer robust protection. Our system is designed to be user-friendly and effective in preventing phishing attacks. The insights of this paper serve as proactive strategy which reduce the number of successful phishing attacks and increase user awareness of online security risks.

articleTitle: An IoT Based Innovative Agri-Crop Care System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the ever-changing scene of agriculture, traditional ways seldom meet the modern farmer's expectations in terms of efficacy and sustainability. At the hub lies CROPIE—an agricultural platform that changes the crop, revolutionizing the way farming is done today by bringing cutting-edge technology hand in glove with an oath to purely organic and eco-friendly solutions. While any single model is capable of diagnosing plant diseases, managing weeds and pests, and improving crop productivity by following health-oriented practices, CROPIE is a suite of state-of-the-art modules. Plugged into real-time data and powered by sophisticated image recognition, CROPIE enables farmers to make decisions that improve productivity yet stay true to organic principles. It is, therefore, such an approach that shall help not only to meet the immediate challenge in farming but also drive towards a more sustainable future of farming, which provides productivity without compromising ecological responsibility or health sensitivity.

articleTitle: Ecoflow femmecare - Sanitary Napkin Disposal Via Chemical Breakdown
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: The improper disposal of sanitary napkins poses a longstanding environmental concern, given their non-biodegradable nature. Conventional methods such as incineration or deep burial contribute to pollution, necessitating innovative solutions. Sanitary Napkin Breakdown is a responsible and sustainable approach that significantly mitigates pollutants by breaking down sanitary napkins into constituent materials. This breakthrough method reduces environmental harm and promotes recycling, allowing the repurposing of these materials. Sanitary Napkin Breakdown offers a promising solution to the pressing issue of sanitary napkin disposal, contributing to a greener, more sustainable future.

articleTitle: An Overview of Intelligent Control Techniques for Enhancing Regenerative Braking Energy in Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: In the automobile sector, Hybrid Electric Vehicles (HEVs) serve as a game-changer due to they provide a sustainable way to improve fuel efficiency and address environmental issues. Regenerative braking is a crucial component that recover kinetic energy during braking allows the vehicle’s battery to be additionally charged and thus extends the driving range. The application of intelligent techniques in optimizing the regenerative braking control system for HEVs is extensively explored in this paper. This research offers an in-depth analysis of intelligent control techniques such as fuzzy logic control, Sliding mode control, neural network, etc., which demonstrating the rate at which they can harvest energy recovery efficiently. This review addresses related issues such computing complexity and real-time responsiveness in addition to emphasizing the benefits of intelligent control systems. The review ends with recommendations for future research, such as integrating adaptive control techniques by synthesizing the current state of intelligent techniques in regenerative braking control, to guide researchers and practitioners towards developing robust and efficient solutions for the sustainable advancement of HEV technology.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Voltage Sag & Swell Using Intelligent Control-Based Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This paper introduces an advanced Dynamic Voltage Restorer controller designed to address voltage fluctuations within the system, specifically voltage sags and swells. The proposed DVR controller relies on power electronics and functions as a voltage source converter, capable of delivering controllable three-phase voltage output while mitigating THD on the load side. The DVR is integrated into the grid in a series configuration, promptly rectifying voltage disturbances and restoring load voltage to fault conditions. The key power quality issues addressed in the grid system encompass voltage sags/swells, harmonics, frequency variations, and reactive power generation. In this study, non-linear loads are deliberately employed to induce power quality challenges such as sag/swell and harmonics. To measure sag/swell voltage parameters and total harmonic values, the paper presents the development of conventional PID controllers, Artificial Neural Networks, and Fuzzy-PID controllers. The proposed system is implemented and simulated using the MATLAB/SIMULINK platform, and a hardware prototype model is constructed utilizing the PIC16F877A microcontroller. Subsequently, a comprehensive analysis of all pertinent parameters is conducted.

articleTitle: Automated Voice Pathology Diagnosis Through Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Power, Energy, Control and Transmission Systems (ICPECTS)
abstract: This work focuses on classifying voice disorders into healthy and unhealthy categories, specifically addressing diseases such as Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) and monochondriosis. Utilizing MATLAB and Python, we have developed an entirely software-based solution for analyzing voice signals. The system captures and processes voice recordings to identify and diagnose voice-related problems. Advanced algorithms are employed to analyse various parameters of the voice signal, such as pitch, amplitude, and frequency content. By comparing these parameters against standard values, the system can accurately classify the voice as healthy or unhealthy. This classification is crucial for early detection and intervention, potentially improving patient outcomes. This non-invasive approach offers significant improvements in the quality of life for patients with GERD, monochondriosis, and other voice disorders. By providing a reliable and efficient tool for voice analysis, this work contributes to better diagnosis and management of voice-related health issues, ushering in a new era of compassionate healthcare.
